fields.Text:
Sumire is a half oni, the offspring of a human mother and oni father.

When Sumire was born, people called her a cursed child and drove both mother and daughter out of the village. Hauling her tired body, the mother went seeking for her daughter’s father. However, nothing was there where the oni village once was. A sorcerer then approached the weary mother. Pleading that at least Sumire should have a chance at a good life, the sorcerer coaxed the mother into handing over Sumire. But contrary to what the sorcerer promised Sumire’s mother, the real reason why the sorcerer sought Sumire was to use her as a core for a spell. To the sorcerer, the powerful oni blood flowing through Sumire’s body was the best ingredient. The sorcerer sealed Sumire inside a wooden box and conducted the ritual. However, the power the child beheld was far stronger than expected and it began to overflow out of control. The sorcerer’s curse was let loose and it spread all over, taking the life of every living being, including the sorcerer. The area became a land of the dead with only lost souls left. Only Sumire, with the life force of the oni, continued to breathe shallow breaths inside the box. It was Akayuki and Aoyuki who saved Sumire from the sealed box, which not even the lost souls could approach. After purifying the land of evil souls, the two arrived at the core of the spell and found Sumire inside the box. Discovering the child, Akayuki and Aoyuki were dumbfounded at first, but recalling their own past, they decide to take her in as their pupil.

Sumire was raised by Akayuki and Aoyuki since then. The two cared for the child as if it were a competition and this extended to their teaching. Under their attention, Sumire learned various things from martial arts to mystical arts, basic common sense, and the kind of attitude a warrior should have. On the surface, their relationship was that of teacher and pupil. But as time passed, the meaning of their relationship became much more for all three of them.

Nevertheless, on the day of Sumire’s last graduation test, this relationship gets ruined. Sumire, who had come a long way, battled the Ancient Demon as a graduation test. At first, it seemed she would prevail. However, at the crucial moment, Sumire let her guard down at the thought of having to part ways with Akayuki once the test was over. The Ancient Demon seized the chance and gathered its last might to complete its Curse of Petrification. To save Sumire, Akayuki intervened and took the curse instead. Even as she was turning to stone, Akayuki didn’t blame Sumire. Sumire, on the other hand, who lost Akayuki because of her own mistake, sunk into a pit of guilt. The same went for Aoyuki, who was absent at the time because he had to control the Evil sword.

Sumire and Aoyuki did everything they could to bring Akayuki back to normal, but no existing method could turn her back. After a long period of trial, the two came to accept that Akayuki was really gone. Aoyuki and Sumire still cherished each other, but they couldn’t help but think of Akayuki when they were together. Every time they looked at each other they felt guilt towards one another. In the end, as the two couldn’t forgive themselves, they decide to part ways.

Sumire, who was now alone, honed the martial and mystical arts Akayuki and Aoyuki taught her, sought ways to turn back the petrification, and helped people around her along the way. Sumire had no particular intention. All she wanted was to keep her promise with Akayuki and reminisce about the precious times when the three were together. Hundreds of years passed like that. Before she knew it, the people she saved, those who admired her and those who emulated her gathered around her. Sumire accepted them and taught them as pupils. They then passed those lessons on and formed a new circle, calling themselves ninjas. As the circle was formed by followers of Sumire, the faith of the “ninjas” towards her was almost religious.

Having lost Akayuki once in the past, Sumire shows a tendency to overprotect her now that she is awake. This was directly passed on to the ninjas following Sumire. If Akayuki even mentions that she’s feeling hungry, Sumire and the ninjas go right into action bringing her all the dishes gathered from all the diners in the area. Nowadays, to avoid all this trouble, Akayuki is going out in secret more often. But no matter where she goes, she gets spotted by the ninjas and eventually Sumire tags along behind her.

Ameris is the Earth Dragon King Amarok’s daughter. She received training to become an heir since a young age. Ameris often heard the future of Earth Dragons seemed bright since she showed talent in magic and acted more mature for her age. However, after she started studying abroad in the Magic School in human world, she started getting caught up in multiple small and large events. Which is causing concerns for the elders.

Ameris spent a lonely childhood because of her status as heir. Her life met a turning point after she ran into the adventurous and fiery Girgas, who snuck into the Earth Dragon realm. Girgas pulled pranks on her without any hesitation, and this influenced Ameris. It was enough stimulation to turn her originally quiet personality into a bright one. She was able to laugh and cry from the pranks Girgas pulled and she could enjoy being a child fitting for her age. The Earth Dragons and Fire Dragons conflicted with each other, so their friendship is a rare case.

One day, the two of them started talking about venturing into the human world, and they started concocting a plan. The most pressing issue was that they had to transform into humans, but they haven’t learned transformation magic yet. That was when Girgas mentioned transformation magic stored in the forbidden library of the Fire Dragons. He suggested they sneak in together and run after quickly learning the transformation magic. Entry into the Fire Dragon’s forbidden library was strictly banned, but the two of them had had set a clear goal, and they didn’t hesitate.

Ameris followed Girgas and snuck into the Fire Dragon realm, and they easily entered the forbidden library through a secret passage. Girgas flew around the forbidden library as if he was already familiar with it, and he picked up a rustic magic book. Ameris took on translating the transformation magic, and it wasn’t a difficult task for her. However, their happiness was short lived. A giant stone dragon statue began roaring at them as if it reacted to their intrusion The defense system of the forbidden library that subdues intruders began to activate.

Ameris fell into a panic. She knew, if the heir to the Earth Dragons was discovered sneaking into the Fire Dragon’s forbidden library, then she won’t just get a simple scolding. She couldn’t fathom what kind of disaster would take place. The two young dragons turned towards the secret passage. Ameris jumped in, and Girgas closed the door. Ameris came to her senses after seeing the closed door, and she heard Girgas telling her to run away first. Girgas was smiling brightly as if he was saying she doesn’t have to worry about a thing.

Ameris couldn’t see Girgas for a long time after that. She missed Girgas and her concern for him grew, but she couldn’t approach the Fire Dragon realm. Ameris waited for the day she reunites with Girgas. She imagined the day they would reunite, and repeatedly practiced expressing her gratitude and how much she missed him so much. That was when she realized that she considered Girgas more than a friend. It was an obvious result that Ameris rushed into the human world after hearing about Girgas. She used the excuse of studying abroad in Magic School to become the perfect heir and ran off into the human world to find him.

Ameris perfected her transformation magic, but she doesn’t hide her horns or tail to look like a couple with Girgas. However, everyone considers her a failing student in magic like Girgas because she shows off her half dragon half human appearance. Someone once said they saw her fixing up the wreckage caused by Girgas’s pranks, and claimed she might be proficient in magic. However, that claim was quickly considered as a rumor since there’s no way Ameris could cast such great magic spells when she can’t even properly cast a transformation spell.

Priscilla’s a half vampire  born under Demonshire’s governor Count Claude, and a noble demon mother. All eyes fell on her when she was born, for Priscilla’s birth was the joining of two historic houses within Demon World. Priscilla was born with powerful magic and inherited traits from both houses.

Priscilla’s escape is the only known case of escaping the curse of the Demon God manifestation. Bellial’s manifestation only occurs to demons who inherited the blood of a Demon God. When a Demon God dies, they don’t get completely eliminated. Instead, a Demon God will possess a demon who inherited his own blood. And begin to sap away his or her mana to recover. Once the Demon God fully recovers, its revival will be complete. Due to the nature of mana absorption, the Demon God’s curse usually falls on demons born with great magical power.

Demons feared the Demon God’s revival would plunge Demon World back into war and terror. They stopped his manifestation by removing the host before his revival could be completed. Laws related to Bellial’s manifestation were top priority, and demons possessed by him would be killed regardless of social status. After the battle continued over 300 years, Bellial’s manifestation seemingly vanished from Demon World. 

But one day, as fate would have it, Bellial’s manifestation emerged within Priscilla’s mother Iris.Claude and Iris joined their powers in an attempt to prevent Bellial’s manifestation. However, it was not enough, and the symptoms couldn’t be kept secret anymore. Knowing it would endanger her and her baby’s life if other citizens found out about  Bellial’s manifestation, Iris ended her own life. However, as if to insult Iris’ sacrifice, Bellial reached his hand out towards Iris’ daughter Priscilla. When the manifestation emerged within Priscilla, Count Claude knew he would lose his daughter like he lost his wife. He desperately searched for a way to save Priscilla. Even if that meant he would be trapped in an infinite time loop…

Bellial’s energy seeping into Priscilla vanished thanks to Count Claude’s sacrifice. Priscilla lost both parents because of Bellial and was greeted with Demonshire fallen into chaos after it lost its governor. Since she couldn’t let her parents’ beloved city fall into chaos, she stepped up as the new governor. Both the Elite Royal Guard captain, and assistant, who stayed loyal to the Count, stayed by her side. All demons and vampires bowed to the mix-blooded girl who had inherited both bloodlines. It was a peaceful succession.

Priscilla still had lots to learn as governor, but she’s working diligently to be a great leader like her father. To get rid of  her old introverted appearance, Priscilla sets time aside to come up with charismatic lines by working with the assistant or shouts tough-sounding names for skills with the Elite Royal Guard Captain. Despite her inexperience, the office staff treasure the new, young governor, for her passion to fill her father’s shoes. 

Meanwhile, it’s not just the staff members who affectionately pay attention to the young governor. Priscilla became a star politician from this incident, and now is the hot topic for every citizen within Demonshire. The type of hand cream she uses when going out, the book she reads before bed, and other things she does gets the spotlight. The most popular gossip is ‘whether Priscilla drinks blood or not.’ It’s obvious Priscilla drinks blood from her vampire heritage. She especially loves the blood dishes made with Count Claude’s recipes.

Miss Chrom is the executive of the crime syndicate ‘Reservoir Snakes’.

Miss Chrom joined the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ only a few years ago. It was when the syndicate was competing with others to expand their powers within the Rah Empire. At the time, Miss Chrom was a grunt of a rival gang of the ‘Reservoir Snakes’. One day, she contacted the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ and made them an offer. If they wanted the Rah Empire, make her an executive. The syndicate’s other members all claimed she was a mole and suggested taking her out. However, the boss ‘Great Grandma’ was intrigued by Miss Chrom’s boldness. The Great Grandma gave her a one-year opportunity, under the condition a single failure would result in her death.

Miss Chrom joined the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ and immediately expanded the syndicate’s business. Not just weapons smuggling, but instigations, interferences, and assassinations. No matter how dirty the job, it would be done if the price was right. Thereafter, Miss Chrom contacted the Rah Empire’s powerful individuals such as the wealthy, nobility and imperial families. Even those who were weary at first soon became charmed by Miss Chrom’s silver tongue, and in no time jobs for the syndicate grew. As the syndicate’s influence over the empire continued to grow, Miss Chrom started to eliminate competitors. A few resisted, but they were no match against the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ which had already formed a tight relationship with the Rah Empire’s corrupt power class. Miss Chrom turned the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ into the largest secret syndicate in the Rah Empire within 1 year.

Having been recognized by ‘the Great Grandma’ for her remarkable performance at the empire, Miss Chrom was entitled as the ninth executive of Reservoir Snakes. As if she waited for this precise moment, Miss Chrom immediately began to get rid of the nuisances scattered within the organization. The most famous episode related to Miss Chrom, is where she once turned the affair of being exposed for weapon smuggling into receiving a medal of honor for services of public security. It is told that even the Great Grandma grinned with satisfaction. Acknowledged for her contributions from then on, she was put in charge of coordinating the syndicate’s tactics.

Miss Chrom feels extreme pleasure and satisfaction when her carefully laid plans fall perfectly into place without error. On the other hand, her plans going awry is her biggest disdain. She eliminates anyone who messes up her plan with unpredictable behavior regardless of whether they are friend or foe. Indeed, the death toll of disobeying orders is higher than that of syndicate operations. Due to this fact, the agenda that Miss Chrom should be submitted to disciplinary action arose within the syndicate. However, as the number of members executed for disobedience has been proven to be lower than the expected casualties for the operation, such opinion has been put to rest. 

Miss Chrom isn’t satisfied just being No. 9. Reservoir Snakes is just a stepping stone for her to reach even greater heights. She considers Arabelle and others loyal to the Great Grandma as mere pawns for her to manipulate. She already tracked down Elvira, but she is keeping her location a secret from the syndicate’s for future plans. Miss Chrom acts as an executive of Reservoir Snakes. However, she is willing to work with anyone to achieve her grand scheme. Even if that anyone is the organization’s target.

The immature Vampire Girl Karina, finally becomes the family’s successor!

Karina was the only daughter among many sons in a noble vampire family. However, she was far from manners and refinement. After an unknown incident, she refused to consume blood packs, and started drinking the blood of adventurers. After being charmed by the sweet blood of the Guardian, she’s been following the Guardian. When she arrived at Heavenhold with the Guardian, it gave her new and exciting experiences she had never felt at home. Karina kept trying to drink the blood of Heavenhold’s citizens until she was caught by Loraine.

Karina went through the succession ceremony she’d been putting off from adventuring with the Guardian at Heavenhold. She refused the succession until now, but after she received a letter from her father about her sister being sick, she had to return home. When Karina returned home, she saw her unconscious older sister, who couldn’t wake up from failing the ceremony. Karina’s adopted sister Charlotte was born with tremendous mana. She was selected to become the next heir to inherit the ancestral power, and was adopted into Karina’s family when Karina was young. But, Charlotte failed in inheriting the power during the ceremony, and fell into a coma. Karina, who faithfully believed her older sister would inherit the title, fell into shock, but she performed the succession ceremony as the other worthy heir. Karina entered into the ceremonial world where the ancestral powers gathered, and successfully completed the ancestor’s challenge. She rescues Charlotte and returns to her original world.

Through the succession ceremony, the two siblings shared each other’s power. Karina obtained more bountiful mana and Charlotte got a healthier body. Despite an unprecedented event of two vampires becoming lords of the family, Charlotte and Karina are more pleased with their hair colors mixing instead of them becoming stronger. After the ceremony, Charlotte was ecstatic and offered to conduct the succession together as lords. However, Karina left Charlotte the position, saying she had an important mission of drinking the Guardian’s blood.

After Karina left the mansion, she headed to Heavenhold in search of the Guardian. Karina considered staying behind and helping her sister with being the family lord at her request. However, she knew what she truly wanted was not the boring job of lord but rather adventuring with the Guardian. Karina, who’d been thinking of showing off her new looks, heard the news that Heavenhold disappeared without a trace. Karina didn’t lose hope, and tenaciously chased after traces of Heavenhold. After much trial and tribulations, she successfully arrived in Demon World.

She may have left the mansion, but she has been helping Charlotte’s duties in secret. As Karina faithfully answered every letter from Charlotte, she found out her sister was suffering from her duties as lord. At first, Karina tried to help Charlotte in person, but there were limits since she skipped out on lordship lessons. Therefore, she chose to make a deal with the androids. Karina would do simple chores or clean Heavenhold’s exterior that androids despised doing while the androids would take care of financial businesses. The deal is quite satisfactory for both sides since Karina can find targets to drink blood from while cleaning or doing chores, while the androids can do jobs they could do while sleeping.

Mercenary, on-call service, and party! Where there's money there's the Mad Panda Trio!

Mad Panda Trio’s leader Scarlet was put into a convent in her youth. 
When her father said, ‘you’re a nice girl, so you’ll understand, right’ she just nodded. Scarlet always endured to be the nice child. All Scarlet wanted was a bit of kindness from others, but all she got was bullying from other kids and the disapproval from the nun. One day a merchant notorious for his rude attitude visited the convent for business. The merchant was abhorred by others for his reputation to make everyone's lives miserable if it meant him gaining profit. However, when it was time for the merchant to leave the convent, everyone treated him with the utmost kindness. Scarlet asked the merchant how he managed to earn everyone's kindness. The merchant answered with a smile. Whatever your form or shape, as long as you have money everyone will be kind to you. After hearing his words, Scarlet fled the convent that night.

Red Panda, unlike his foul mouth, likes to boast about his heroic saga. With his captivating tales one can't help but listen until the end. During his time as a storyteller before joining the Trio, he even had fans following him around. Red Panda always talks about his past, but it changes every single time. So it is not clear what he actually did in the past. No one is sure whether his outlandish name is his real name or not. Yet, what never seems to change is that he retired after getting an arrow to the knee and that he absolutely loves his Trio comrades.

Daniel, a.k.a Danny, was once such a brilliant child that he was granted early admission into the kingdom’s university. At the time, this was big news within Kanterbury. The parenting diary of Daniel’s parents even became a best-seller all over the kingdom. Unlike his parents who were quite satisfied with the fame, Daniel grew tired of the attention.Then one day, Daniel passed out from a fever. After days of turmoil, Daniel finally woke up. However, having suffered from the fever, Daniel was no longer the brilliant child he once was.The world quickly lost interest in dumb Danny and the attention of Danny’s parents shifted to their second-born. So that is how Daniel became forgotten. No one hardly noticed, when he disappeared one day after a red-haired woman’s visit to the mansion.

There is no record of how the three met and came to be known as the Mad Panda Trio. Nonetheless, in their search high and low for ways to make cash, they formed a family-like bond trusting and depending on each other like no other.

Where there’s money, you’d best be sure that the Mad Panda Trio are on their way. Indeed, they were one of the firsts to gain info of a special party to be held at Heavenhold. Obviously, the Mad Panda Trio figured rich customers would attend the luxurious party filled with glamorous decorations and a magnificent feast. Prepared to strike it rich, they attended the party. Although they managed to earn a lavish prize amongst determined competitors, somehow the Mad Panda Trio seem to be continuing their poor mercenary lives. The prize they earned after all that effort is just collecting dust, being used as a bookend.

Red Hood Elvira, on the lam from being expelled from the gang, returns with a new weapon and more powerful than before!

In the past, she was the youngest executive candidate for the ‘Reservoir Snakes’. Elvira’s goal was to become the gang’s executive by diligently performing missions given by the boss ‘Great Grandma’. However, her plans began to go awry after her chance meeting with the Guardian. She picked a fight with the Guardian and ended up being defeated. A defeated gang member must be expelled and taken out according to ‘Reservoir Snakes’ rules. Elvira turned from the boss’s granddaughter and rising executive candidate into the gang’s target. Since she couldn’t return to the gang, Elvira blamed the Guardian for her being chased. Elvira asked the Guardian to take responsibility and began following the Guardian around.

By following the Guardian, Elvira experienced many adventures and happenings. An adventure around the world riding on Heavenhold was refreshingly shocking compared to her repeated bounty and monster hunting she did as the gang’s missions. A new adventure and incidents happened centered around the Guardian, and Elvira started to enjoy the adventure with the Guardian that never left her bored. It’s gotten to the point where Elvira nags the Guardian about when the next incident will take place. 

When the Guardian left for the Rah Empire and didn’t come back after a long time, Elvira had to live a life of boredom again. She would use bombs as fireworks in the middle of the night, or throw her apple pie bombs at people to deal with the boredom. However, none of these activities was fun as the adventures she had with the Guardian. Being sick of boredom, Elvira left Heavenhold to find the Guardian. Elvira arrived at Rah Empire, and she attempted to find the Guardian before the Reservoir Snakes noticed her arrival. But she was found by gang members chasing after Elvira and was under pursuit again. Elvira ran all the way to the desert to flee the chase, but the gang’s search net tightened. In the end Elvira trail was caught at a desert village.  

Elvira was on the verge of being taken out by gang members, but was saved from meeting Rosetta by chance. Elvira found out Rosetta is from the Reservoir Snakes like her, and despite being chased by the gang for a long time, she still survived. She decides to become Rosetta’s apprentice and become stronger. Elvira clung to Rosetta despite her refusal. Under the condition of Elvira doing anything Rosetta orders for 3 days, they spend time together. Elvira completed all tasks given by Rosetta for 3 days. After confirming how Elvira’s desire to become stronger was true, Rosetta left Elvira’s side with a new weapon and a letter. Elvira, who became more powerful with the new weapon, no longer had to run and left the village after defeating the gang members attacking her.

Thanks to Rosetta leaving her tab to Elvira, she’s now being chased by debt collectors. Later, Elvira searches after Rosetta high and low, but she misses her by a single step. Wherever Rosetta goes, she leaves a tab under Elvira’s name, so the tab is still piling up.

Rosetta was the executive and founding member of the crime syndicate, ‘Reservoir Snakes’. But she left the gang to live the life of a wandering huntress.

Rosetta’s early life was full of pain from being in a place called ‘The Wolf’s Belly’. ‘The Wolf’s Belly’ was a facility that kidnapped abandoned children in slums and raised them to be combatants. It was called hell itself as the children were both tortured and forced into the cruel training practice of pitting each other to the death. Despite this, Rosetta waited for a chance to retaliate. When she met Olivia, who shared the same ideals, they decided to leave this hell together. They stole weapons and eliminated all members of ‘The Wolf’s Belly’. She and Olivia burned the facility down to eliminate all of its traces. Rosetta and Olivia didn’t want the hell they’ve been through to be repeated, so they formed the gang, ‘Reservoir Snakes’ to protect each other. 

As the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ grew, Rosetta and Olivia began to argue about the gang’s operations. Unlike Rosetta, who claimed even the weak should be protected since they are a part of the gang, Olivia considered them as useless beings who endangered it. To lead the gang down the right path, Rosetta challenges her close friend, and leader of the gang Olivia, to a duel. After a fierce battle, Rosetta was defeated, and she left the ‘Reservoir Snakes’. When Rosetta disappeared, Olivia started to change the gang without hesitation. The remaining humane side of the gang from when Rosetta was a member had been eliminated. The rule of ‘Members who fail their mission or lose to the enemy will be expelled immediately.’ was erected during this period.

One day, Rosetta, who roamed aimlessly after leaving the gang, saves Elvira who was being chased by that very gang. Pleading that she wants to become stronger, Elvira clung relentlessly onto Rosetta. The two end up living together under the condition that Elvira does whatever Rosetta orders for 3 days. At first, she tries to get rid of her by making her do meaningless tasks, but after realizing Elvira’s genuine yearning to become stronger, she leaves behind a weapon and letter acknowledging Elvira as her apprentice.
Rosetta is considered a legend amongst Sparkling Barley Tea maniacs. Every year she participates in the ‘Demon's Road’ pilgrimage held in Dungeon Kingdom. Although it’s the rule to participate in a group of 4, Rosetta has always participated alone saying that she can drink 4 people’s worth. It is said that the surrounding customers cheer and applaud when she drinks an additional glass to rinse her mouth after completing the pilgrimage.

As for the police, she’s famous for a different reason. Drunk from all the tea, Rosetta has a habit of falling asleep basically anywhere. The street, the rooftop, or even other people’s beds. On days Rosetta drinks too much, you can find her in the most bizarre places. They say if you try to wake her up, she starts firing her gun randomly causing a commotion. When the sun rises, Rosetta gets up and goes on to drink tea again as if nothing happened.

Pymon destroys everything in her way and proclaims herself as the strongest Demon God.
Pymon was one of the Demon Gods who ruled over Demon World alongside Andras, Crosselle and Bellial. Although Pymon lost her body from being defeated by Lilith and Erina, she is awaiting the chance of rebirth by reincarnating in the body of demons.

The reason why Pymon, who proclaims herself as the strongest Demon God, possessed the fragile girl Reynai is due to her innate mana. As most demons who become hosts to Demon Gods do, Reynai was also born with an enormous amount of mana. On top of that, Reynai was also bright. She was considered a gifted child and everyone had high expectations of her. All because the adults said she should become someone great, she was educated strictly and rigorously. Such overbearing environment constrained her from expressing her opinions and made her a reserved, passive child. Reynai became the well-behaved, kind child her parents wanted, but everything completely changed when Pymon possessed her. 

As soon as Pymon reincarnated through Reynai, she began to destroy the center of Saul. Though Reynai trembled at the unaccustomed power and violence of a Demon God, at the same time, for the first time in her life she felt a sense of liberation. Lilith arrived immediately upon hearing the news and stopped Pymon, sealing her in Reynai’s body. From there on, as she did with the other Demon Gods, Lilith spoke of the ‘Time of Ruin’ and suggested a contract of obedience. However, she faced an unexpected obstacle. Contrary to her expectation that simple-minded Pymon would accept the contract without much thought unlike the other Demon Gods, Pymon who simply did not understand the content of the contract rejected it and started off. Even Reynai’s all-nighter explanations were of no avail, so she had to take charge and proceed with the contract instead. Pymon, on the other hand, didn’t seem to care what became of the contract.

Pymon thinks she and Reynai are the perfect team, a partnership of the strongest body and innate mana. Reynai seems to agree to a certain extent, but she becomes absolutely ashamed when Pymon starts flexing her muscles all of a sudden. The role of apologizing after vandalizing and causing harm is always Reynai’s job as well. 

There’s a part of Reynai that admires Pymon who always acts with confidence. Especially when Pymon easily says things that she can’t because of her timid personality, she feels vicarious pleasure and that she can depend on her. Now, as time has passed, she concurs with Pymon’s destructive way of solution although she doesn’t express it out loud. Sometimes she’s the one who first suggests to Pymon that she run amuck.  

Recently, to reduce the gap between Pymon and Reynai’s personalities, Lilith suggested that the two should switch hobbies. That is how Pymon came to start embroidery while Reynai learns martial arts. Perhaps the new hobbies were a good fit, Pymon surprisingly won the Artist of the Year Award at the Demon World Embroidery Exposition, and Reynai made Celine cry in a friendly sparring match.

Andras is a merciless slayer who equally gifts death to all those who don’t worship her.
She was one of the 4 Demon Gods who reigned over Demon World, but lost her body after being defeated by Lilith and Erina in the past. However, Andras’s soul didn’t perish. She possessed bodies of Demons of her bloodline and started to recover her strength.

Andras possessing Celine took place because of an abnormal worshiping organization. This organization formed during the Demon World’s reunification war. They kidnapped orphans from war and extracted their high purity mana by sacrificing them as offerings. Their goal was to accumulate the mana to reincarnate the Demon God and use her to win the war. The organization’s leader finally succeeded in bringing back the Demon God after offering thousands of children. However, Andras didn’t show mercy towards the organization that dared to use her for their own means. She wiped them all out on the spot. Then, she possessed Celine, the child who was going to be given as an offering with all the mana still intact.

Celine, who forfeited her life after being kidnapped, prayed for revenge to the Demon Gods. She believes Andras’s possession is the result of her prayers being answered. Andras felt bewildered by Celine’s heartfelt gratitude and respect. When Andras reigned over as a Demon God, no Demon had ever believed and followed her but only feared her instead. Andras believed Celine had gone mad for being trapped too long from her kidnapping. She assumed Celine would feel fear and despair like the other Demons when she regained her senses, but Celine’s respect and faith towards Andras only deepened. This made Andras start to gain a bit of interest in Celine as well. It was the first time in Andras's long life that she became interested in a Demon instead of a powerful being.

Since then, she was able to hide her identity for quite a long time. But in the end, Celine and Andras were discovered by Lilith, who was looking for the Demon Gods. After long turmoil, Lilith suggested a contract entailing freedom in the future in turn for subordination to the defeated Andras. Considering Andras’s personality, the other Demon Gods didn’t think Andras would sign the contract. They assumed Andras, whose pride was sky-high, would abandon her host and escape like Bellial did. Against their expectations, however, Andras willingly accepted the contract. Andras glossed things over by saying it would be bothersome to try finding another host while dodging Lilith’s watch, but the exact reason is yet to be uncovered.

Andras once got caught speaking ill of Lilith saying that she’s just a pipsqueak with petty tricks and was grounded for a month. When Andras shouted that this was hardly enough to restrain her, Lilith forbade the provision of Madeleines and romance novels as well, which were given by Celine’s request. Since that day, Andras is subtly being more careful with her words. At least in front of Lilith. At night she still secretly talks behind her back.

H.E.R.O.S KAI, which stands for Heavenhold Emergency Recovery Operating System, is an android designed to recover the systems of Heavenhold in the event of an emergency.

When Heavenhold was built, to be prepared in case control fell into the hands of the enemy, an AI that would support the Hero in regaining control no matter the situation began to be designed. Designing an AI that could discern Heroes as well as handle all the controls of Heavenhold turned out to be rather a challenge, so, the solution was to create an AI based on the mind of Kaden, who was best suited to carry out the mission. In the process of implanting Kaden's memories into the AI, however, the memories beginning from the time of Heavenhold’s construction caused an error, leaving only the memories of Kaden's childhood intact. That is how the AI came to be code-named Kaden Artificial Intelligence, or KAI.

As a child, Kaden was overly enthusiastic and often shouted the word “Justice," associating everything with justice. These traits were directly transplanted to KAI. The first thing KAI did on his first run was to walk around Heavenhold and use its control to name the equipment so that they included the word Justice. For a while, this gave Heavenhold’s workers a tough time because the equipment wouldn’t operate unless they shouted Justice. KAI has since caused many other problems including preaching about justice and passion upon every encounter until the listener’s ears ached. Nonetheless, because he was already one with the control system and many considered him to be kind of charming, it was decided he would stay that way.

Like the young Kaden, KAI also desired to be a Hero. On the other hand, KAI was also well aware that he could not become one because he was created for controlling Heavenhold and helping the Hero in danger. KAI tried to push the desire to be a Hero out of his mind so that it wouldn't interfere with his mission. But in the end, he couldn't give it up completely, so he secretly devised the Hero’s pose that represented his ideal image of a Hero. Although the pose was somewhat embarrassing to some, KAI says striking the pose makes him feel like a Hero. He later described the pose as "a righteous and sacred posture that inspires courage and passion," and it is said that he always strikes the Hero's pose before operating an important equipment.

Following the completion of KAI's learning, KAI had to be put into hibernation at the lowest level of Heavenhold according to the original plan, for his purpose to be maintained and to prevent him from being modified. This was done in the presence of everyone at Heavenhold. It’s said that even those who had criticized KAI for being noisy felt a kind of sadness at that moment. Right up to the moment KAI was put into hibernation, he reassured everyone that he could handle it. Although everyone there agreed that they wished to see him again, they also promised one another to create a future where KAI would never wake up.

Crosselle is one of the 4 Demon Gods who ruled over Demon World since the very beginning. In the distant past, Lilith and Erina defeated all the Demon Gods after a long battle. However, the souls of the Demon Gods weren’t completely eliminated, and they started seeking ways to be reborn.

The sly strategist Crosselle chose to form contracts with Demons. Finding an adequate host, Crosselle tempted Monica, the head researcher of ‘Cyber Robotics’, a company in charge of Demon World’s android production, with a promise to free her from all pain. Monica, who was suffering from endless tasks and fatigue, accepted Crosselle’s offer. Crosselle possessed Monica’s body as planned. The moment Crosselle’s plan of slowly possessing Monica’s body and regaining her strength was foiled was when she was discovered by Lilith and Erina. Lilith, who bound all 4 Demon Gods with a special binding artifact, spoke of the ‘time of ruin’ from the prophecy. She promised to give the Demon Gods freedom in the future, and suggested a contract of obedience to the Demon Gods and the hosts. Bellial abandoned the host and escaped, but Crosselle, Andras, and Pymon all accepted Lilith’s offer and followed her orders under the offer of freedom.

At the time of the contact, Monica made one condition. Speak and act with class. Crosselle didn’t think too much of this condition, but this was a grave mistake. The contract with Monica was the greatest suffering she ever experienced. Any time Crosselle attempted to act like a Demon God, she had to deal with Monica’s unbelievable nagging. She couldn’t laugh creepily. If her nail art got damaged during battle, Crosselle would face continuous scolding that would make her lose her wits. Monica was most upset when Crosselle ruined her new luxury coat. A skull-cracking scream continued non-stop. Crosselle couldn't endure it any further. The screams stopped after Crosselle cooperated with Lilith, and worked for three days and four nights to buy a new coat. Through this process, Monica achieved complete surrender from the Demon God Crosselle. This feat was historic. No other being was able to achieve this, not even the gods from heaven nor the hero of legend. Crosselle now lives a ‘disciplined life’ which perfectly follows Monica’s rules.

Before she knew it, enjoying a glass of sparkling barley tea after returning home from a mission became Crosselle’s only pleasure. Worn down to the bone by Lilith’s everyday orders and Monica’s constant nagging inside her head, the taste of sparkling barley tea that Crosselle got to taste by chance was so fantastic that it was enough for her to forget being reborn as a Demon God. Nonetheless, as Monica only allows one glass a month saying she needs to watch her weight, the ‘Sparkling Barley Tea Day’ that comes once a month is most precious to her. For Crosselle, sparkling barley tea is the only thing that motivates her to endure till the day she becomes free in the distant future.

As Demon World's best engineer and archaeologist, Vinette was the Lead Scientist in the creation of Heavenhold. Not only is she the leading scholar in both archaeology and engineering, if Lilith is considered to have spearheaded the economic growth of Demon World, Vinette is considered to have trail-blazed the development of Demon World’s technology.

Vinette, who showed great promise in engineering from her youth, was the Principal Researcher of the Saul Engineering Lab. Although she was competent enough to solve questions nobody could answer, she held little interest in Saul's military engineering. Her sole interest was in ancient civilizations and her hobby was exploring ancient ruins. Vinette was thus considered eccentric by the other Saul scientists.

Based on her travels to the ruins, Vinette published multiple papers on ancient engineering. However, her works were rejected by academics who didn't understand the engineering of ancient civilizations. Vinette didn’t care much about academic recognition though because she genuinely loved doing the research. Eventually, she quit her job at the lab to focus more on researching ancient civilizations.

One day, Lilith, who is Vinette's long-time friend and also the Demon Queen, visited her for advice about the development of Demon World. Though those around Lilith were skeptical of appointing Vinette, who was not academically recognized, as a technical advisor, Lilith knew of Vinette's brilliance better than anyone. With Lilith's support, Vinette became the Technical Advisor for Demon World and established a lab as well as a university to educate more students. Conducting research together, she and her students gradually formed a strong bond. From then on, upon Lilith’s recommendation, she joined the enterprise of building Heavenhold as the Lead Scientist along with her team of students.

The 'nanoparticle' technology Vinette employs is an ancient technology no one could recreate. To utilize this technology, which is extremely complex to even make in the first place, the cerebral nerves had to be connected to the nanoparticles. Not only was the procedure life-threateningly dangerous, if you didn’t completely understand ancient technology's principles, it couldn't even be used. Yet, against all odds, Vinette successfully recreated the nanoparticles and even modified her own horns to enhance their functionality. This was a monumental event, as it was the first perfect recreation of ancient civilization’s technology in Demon World. However, academia refused to recognize her achievements, dismissing them on the grounds that only Vinette could utilize such technology and thus could not be commercialized. Lilith, who attended the nanoparticle technology presentation, was deeply disappointed by the narrow-mindedness of Demon World's academia. This prompted her to reduce the fundings of stubborn scholars and redistribute it to support younger and more innovative researchers.

Fei, the last successor to the Shen Mountain Fist, travels the world and gains numerous insights!

Although Fei was once a member of a prestigious clan, his humble origin caused him to be falsely accused and was thus kicked out from it. Thereon, he received training from Old Master Tao alongside the Guardian and mastered the moves of the Shen Mountain Fist, which allowed him to defeat the Viper Clan, a clan that threatened Shen City. Fei then left with the Guardian to experience a bigger world while Mei inherited the will of Old Master Tao, who lost his life in the fight against the Viper Clan, and carried on the teachings of the Shen Mountain Fist. Though the Shen Mountain Fist staggered for a moment following Old Master Tao’s death, by joining forces with the Guardian and winning the Martial Arts Dodgeball Competition, Fei once again promoted its status to the world.

As Fei’s fame spread, fake clans that made money by impersonating the Shen Mountain Fist cropped up. Fei, who couldn’t just sit and watch, challenged the fake clans to a duel. In doing so, he rescued the victims who were deceived and retrieved their stolen wealth. In the midst of it, Fei comes across a rumor of a clan that uses martial arts strangely similar to the Shen Mountain Fist but in an aggressive manner. At first, he thought it was just another impostor clan, but as he heard more and more eyewitness accounts, he realized there were too many similarities. Intrigued, Fei paid them a visit. But the building was empty, and no clues were to be found.

For the advancement of the Shen Mountain Fist, Fei continued sparring by visiting numerous strong fighters and clans. Though there were places that expressed reluctance towards Fei’s visit, they also showed interest in the young master they had only heard rumors of and accepted his sparring challenge. Among them were people such as a giant man like the Viper Clan Leader, a Teatan of the outskirts who demonstrated nimble martial arts, and even a guru that could fly and wield a sword. Through copious sparring matches, Fei was able to develop his Shen Mountain Fist to be more flexible and suitable for real life practice. Upon hearing the news, Mei also continued to train, reviewing the records and teachings on Shen Mountain Fist that her master left behind.

The two regularly spar at the Shen Mountain Fist dojo to share the martial arts they have learned. For the growth of martial arts, this sparring match was held publicly. The clash between Fei’s soft, dance-like Shen Mountain Fist and Mei’s hard, diamond-like Shen Mountain Fist aroused awe in its viewers. Though there were people who made bets on their match at first, all matches would end in a tie, so they quietly disappeared. Before anyone knew it, this sparring competition became a famous attraction of Shen City. The Ultimate Ice Flame Bomb the two shoot together into the sky after the match seems to be especially popular.

Geumrin is a frail carp sage, yet her sense of justice prevents her from turning a blind eye to anyone in trouble.

Long ago, a massive waterfall and a "Gate" stood at the peak of Shen City's sacred mountain. This gate, which accumulated a powerful force known as celestial energy, periodically released its power into the waterfall, creating intense spiritual ripples. Carp sages would gather to swim against the current, as the condensed power could transform them into "dragons." However, this ascension ritual carried great risk. If someone consumed by greed reached the top, they could become a destructive "Evil Dragon."

Geumrin was one of the sages attempting the climb. To be precise, she was the weakest even among the carp sages, who were considered lower-tier. Her body was naturally ill-suited for accumulating celestial power, and her child-like frame had long since stopped growing. Nevertheless, Geumrin never gave up. She continued her training and climbed the waterfall every time the "heavens opened." She believed that her becoming a sage despite her weakness was surely the will of the heavens, and she desperately wanted to become a dragon to lead the world toward a better future.

After many years, the day the heavens opened finally returned. Geumrin vowed as she climbed the waterfall once more that today, she would finally reach the top... In the process, she exhausted all the celestial power she had painstakingly gathered by helping people in need, but she finally reached the foot of the last waterfall for the first time. However, Geumrin ultimately failed to reach the summit. Another carp sage, who had turned into an Evil Dragon, caused the waterfall and the gate to collapse.

Even so, Geumrin did not despair. Just as she always prioritized helping those in trouble, she stood before the Evil Dragon to protect the people. Then, like a miracle... celestial energy descended upon Geumrin, allowing her to subdue the Evil Dragon and purify it back to its original form. Afterward, Geumrin was no longer obsessed with becoming a dragon. She realized that one doesn't have to be an omnipotent dragon to help others; even as a frail carp sage, she could do plenty.

After the burned village was restored and peace returned, Geumrin left the sacred mountain, leaving the saddened villagers behind. She decided to cultivate her spirit by directly helping those in need in the wider world. However, contrary to her wishes, she faced obstacles every time she tried to help... Because of her child-like appearance, no one believed she was a sage. Unable to perform miracles every time to prove her status, Geumrin had no choice but to share her vast knowledge and old tales to prove just how old she really was. Only after a long conversation could she finally help people, and while she did so with a joyful heart... she sometimes felt a strange sense of self-deprecation.

Rey is the leader of the werebeast organization, ‘Tooth and Fang’. 

‘Tooth and Fang’ is an organization with the goal of founding a nation for werebeasts so they won’t face discrimination. Early on, the organization had radical ideologies and chose to use the most extreme and violent methods possible for their goals. Rey became its leader as ‘Tooth and Fang’ was about to be marked as an armed group by the people. Rey’s first order as leader was to have everyone hide their tooth and fang for a while. As the werebeasts lowered their aggression and melded into society, people started to lower their guard around the Tooth and Fang. Now, they’re known as a skilled craftsmen organization or volunteer organization instead. However,It was as if everyone didn’t lower their weary gaze. Suspicions about whether Tooth and Fang had connections to a large, underground organization started to grow. An article about someone witnessing Rey contacting a mysterious girl using forbidden necromancy was published, and the press agency closed overnight. The witness never came forward so there was no way to uncover the truth.

Rey thinks of all werebeasts following her as family. At first glance, her actions seem thoughtless, but all of them are guided by her love for her family. After she accepts someone as family, Rey believes the family member no matter what, and this causes concern for her subordinates. However, because of her unconditional trust, many werebeasts stay true to Rey and follow her as well.

Rey frequently cuts her rapidly growing hair, and has a hobby of knitting clothes from it. She even gifts the knitted clothing if she’s in a good mood. The clothing Rey made with her own hair is high quality and well designed. Since it’s a rare item that everyone can’t get, the clothing that somehow made it to the markets are sold for an exorbitant price among fans. Due to her talents, she wanted to become a fashion designer as a young girl. However, Rey was rejected from art school every time for being a werebeast. This memory is the worst among the countless discrimination Rey has faced, and it is rooted deeply in her mind.

She’s having an especially hard time because of the Innuit from Mt.Shivering. Many consider Innuits as werebeasts because of their appearance, but they’re actually different species. The key difference is that werebeasts can transform into an animal form, but Innuits can not. However, it’s rare to see a werebeast transform into their animal form in human society. Few Innuits take advantage of this to gain profits by disguising themselves as werewolves. Even werebeasts have a hard time telling werewolves and Innuits apart. Due to this, damages from impersonations are happening constantly. Rey is dealing with numerous woes from the positive image about werebeasts that took hard work to establish is being tarnished.

Ara is the wish granting Sea Witch. She was sealed away by Garam and Nari in the past, but broke free after the seal weakened from an unknown reason. 

Ara uses her magic to grant the contractee’s wish. However, the wish usually gets granted in a twisted way, and it eventually leads to the contractee’s demise. Despite this, those blinded by their wishes still seek out Ara and tragedy repeats itself. As damages began to mount uncontrollably, those with the will to do so, set out to take Ara down. However, Ara gained copious amount of power and magic. So even the most famous sages failed to take her down. Had Ara not paraded her power and came upto land, Garam and Nari might have failed as well. Due to this, she holds resentment towards Garam and Nari. She’s plotting her revenge and swears she’ll decorate her room with fox pelts by skinning Garam and Nari. Ara was defeated once, but she considers Garam and Nari’s personal skills to be way below hers. She just thinks she was caught off guard. Ara boasts she’ll win if they fought again. 

The contract between Ara is established by offering her tribute. The type of tribute is decided by what Ara wants at the moment, and it’s usually something precious to the contractee. Ara has a hobby of collecting beautiful and luxurious items, so she sometimes asks for simple luxury items. At times, she asks for a tribute that’s too expensive compared to the wish. Luckily, the contractee gives up and returns. All of the collected treasure is hidden within Ara’s mansion deep in the sea’s depths. Since her collection was gathered from a long time ago, it rivals that of the Rah Empire. A few brave souls who heard the rumor jump into the sea, but only bubbles returned to the surface. 

In truth, Ara doesn’t intentionally twist the contractee’s wish to cause them pain. She wholeheartedly grants the contractee’s wish, but just doesn’t recognize her methods to be wrong. Ara is a separate entity from humans, so she doesn’t properly understand the values, and morals of the Human World. 

Her impatient personality and over confidence makes her assume and make conclusions too quickly. Ara still thinks the attempts to take her down were caused by everyone being jealous of her. When she realizes she made a mistake, Ara gets severely embarassed. Ara thinks this tarnishes her perfect image and tries her best to act natural. Her human part plays it off very well, but her tentacles respond like a puppy’s tail to emtions and gives away her being flustered.

Like an octopus, she has superb regeneration. Both her human and octopus parts are the main body, so she can regenerate whichever part that gets destroyed. The regeneration usually takes place at the one that has more left, but the regeneration site is upto Ara’s will. It’s  unknown about how the unregenerated part gets processed.

The White Beast makes a wish for memories with a precious friend, and turns into White Snow!

The White Beast and the Princess are dear friends like no other. When the White Beast first arrived at Heavenhold, it was weary of everyone except for the Guardian. It even refused food Loraine gave and began to grow thin. The Princess made efforts for the White Beast such as offering her meat dishes or mimicking a puppy. Through the Princess’s efforts, the White Beast finally opened its heart, and became best friends with the Princess. 

There was an accident when the White Beast tried to hug the Princess to express affection, but ended up crushing her. The White Beast only attempted to express its affection like it did to the Guardian, but unlike the Guardian, the Princes couldn’t handle the White Beast’s heavy body and sharp claws. The White Beast was shocked after scarring the princess. It restrained itself and the accident never occurred again. However, the White Beast felt stifled since it only scarred the Princess instead of thanking her. For the first time, the White Beast felt remorse towards its own body, one that hurts the princess regardless of its will.

During the Snowflake Festival, the White Beast thought it could play with the Princess as much as it wanted all day if it turned into a human. So it went and made a wish to Bari. The pure-hearted wish from the White Beast was more than enough to motivate Bari who had been sick of granting greedy wishes. Bari taught the White Beast how to speak human and act like one, so it could spend time with the Princess. She also brought lots of clothes and gifted them to the White Beast. All the clothes Bari gifted were actually prepared for a family member who had turned into a child.

After turning into a human, the smooth hands, skin and everything else felt awkward for the White Beast. However, the fact it could play with the Princess as much as it wanted made the White Beast ecstatic. The most fun activity was making snowmen. The White Beast is a Guardian Wolf that inhabits the chilly Mt.Shivering region and likes the cold. The cold snow was the best toy for it. Touching and playing with the snow that it only ran on as a beast with its own hands was a whole new world. The playtime in snow for the White Beast and the princess continued, and they only stopped after the surrounding area near the inn was filled with snowmen.

After the festival was over, it returned to the White Beast form, but its bond with the Princess became stronger. The White Beast figured out how to play with the Princess without hurting her after being in human form. The White Beast is content not turning into the human form because of this. However, when it snows, the White Beast wants to roll snow balls again, so it contemplates making the wish again.

Scintilla is from the family of Harpies, the flame elementals who possessed the throne of elemental king for many generations.

She’s a harpy from the land of flames. Most harpies are born with frail thin bodies. Due to the laws of homeostasis, harpies can’t strengthen their bodies through training. However, Scintilla’s hard work surpassed this limit and changed her nature. She's the first muscular harpy in existence, who ventured into the human world with a yearning to have a stronger and more powerful body. During her travels in Desert Kingdom, she ran into Marvin and started to idolize him. 

She’s an excellent physical martial artist, and her specialty is kicking. Scintilla’s been going around the human world and learning more martial arts. After seeing the Super Thunder Lightning Kick of the two fairies from the east, she set a goal to find a muscular comrade and create an ultimate move just like them. 

Scintilla’s addicted to training. She’s a passionate exercise maniac, obsessing over her muscles. She worries about losing gains the minute she stops training, and uses daily activities as a way to train. Scintilla loves any type of training that’s enough to be a challenge. She came to the human world for the same reason. She believes the unpredictable nature of the human world makes it the true training ground. Nothing’s impossible for Scintilla. She’ll try until she succeeds! Scintilla is prepared to do anything through her burning passion and will like an undying flame.

Wakamo is a legendary exorcist and an onmyoji who commands the great yokai Geumho as her dutiful soul.

From childhood, she was said to bear the vision and aura of a reincarnated ancestor. Whether it was lingering spirits unable to let go or unruly yokai, a single playful gesture from Wakamo was enough to bring them peace. So when the great yokai Geumho, who had never before acknowledged a human, chose to serve her as a dutiful soul, none questioned it. Everyone simply nodded in acceptance.

Afterward, Wakamo trained in the sacred mountain where fox dutiful souls resided. Surrounded by her clan's onmyoji, she absorbed vast knowledge and honed her powers. When she came of age, she entered the palace as one of the kingdom's official exorcists. Yet the duties that awaited her were far from the path she had envisioned. Her strength was used only to preserve palace stability, while she was forced to ignore the suffering of those outside its walls. When she voiced her doubts, the clan’s answer was always the same: “Stay in your place.”

“So basically, all you have to do is not leave the palace, and you’re good, right?”
It was a half-yokai boy from the Exorcist Bureau, someone she occasionally spent time with. That absurdly simple remark ended Wakamo’s long hesitation. In the years that followed, she poured her conviction into a book filled with secret arts and broad knowledge. Despite fierce opposition from the palace and her clan, who regarded onmyodo as their exclusive property, she copied and distributed the book across the land. To Wakamo, the art of yin and yang was not the right of a privileged few but a means by which all could learn to protect themselves. For this act she was stripped of her position and cast out of her clan, yet she never once regretted it.

From then on, Wakamo traveled the land with Geumho at her side. She brought relief to those tormented by spirits and yokai, and exorcists inspired by her deeds gathered around her. When the half-yokai boy who had once awakened her resolve joined their ranks, she felt a joy unlike any before. Sharing wisdom with exorcists from many paths, her world—once bound by the limits of onmyodo—expanded beyond measure.

But joy and fulfillment did not last. No matter how many yokai they defeated, disaster always struck elsewhere. Protecting one place meant another fell, and the onmyodo she had passed down to the people proved powerless before yokai that grew even stronger. At last, Wakamo knew she had to choose again: whether to set out on the perilous journey to destroy the "Dark Immortal’s seal," the very source that ceaselessly birthed yokai. A path that could only be paved with the sacrifice of her companions….

When the half-yokai boy who had once awakened her resolve joined their ranks, she felt a joy unlike any before. Sharing wisdom with exorcists from many paths, her world—once bound by the limits of onmyodo—expanded beyond measure.

But joy and fulfillment did not last. No matter how many yokai they defeated, disaster always struck elsewhere. Protecting one place meant another fell, and the onmyodo she had passed down to the people proved powerless before yokai that grew even stronger. At last, Wakamo knew she had to choose again: whether to set out on the perilous journey to destroy the "Dark Immortal’s seal," the very source that ceaselessly birthed yokai. A path that could only be paved with the sacrifice of her companions….

Valencia, is Demonshire’s Elite Royal Guard Captain.

The Elite Royal Guard is made up of the most loyal vampires with the highest skill in martial arts. Captain Valencia’s swordsmanship is so amazing that she’s never lost a single Demonshire Swordsmanship Competition. After she became the Elite Royal Guard Captain, Valencia has successfully completed every single mission without failure. She’s quite proud about this record. Valencia confidently introduces herself as ‘Demonshire’s Best Swordsman’ and as having never failed a mission she was tasked with.

Many vampires idolize Valencia for her gallant swordsmanship, charming looks, and the fact she became an Elite Royal Guard Captain at a young age. After Valencia was featured on the cover of Demonshire Monthly, many young vampires idolizing her lined up to take the Elite Royal Guard entrance exams. On the other hand, there are those who see Valencia in a negative light. Her overconfidence and lack of experience were called into question. Valencia looks down on everyone except the Count. Due to this, she sowed many conflicts with the Count’s assistant and many others. On top of that, her lack of flexibility and common sense from solely focusing on training swordsmanship from a young age makes Valencia quite clumsy. There’s a famous tale from the Count’s quarters about how Valencia mistook ‘organizing’ paperwork as ‘taking care of it’ and cut the stack of papers down with a single strike.

After taking on the task of serving Priscilla, who is much younger than herself, Valencia feels her sense of duty has grown. Thus, she is constantly on the move but nothing seems to be of much help to Priscilla. Rather, it is Priscilla who cheers up the sulking Valencia. Recently, she spends more time training. She says she had a nightmare about a particular knight, but doesn’t reveal the details to anybody. Even when Priscilla asks with big bright curious eyes, Valencia only dodges the question blushing with embarrassment.

She strictly distinguishes public and private affairs. When she is on duty as the elite royal guard captain she maintains a strict and serious demeanor. But after the day’s done and she returns home, she hops right into bed to watch NewTube. As she especially likes animals, her NewTube algorithm is filled with cute animal videos. When she is curious about something she looks it up on NewTube. For Valencia who is slow on worldly affairs, the information on NewTube equals common sense. Recently, while looking up keywords such as knight, dual and loss, she learned that a defeated knight should declare to the opponent “Kill me! My spirit shall never surrender, no matter what!”

Noel is a Gnome doctor who travels the world treating those in need.

Born as Mora in the Gnome Village, she lost her parents early in life during the ongoing war against the Ants. The tragedy left a profound emotional scar within her heart. With no family left, Mora spent her days sitting alone and crying—until one day, an elderly Gnome inventor came across her. He invited her to his home, promising to heal her wounded heart. Having nowhere else to go, she accepted.

As she lived under his care, Mora searched for a way to heal her emotional wound. One snowy day, she found herself comforted by the sight of white snow falling outside the inn’s window. That moment also sparked her curiosity about the outside world. From then on, she observed everything beyond the window, recording her findings in a journal, and dreamed of the vast world outside. She often read the fairy tale “The Little Gnome Adventurer”, and admired its protagonist—Noel—hoping someday to become a brave adventurer just like her.

But one stormy day, Mora leaned too far out the window, trying to imitate the book’s heroine. Caught in a violent blizzard, she suffered severe aftereffects and lost all her memories. With her past erased, the only thing she remembered was the name “Noel.” Believing it to be her own, she adopted it as her new identity.

Time passed. The war between the Gnomes and Ants only grew worse. Wanting to help in any way she could, Noel began learning medical skills, eventually becoming a doctor who tirelessly tended to the wounded. Though the constant injuries kept her endlessly busy, she continued her work with the hope of a peaceful, war-free world.

One day, using one of the inventor doctor’s devices, Noel finally succeeded in ending the war between the two races. Peace returned—and with it, her lost memories. Inspired by the doctor who once healed her heart, she decided to set out into the wider world to heal the emotional wounds of others. After preparing for her journey, Noel leapt into the enormous light once created by the Red Fairy, accompanied by her close companion, the bomb bug Eve. Her body grew to human size, and eventually she met the Knight’s party and formally joined Heavenhold.

Everything in Heavenhold fascinates Noel, who once only observed the world through a small inn window. White beasts with sharp claws and teeth, bustling burger houses filled with people… and of course, the Smiling One she so deeply adores. Whenever Noel sees her idol up close, her heart rate rises noticeably. She recites her prayers with joy each time, though the Smiling One herself remains utterly baffled by the Gnome’s heartfelt devotion.

Clara is the Chosen One’s Saintess.

She calls Veronica Archpriestess older sister, while following her faithfully. The close relationship and religious life they share serves as an example for other ordinary followers. However, the true nature of their relationship is complete master and servant. Clara only acts under Veronica’s orders. Clara’s consciousness has completely disintegrated for unknown reasons. Her only joy and meaning in life now is to follow Veronica’s will and serve the Chosen One.

Clara is the Chosen One’s Saintess and ‘Weapon’. She’s at the head of missionary activities. These activities involve delivering judgment upon those who go against the Chosen One’s will. Once Veronica gives the order, Clara uses her power from an unknown origin to punish the nonbelievers. Clara sometimes gets consumed by madness and loses control. This results in her indiscriminately dealing great damage to both friend and foe. However, Veronica doesn’t mind any of this, and calls it the ‘miracle of the Chosen One’. Therefore, Clara is secretly treated like a ticking time bomb by the others.
Of course, there are those who worship this power. There will always be admirers of an enormous power, especially when people are losing hope from an outside force’s invasion. Clara’s activities under the name of Saintess have left a deep impression on many. It also reminded them of the forgotten memories of the Saintess who existed 500 years ago. And converted many into the Chosen One. Many neighboring nations, and other organizations that haven't lost bureaucratic capabilities are weary of the Chosen One’s expansion. However, the fear of the Saintess’ power is stopping them from taking measures.

Opinions about Clara’s first public and official appearance differ, but most agree that she came after the Chosen One’s 3rd expedition. The expedition involved Veronica and her direct disciples traveling to the edge of the continent in search of the Chosen One’s traces. The followers consider it as one of the riskiest since the Chosen One’s founding, and one that placed the organization’s existence on the line. There was an enormous explosion that could have wiped the area clean off the map during the expedition. But, only Veronica and an unknown female disciple led by her hand returned from the gruesome scene. Since that day, faint screaming resembling someone being horrifically tortured can be heard from the depths of the Chosen One’s temple. Some can sense excessive amounts of regeneration magic coming from Clara, but no one dares to question if there’s a correlation between the two.

“True strength is proven when you rise again.”- Reed

Randi is a southpaw fireballer and Rookie of the Year-winning battleball pitcher.

Randi’s dream of becoming a battleball player was sparked by pitcher Reed’s comeback game. Up until the game, he had been in a long, devastating slump, and no one believed he'd return. But he defied all expectations and stirred up cheers from the crowd as he stepped onto the mound. His blazing fastballs didn’t just strike out batters, they also struck a chord in Randi’s heart. Since then, Randi dreamed of becoming like Reed and began throwing with her left arm.

Those who witnessed her fastballs, thrown by her naturally gifted arm, hailed her as "the second coming of Reed." But she didn’t just rely on her natural talents. She trained relentlessly. But young Randi, surrounded by praise and attention, slowly showed weak spots. As a result, her once-proud fastball lost its edge and a string of losses started following her.

She realized that this would blow her chances of making it into the Purple Sox, where Reed played, and she pulled herself together. She pushed through 1,000 shoulder-strengthening reps a day and took ballet lessons to improve her flexibility. She even limited eating her favorite food, meat, to just one day a year, all to become a great pitcher. In the end, her relentless effort paid off, and she earned a spot on the Purple Sox and was named Rookie of the Year.

But her triumph was short-lived. During a game, she accidentally threw a pitch that badly injured a batter. The guilt and the backlash that followed left her left arm frozen. She was no longer able to throw a fastball, and the pitcher in her was lost. Unable to throw with her left arm, she worked hard to throw with her right, but was unable to move beyond average. Even so, she couldn’t give up battleball, which was everything to her. Driven by her determination to stand on the mound again and the support of those around her, Randi finally made her return.

After getting past a difficult time in her life, Randi’s fans no longer saw her as Reed’s shadow. The player they saw was none other than southpaw fireballer Randi in her own right. One day, a child wearing a Purple Sox uniform ran up to her, holding out a piece of paper and a pen. He asked how he could become a strong pitcher like her. Without a moment of hesitation, Randi replied.

“When you fall, you have to be able to get back up. That’s true strength.
 And… when it’s too hard to do it on your own, take the hand of the person beside you. 
 Because battleball isn’t played alone.”

A magic researcher who experiments on anything that catches her eye, always lost in eccentric thoughts.

Gremory was once a petty criminal in the Demon World, committing all sorts of bizarre acts in the name of science—such as swapping a human's brain with a wyvern's or testing potions that induce an out-of-body experience for exactly five minutes. Her experiment days always ended with public property damage and screaming citizens. She was frequently hauled off to the Demon World Police Station for disturbing the peace, but thanks to Detective Odile, who worked there at the time, she was usually let off with a warning.

After they became acquainted, Odile suggested they work together as detectives. Gremory readily accepted on the condition that Odile fund her research. Before long, they established the "O&G Private Investigator's Office," named after their initials, and began taking on various requests in the Demon World to earn money. However, most of their earnings went toward paying for the damages caused by Gremory's experiments.

One day, Gremory was tasked by Queen Lilith to audit the Neo-Federation. Since Odile was away following a tip about Lucy, Gremory traveled to the destination alone. Upon arriving at the Neo-Federation, Gremory intended to proceed with the investigation, but her urge to experiment boiled over the moment she saw the brand-new androids. Unable to restrain herself, she poured her specially concocted experimental potions on them, reducing five units to scrap metal. She was immediately detected and captured by the Cyber Robotics security team.

Gremory faced a crisis of 15 years in prison under criminal law, but unexpectedly, the head of Cyber Robotics appeared before her. The CEO claimed to have watched her exploits in the Demon World with interest and offered to pardon her if she cooperated with his experiments for a while. Gremory was highly suspicious of the offer, but the prospect of secretly gathering intelligence on the Neo-Federation—and conducting her own research without limit—was too tempting. She snapped up the deal.

Soon, Gremory was gifted a top-tier personal research facility and abundant materials. The first thing she built was a pair of giant mechanical arms. Her reasoning was that her two hands were too slow to keep up with her overflowing ideas. Now, her eccentric research speed has increased fourfold. Exactly what experiments Gremory is conducting in the Neo-Federation remains top secret. Rumor has it that she has already consumed well over 100 androids during her time in the facility.
