Chun Ryeo is a cyborg martial artist who reached enlightenment through extensive training.

He was previously exiled from the Just Heaven clan after being framed by the eldest disciple, whom he trained with. In the process, he was ordered not to use the clan’s martial arts ever again. His limbs were severed, and his energy core was destroyed. He also suffered from serious external trauma including major fractures throughout his body. An old master discovered Chun Ryeo, but it was too late for him to be saved by ordinary measures.

Chun Ryeo received surgery that changed most of his body into a cyborg. Since the cyborg surgery theoretically suggested immortality, many coveted it. But Kamazon was strictly reserving the chance for a selected few. Originally, the old master was to be the recipient after helping Kamazon’s Director Luiz, but he yielded the chance to Chun Ryeo after seeing him on the brink of death. The surgery was a success. Not only was Chun Ryeo able to carry on with his life, he could also continue practicing martial arts.

Chun Ryeo deeply respects the old master. This is because through him, Chun Ryeo was able to obtain a new body as well as find purpose in life when he wandered after achieving revenge. To Chun Ryeo, who believed he was alone after losing his parents at a young age, the always-righteous old master became his role model. The degree to which Chun Ryeo respects the old master is reflected in the martial arts he created, as the name itself is from the old master’s Dharma name, ‘Shen Mountain’.

The Shen Mountain Fist being called an unmatched martial art is due to its power as well as its broad application. The Shen Mountain Fist was created with the martial arts of the Just Heaven Clan, which deal with extreme yin, the teachings of the old master which deal with extreme yang, and Chun Ryeo’s own enlightenment. Thus, it can flexibly tackle any situation or enemy. Moreover, as Chun Ryeo himself is a human turned cyborg, it is said that both humans and androids can acquire the martial arts he created.

In the past, Chun Ryeo’s whereabouts could easily be tracked through his participation in various volunteer work. But after his master ‘Shen Mountain’ reached Nirvana, he vanished without a trace. As a result, rumors such as ‘He returned to civil society due to the grief of his master’s passing.’, ‘He secluded himself to gain deeper understanding.’, ‘He escaped in the middle of the night with a long, blue-haired woman.’, etc. have circulated, but the truth has yet to be revealed.

Sia is a vendor who collects and sells items while travelling all across the world.

She likes collecting rare items, from both land and sea. Ever since she was young, she liked searching the sea for hard-to-find pearls or unusually-shaped corals. From there, her interests spread to terrestrial items, and she realized that she needed resources to obtain the items she wanted. Sia started her business with items from her collection, and the rare items only found in the deepest parts of the sea sold out quickly. She felt fulfilled seeing people in delight after buying her items, and she decided business was her calling.

Because she wasn't interested in wealth or appearances, she wore modest clothes and spread her items out on nets and cloth. This led her to be easily picked on. Sia, who didn’t like conflict, tried to avoid it by selling items at a lower price and paying street tax despite experiencing losses. But as time passed, she experienced difficulty adapting to the rapidly changing trading posts of the city, and the amount of conflict that the the influx of people brought on started to get out of hand. In the end, Sia started to seek out remote places that allowed her to focus on her business. Soon, Sia became a kind of legend among tradespeople as someone who sells rare items but is difficult to meet.

Once a year, she stops by a beach town and does business there for a while. The town she visited after leaving the city was small and isolated, but the people there were so happy with the items Sia brought that they treated her to tea and snacks. Sia, who was moved by the kind treatment, visited the town every year. She became close to the townspeople, even helping them with town matters and having fun with them. To repay her for her efforts, the townspeople gifted Sia with a a giant cart in the shape of a shop. Sia, who always struggled to move her items, is said to have burst into tears by the gift. Because of this, that town became more important to Sia than any other big city.

Sia goes through great changes thanks to the town. As more people started flooding in with the passing of time and the town's advancement, Sia also began to get involved in various incidents. Sia, who couldn’t abandon this town like she did other places, realized that simply running away from disputes was not the answer. She began to dress herself up so she wouldn't be disrespected, employed the eloquence she mustered through years of business experience, and took advantage of her mermaid powers to confront conflicts that threatened the town's peace.

Count Claude is the governor of Demonshire.

Claude achieved the seemingly impossible unity within demon and vampire societies. Demons and vampires suddenly had to live under the same roof after the Demon World’s unification war 500 years ago. They couldn’t accept each other’s differences and conflict started to brew. As conflict and hate was about to swallow up Demonshire, Claude emerged and intervened. He promised prosperity and harmony between the two species, and married Iris, a noble demon family’s daughter. The union between these two symbolized unity within Demonshire. Claude gained wholehearted support from Demonshire’s citizens and became its leader. Some claimed the union between Claude and Iris was an emotionless arranged marriage, but Claude’s love towards Iris was true. Claude didn’t show it, but he deeply loved the companionship, and the little world they made together. Because of that, Claude stepped into eternity. Even a shred of hope was enough. If he could protect his loving daughter Priscilla, the treasure his wife left behind.

In Priscilla’s memories, Claude is remembered as a cold and quiet father, but he treasured her. All the letters Priscilla wrote to Claude when she was young are stored under high security and within his reach. The letters kept his resolve while Claude went through the painful loops.

Claude’s a powerful being who lived for a long period, to the point he can call Lilith a milk-drinker. He’s a pure-blooded vampire born with great mana. The experience he gathered from his long life makes his power at the summit for a single species. Turning back time using the artificial sun’s explosion was only possible because the caster was Claude. 

Just like other vampires, Claude also drinks blood. Many worry or expect Claude to bite the victim’s neck while drinking blood since he’s a pure-blooded vampire, but he actually prefers drinking refined blood like blood packs. It’s because he believes a willingly given tribute is more valuable than blood taken forcefully.


Claude’s the author of the cook book, ‘100 ways to enjoy blood’. This is the result of him researching a way to feed blood to Priscilla, who felt urges to drink blood but didn’t like consuming it. The Count family’s refined blood dishes are all made with the Count’s recipes.The recipes are delicious, but the cooking process is severely particular. Due to this, many cooks within the Count’s family quit after a short period despite being treated well.

J is an agent of the Atlantis Intelligence Bureau.

In the seas of Tetis, countless species swim freely, but the waters remain ever tranquil thanks to the presence of the Water Elemental King, Triton. Supporting him are the agents of the Intelligence Bureau, who work tirelessly to eliminate large-scale terrorist threats and national-level dangers that threaten Atlantis, preserving peace beneath the waves.

Among them, J is a unique case. Unlike other agents who operate in teams, J is deployed alone into mission zones and completes operations solo. Officially, it is said that the upper echelons have granted her special clearance to undertake solo missions, citing her exceptional ability to handle team-scale operations by herself.

But in truth, J is isolated within the organization. Though fiercely loyal to the nation and known for executing missions with complete emotional detachment—sacrificing aspects of personal life for the sake of duty—J's methods came to be viewed as outdated and inefficient following a generational shift within the Bureau.

As a result, J became the only agent without a team. After countless solo operations, staring at the resignation letter hidden in a corner of her desk drawer became a part of her daily routine. While J wanted to continue protecting the peace established by Triton, there was also a more practical reason: retiring now would disqualify her from receiving the special pension reserved for public servants.

However, everything changed when J participated in a joint operation with an agent named "Osprey." The mission offered her a revelation—both agents focused solely on the objective, with no emotional friction throughout the process. The clean, successful outcome solidified J’s belief that within a results-driven organization, finding compatible teammates was nearly impossible.

From that day forward, J began building a personal team for each mission. The selection criteria were threefold:
1. Shared objectives.
2. Complete transparency.
3. Equal authority.
Through this process, she built teams that could focus entirely on the mission at hand. Over time, these successes accumulated. As a result, in a rare decision from leadership, J was granted full operational autonomy—becoming the only Intelligence Bureau agent authorized to carry out missions without receiving direct orders.

To J, teamwork is just a minor detail. The mission's completion is all that matters.

Though fiercely loyal to the nation and known for executing missions with complete emotional detachment—sacrificing aspects of personal life for the sake of duty—J's methods came to be viewed as outdated and inefficient following a generational shift within the Bureau.

As a result, J became the only agent without a team. After countless solo operations, staring at the resignation letter hidden in a corner of her desk drawer became a part of her daily routine. While J wanted to continue protecting the peace established by Triton, there was also a more practical reason: retiring now would disqualify her from receiving the special pension reserved for public servants.

However, everything changed when J participated in a joint operation with an agent named "Osprey." The mission offered her a revelation—both agents focused solely on the objective, with no emotional friction throughout the process. The clean, successful outcome solidified J’s belief that within a results-driven organization, finding compatible teammates was nearly impossible.

From that day forward, J began building a personal team for each mission. The selection criteria were threefold:
1. Shared objectives.
2. Complete transparency.
3. Equal authority.
Through this process, she built teams that could focus entirely on the mission at hand. Over time, these successes accumulated. As a result, in a rare decision from leadership, J was granted full operational autonomy—becoming the only Intelligence Bureau agent authorized to carry out missions without receiving direct orders.

To J, teamwork is just a minor detail. The mission's completion is all that matters.

Heavenhold’s training instructor and the warrior who hones his skills to become a true hero.

Craig worked diligently for over 20 years to become Dungeon Kingdom’s hero. His unwavering challenge despite the long failure, he succeeds in taking down the Archfiend. He sometimes gets mistaken for Halbal, but the Guardian and Ailie’s wits solved the misunderstandings. He is now recognized as the hero of Dungeon Kingdom. Despite achieving his long awaited dream, Craig abdicated his position of hero. Because he made a new goal of becoming a true hero who saves the entire world by being with the Guardian. Ailie also cheers for Craig’s dream and leaves Dungeon Kingdom with the Guardian to Heavenhold.

Craig, who worked diligently to become a hero in a tough environment for a long period, couldn’t just walk past those in a tough environment like him. At first he’d simply give advice to people seeking help, or adjust their posture. However, his excellent teaching and diverse knowledge coming from his deep experience gathered a following. This led to a group lesson. Eva, who had been watching Craig intently, named him training instructor. He has well adjusted to his position and now works as Heavenhold’s lead training instructor.

Craig’s in charge of various lessons such as swordsmanship, shield handling and mental training to avoid burnout. His lessons are so popular it reaches full capacity in an instant. The most popular subject is How to Survive in the Dungeon series. The realistic description of extreme situations lacking equipment or consumables, and the demonstrations of survival methods written on the manual are surprisingly top-notch.

Ailie, who follows Craig around, gave up on Relic Collecting, and started a new job. Ailie wanted become a person who would not ashame Craig when so many people rely and respect him. Ailie chose the path of working for Kamazon after she gave up on being a Relic collector. She believed she’d be dignified if she worked for the global corporation Kamazon and help Craig achieve his dream by his side. The story of Ailie sending in her  ‘Kamazon’s 67 Problems’ report to Kamazon customer services and asking the corporation to hire her if they want these problems solved is still told like a legend among job seekers. Ailie got hired by Kamazon from this incident, and through a fast track of promotions, she’s now a Director for Kamazon’s Heavenhold branch.

Illuni is the first avatar of Girgas.

For Illuni, every day is a brand-new adventure to discover the world. Driven by a boundless, instinctive curiosity, she can't help but reach out and touch whatever she sees, clutching it tightly in her little hands. More than once, she's gone out with a fresh, rosy face and come back covered head to toe in volcanic ash, so often that even Girgas himself can't help but worry.

Illuni has a natural fondness for all living things. Even when she meets someone for the first time, she greets them with open warmth. But anyone caught by her attention is in for an endless storm of questions. She doesn't actually know many words yet, so her questions are usually simple and often repeated, with her nodding eagerly to show she's listening. On her way home, she quietly mutters the tricky words to herself, rolling them around on her tongue in clumsy, childlike pronunciations.

So lively is Illuni that even after a whole day of play, she hates going to bed. She'll chatter away until dawn, then finally nod off in Girgas's arms. Sometimes she drifts off alone, and on those nights, there's always a little diary left open by her pillow.

'Hi, Diary~! Today I played with Dummy-face, Smiley-face, and Girgas! My favorite was hide-and-seek! But this time, Dummy-face spotted me and went, "There you are!" and I jumped so high! Girgas laughed and called me silly. He said I have to hide my legs too! But it's okay if I get caught. Then I can just hide again! I'm gonna play again and again and again!

Oh! I gave Dummy-face some red water, but they didn't drink it. They said it was lava. Lava's not for drinking, it's yucky! Then the red water went POP! And BOOOOM!!! So... is red water lava? Or yucky??? Hmm... I dunno! There are sooo many funny words in the world! I wanna learn them all!

So I thought about how to do that. Everyone has to stay with me! When we’re together, I learn sooo many new things! And when I copy them, they clap and say I did great! It makes me super happy~! If I learn lots and lots, maybe someday I’ll do something really amazing, just like Girgas! Tomorrow I’m gonna play even more, and if I learn something new, you’ll be the very first I tell, Diary!'

Even in her sleep, Illuni smiles and mumbles to herself—perhaps reliving the joys of the day or already dreaming of the wonders tomorrow will bring. That pure, innocent light is the very reason she is loved by all.

Beach Cleanup Hitter Rie aims for the Summer Battleball Tournament trophy!

The Summer Battleball Tournament, the biggest event of the season under the blazing summer sun, has officially begun. Known for its thrilling and exhilarating matches, the tournament draws more anticipation than any other battleball competition. After suffering a crushing defeat in last year's finals against the Teatan Giants, Rie spent a spring even hotter than summer, fueled by determination. This summer, the Purple Sox are marching toward the tournament with renewed resolve, burning with the will to reclaim the championship trophy. 

What fans are most excited about this tournament is Rie's performance. In the previous Spring Tournament, she led her team to victory with a 10-game home run streak and flawless defense. At the time, commentators unanimously hailed her as the greatest player in battleball history. When Rie declared in a pre-tournament interview that she had been sharpening her skills and was more prepared than ever, fans and officials alike flocked to the stadium, eager to witness just how unstoppable she'd be in her already near-perfect form. All eyes are now on the Purple Sox’s opening match.

Though Rie is now the most popular and admired player in the league, she never once made the starting lineup during her high school days, spending every game on the bench. Determined to earn her spot, she trained relentlessly each day and even worked as a ball girl to study the techniques of other players. Despite her tireless efforts, she remained in obscurity until one day, the coach of the Purple Sox recognized her hidden potential and recruited her to the Purple Sox, despite opposition from others. With a training program tailored specifically for her, Rie's talent blossomed, and she went on to become the youngest player ever to win the most MVP titles in history. 

For this tournament, Rie pushed herself through a special training regimen. After finishing her regular team practices, she prepared for the summer heat by swinging her bat 10,000 times a day in front of a heater, practicing 1,000 fielding drills barehanded, and running 50 kilometers barefoot. She would end each grueling day with a meal of juicy premium steak and repeat the same routine again the next day. Watching her train with such intensity, her Purple Sox teammates couldn't help but shake their heads, calling her an "extreme training addict."

She was the little princess of Kanterbury. You'll meet her on Heavenhold after 10 years have passed. The little princess who used to dash around the Heavenhold now became an adult.

You, the Guardian took the adventure to the Rah Empire then never came back. It made the little princess anxious. She remembered leaving cheerful message to you when you called through the Rah Empire's payphone. You seemed fine to her back then. Whatever happened to you worried the princess. As she was very sure that the Emperor and the people of Rah Empire did some horrible stuff to you, Aisha arrived at the Heavenhold announcing the alliance between Rah Empire and Kanterbury Kingdom. Aisha and Shapira replied that they thought the Guardian already returned to Heavenhold.

The little princess couldn't possibly understand this sudden farewell. No one taught her that you have to accept the things you cannot understand. So the princess just waited and waited. Her knight always came back and greeted her first. There's no way her knight would have forgotten the duties they have promised to fulfill. The mischievous kids in Heavenhold bullied the princess telling her that 'Your knight ran away,' or 'Your sister and the Knight ran away cuz they hate you.' She drove those kids away, with such great vigor, and then got back to the Inn to shed the tears. The sound of her sorrow made even Loraine sad. Rumors spread among the champions. Some said you have died. Some said you have run away. Some said you were still fulfilling the duty as the Guardian. The princess trusted no one. Only the princess was confident that the astray Guardian would come back. The moment her long and the most strong conviction was shattered, the princess couldn't possibly handle the pain.

Princess' tears for the missing person slowly turned into tears of hatred over the years. There were so many tragedies that could have been prevented if you was there. Heavenhold now became the last line of defense for humanity. Friends struck down leaving only names and graves, and the enemies never gave chance to mourn their death. Princess is now a soldier protecting the remaining humans and also the leader of the Resistance to bring back the forsaken world. Through the training of Knight Captain Eva, the little princess grew up to be a resolute leader. Yet how tragic it is that her innocent smile is now replaced with such strictness and a little bit of fatigue.

Morrian is the governor of ‘Saul’, the city with the greatest military force in all of Demon World. A former soldier, Morrian’s cool-headed judgment and decisiveness is the reason why Saul, a city once ridden with corruption, was able to attain the greatest military. The instant Morrian became governor, she eradicated all of Saul’s corruption in just one day, as if she had been waiting for the chance. Implementing policies advantageous to Saul, she walked a different path than those of past governors. Thus, it wasn’t long before the people and soldiers of Saul became enthusiastic supporters of Morrian.

Morrian’s unparalleled efforts are what has made her a respected governor. Spending her time researching policy, assessing Saul’s state of affairs and commanding troops on top of her own personal training, there was not a single day that she wasted. Her demonstration of persistent effort and tenacity, even as governor, earned her the trust of the people and soldiers alike.

That's not to say she didn't have talent. When she was a military academy student, though she participated completely unprepared, she came out on top in a competition with the best cadets from each city, never to be dethroned. She even excelled in a personnel evaluation that was riddled with corruption on merit alone, setting a record for the youngest person to receive a special promotion. Diligent and talented, Morrian was a paragon and source of pride for all of Saul. She received recognition from all, and yet she never stopped striving for more.

Her obsession with being number one was fueled by the one person she could not beat, her half-sister Lilith. As the second daughter, Morrian was compared to her elder sister Lilith her whole life. From an early age, the two were forced to compete in various contests set up by their grandfather, the King of Saul. Morrian could never beat Lilith, not even once. She did everything she could to win, but the outcome remained the same. The constant defeats left Morrian with a great sense of inferiority, which became an insecurity, and caused her to become obsessed with Lilith. Since becoming governor, Morrian has issued a steady stream of criticism and accusations against Lilith, which Lilith did not respond to. Some claim it to be a subtle display of inferiority, but for the most part, it is brushed off as mere slander.

Chriselle is the manager of the Tetis Brilliant Park as well as a free-spirited weresquirrel.

Although her older brother is a world-class explorer, Chriselle leads a relatively uneventful life. She usually spent her time waiting tirelessly for Chris to return from his explorations, so she often went on small adventures to shake off her loneliness. However, she didn’t venture farther than the small forest in front of her home or the pond in her backyard, because she had to house-sit while her brother was away. But one day, Chriselle went missing. When Chris finally found her late that night, all she could remember was that she had gone a little farther than usual during her forest adventure. Since then, Chriselle started acting strangely, like she had sensed something was out of place, and she became jumpy around purple objects.
”The purple one, I’m pretty sure you’ve seen it before too."

The only thing Chris could do for his sick sister was stop by more often and share stories from his adventures. Chriselle usually seemed distant and didn’t appear to be listening, but her eyes would always light up at the mention of a certain "someone".
”Who, you ask? Tee hee, that's a secret!"

Sensing the change in his younger sister, Chris started preparing stories about that certain ‘someone’ to cheer her up. Sure enough, Chriselle made a remarkable recovery shortly after. Even so, believing she would never be able to go on adventures alone as she had before, Chriselle decided to gather the fantastical places from her brother’s stories and create a new world of her own. 
”And thus, a world of wonder was born! The Tetis Brilliant Park!"

Though she holds the title of manager, Chriselle’s management skills leave much to be desired. ”Excuse me?!" Actually, it’d be more accurate to say she doesn’t do any of the actual work. ”That’s not true!" Under the pretense of "inspection", Chriselle spends much of her time wandering the park, playing pranks on her staff and riding the attractions. ”Ugh… Now when did you find out and when exactly did you write all of this down?" She seems fond of acorns, but doesn’t like eating them, claiming they’re bitter and tasteless. She seems to enjoy peeling off the shells and playing with them. Rumor has it that she repurposes the leftover nuts as bullets…

Unrecorded World Pt. 2

Camilla is the 1st Corps Commander of the Invaders. As the former Queen of Kanterbury Kingdom, she succeeded Beatrix II in A.H.498. Though her whereabouts remained unknown ever since Kanterbury was invaded by the Invaders, it was revealed that she was engaged in the Invaders' 1st Corps, which invaded Demon World.

Camilla is recognized as a capable commander amongst the Invader commanders. When the Savior first appointed Camilla as the Commander of the 1st Corps, the other commanders were stunned to the point where their absolute faith in the Savior was shaken. However, through the operations entrusted to her, Camilla proved her competence as both a commander and a combatant. Especially during the Demon World assault, when the other commanders saw how she ‘acted as if she knew the future,’ they had no choice but to acknowledge her as one of their own. Being particularly aware of her abilities, the assistant commander was sent by the commander of the 4th Corps to monitor her. 

As a child, Camilla was known for her exceptional talents and was often referred to as the Hero Princess. She excelled in a variety of fields, but her skills in spearmanship and magic were unmatched. Beatrix II recruited distinguished tutors from all over the country for her, but it wasn’t long before she surpassed them all. All her tutors agreed that Camilla would have been the strongest warrior in all of Kanterbury’s history had she not been born of royal blood. Realizing the disparity in talent, even Captain Eva fell into a brief slump while teaching her.

Despite her exceptional talents, Camilla didn't have much affection for her life. Her strong sense of duty towards fulfilling the prophecy for the sake of humanity, created by her long education, made her numb to everything except the prophecy. Recreational activities, spearmanship and magic where she showed extraordinary talent, and even herself. However, everything began to change when she met Little Princess. It didn't take long for the cold Princess Camilla to become a warmhearted queen. Whether this change was because of Little Princess or because she realized that her fate could change, Camilla herself doesn’t even know. What is certain though is that the little princess became more precious to Camilla than her royal duties, and even her own fate.

Taki is the action leader of the werebeast organization, Tooth and Fang.

Tooth and Fang's top priority is to act for the happiness of all werebeasts, and Taki follows this goal more faithfully than anyone. While Rey and Toga are the leaders for werebeasts to follow, Taki is the friendly neighbor to werebeast families. If someone is in trouble, she appears faster than anyone to lend a helping hand without hesitation. Thanks to her frequent interactions with the families, Taki is known as the most well-connected member of Tooth and Fang.

Even as a child, Taki was fiercely proud; if she faced discrimination for being a werebeast, she would charge at anyone regardless of the danger. One day, she was severely injured after attacking an adult demon twice her size. That was when Rey and Toga appeared to protect her. Toga made the demons flee just with her nickname, 'Horn Hunter,' and Rey praised Taki for her guts. Since then, Taki has looked up to them, making it her goal to be recognized by Rey and Toga.

Taki loves hearing stories about the 'ancient homeland of the werebeasts' from her grandmother. Every time she heard about how beautiful it was before it was devastated, she felt a longing for a place she had never even visited. Later, after becoming the action leader of Tooth and Fang, Taki learned that the organization was originally a militant group that used extreme and violent methods to establish a werebeast-only nation. When she asked why they abandoned that goal, Rey and Toga avoided the question. Her curiosity remained unsatisfied, leaving only the goal of a 'werebeast-only nation' in her mind. This goal merged with her grandmother's stories, evolving into a dream to rebuild their homeland as the 'perfect home for werebeasts.'

When even the adults in Tooth and Fang could no longer keep up with her speed, Taki sought out a girl nicknamed 'Lightning Counter' and challenged her to a race. The problem was that they hadn't set a finish line; Taki just ran forward blindly, eventually losing the girl and getting lost. Sobbing in fear, she kept running and running until she eventually circled the entire Demon World and naturally ended up back in Demonshire. The adults had a hard time figuring out why Taki, who left in the morning and returned in the evening, was crying so much.

The adults had a hard time figuring out why Taki, who left in the morning and returned in the evening, was crying so much.

Lena is the Chief Scrivener of the Scriptorium, entrusted with the task of recording everything in the universe. 

Scriveners harness a force known as the power of stars, enabling them to objectively document the principles of all things in the world. Each family uniquely manifests this power—be it through writing, music, dance, or other means. At the heart of each family lies the Chief Scrivener, who leads and represents them. Lena, possessing a strong power of stars since childhood, was designated as the next Chief Scrivener regardless of her own will. The role of a scrivener is to record the world objectively, setting aside personal biases. As the appointed Chief Scrivener, Lena bore the weighty duty of documenting the world with utmost fairness.

From her earliest memories, Lena has been the Principal Scrivener. Her life has been solely dedicated to preparing for the role of Chief Scrivener. Her mother, the current Chief Scrivener, treated her only as the successor, leaving Lena devoid of ordinary parental love. As the years passed, Lena began to feel that her life lacked meaning, but no one was there to understand her because this was considered to be a natural part of the Chief Scrivener's role in the Scriptorium. Although Lena never considered abandoning her duties as Chief Scrivener, she could not stop longing for an ordinary life.

Despite her yearning for a normal life, Lena possessed the finest qualities required to become the Chief Scrivener, most notably her exceptional memory. As a child, Lena's urge to have a normal life led her to sneak out of class to play in the ocean. However, her poorly planned escape was soon discovered. As punishment, Lena was made to write a tearful letter of apology reflecting on her actions. To everyone's surprise, the letter was filled with astonishingly detailed and accurate accounts of her escapade. Ironically, this incident only served to solidify her position as the future Chief Scrivener.

The people of the Scriptorium were well aware that Lena was somewhat different from other Chief Scriveners. The quiet of the Scriptorium, once dominated only by the sound of turning pages, was broken by Lena's innocent voice ringing out, and everyone sensed that Lena would become a unique and special Chief Scrivener, unlike any before her.

Mikke is a Bakeneko with the aspiration of becoming a swordsman.

When Mikke visited a bounty office in the hopes of becoming a swordsman, the mercenaries there ridiculed her for her petite physique saying that she probably couldn’t even wield a sword. However, to avoid being exposed as a yokai, Mikke ignored their mockery and took on a simple delivery job as her first task. While she unexpectedly encountered a group of bandits on the job, she managed to defeat them all, sparking widespread attention and earning her the reputation as a remarkable kid.

Though Mikke always carries a sword called Chisui around her waist, since she never learned how to wield a sword, she usually relies on her physical abilities as a yokai to handle most situations. In demonstrating outstanding skills even without using such a good sword, rumors circulated that she might be the heir to a significant swordsman or exorcist clan. However, witnessing her occasional use of the sword as if it were a mere club, people shook their heads in disbelief.

While carrying out requests, there were times when Mikke came across other yokai, some of which recognized her true nature and attempted to recruit her. However, she refused as she longed to stay amongst humans. When requested to exorcise a yokai, she would sometimes secretly let them go depending on their circumstances but was unforgiving to those who harmed humans.

Mercenaries were curious about Mikke's pursuit of becoming a swordsman, especially since she was not driven by wealth or the desire to improve her skills. To that, Mikke explained that she had made a promise to live freely in this world without being burdened by any constraints.

Mikke, who has become somewhat of a mascot to the bounty office due to her erratic yet adorable habits stemming from her feline days, often treats herself to a grilled sweetfish at her favorite shop whenever she completes a request and gets paid. Mikke does this because in her memories from when she was a cat, money is something that is used as an exchange for grilled sweetfish. Although the shop owner himself was initially baffled to see Mikke bring an extravagant amount of money to order some grilled sweetfish, he now says he grills the best fish for her every time.

Eunha is a baby Dokkaebi with tremendous magical energy with great proficiency in shapeshifting.
 
Eunha was born under a red full moon. The elders were in awe and claimed she’d turn out to be the Dokkaebi king. The Dokkaebi king was the hero who led the Dokkaebi and founded their own nation in the past. The king had powerful magical energy that rivaled the sages, and had the strength to move mountains.  It’s said the Dokkaebi king had tremendous magical energy. For Dokkaebi, the amount of magical energy they have is determined at birth. Therefore, everyone had high expectations for Eunha becoming the next Dokkaebi king. This news spread across the Dokkaebi village, and even those that weren’t Dokkaebi started to take interest in Eunha.

At some point, evil spirits started to appear in the world of the living. They began stealing magical energy from magical beings and these instances began to happen quite often. It’s unknown why the evil spirits emerged in the world of the living, but there is a rumor that a certain entity is working behind the scenes. There was no way the evil spirits would let Eunha’s magical energy be. They tracked Eunha down and attacked the Dokkaebi village.

For the peace and joyful Dokkaebi disliking conflict, the evil spirits were too powerful. Eunha safely escaped the village because of her mother, but it was no easy feat losing the evil spirits chasing after her because of her vast magical energy. In the end, Eunha’s mother hid her daughter in the village’s alleyway. Then she promised her daughter she’d return before leaving Eunha. For months Eunha waited for her mother to return, and spent a long time being lonely. Eunha is deeply scarred from spending a long time in hiding and being alone from a young age. She’s cowardly and weary of dealing with others.

The gourd used by Eunha has been passed down for generations. It’s the shapeshifting Infinite Change. This magical item received great power from the sages long ago. Eunha’s vast magical energy allows her to wield the item better than any other Dokkaebi. While she’s using it, she can completely change her appearance and hide her great pool of magical energy as well.

Win Ling is Chun Ryeo’s first apprentice as well as a martial artist and pill refiner that had much influence in the establishment of the Shen Mountain Fist.

She was originally the successor of a pill refining family that could make a special pill with the ability to raise one’s level of martial arts. However, it was evident that her family would be targeted by both the Tiger Clan and the Viper Clan if its existence became known. So, her family kept their identity a secret and disclosed the existence of pill refinement to only a few of their most trusted family members. 

After inheriting the pill, which was made throughout several generations, and the knowledge on how to make it, Win Ling also lived as an ordinary apothecary. At the age of 23 though, she gets caught up in a big feud after someone seeking the martial arts treasure reveals her identity to the Viper Clan. However, in meeting someone in the midst of it, Win Ling not only escapes from danger but also begins a new life as a martial artist.

Like how she studied various medical texts and pill refinement methods, Win Ling also collected, compared, and studied various methods when it came to learning martial arts, and her excellence in learning martial arts allowed her to reach a high level of mastery. As time passed, the number of martial arts skills she mastered increased. She organized what she had learned and alongside Chun Ryeo, refined them into a single martial art, the ‘Shen Mountain Fist’.

Once Shen Mountain Fist was somewhat completed, Win Ling became concerned that its power may fall into the hands of someone unworthy. Thus, she wanted to make an empty scroll that would serve as a warning to miscreants who were only after the power of Shen Mountain Fist while teaching its true ways directly in person. This has much to do with the fact that she witnessed firsthand how if an 'unworthy person' obtains great power, they can destroy everything including themselves. 

Even after achieving great accomplishments, she, accompanied by her fluffy white rabbit, continues to devote all her efforts into studying martial arts while traveling with Chun Ryeo as they continue to train and help others.

Daisy is the baroness of Adela’s fortress city, as well as a girl gifted with incredible strength.

For generations, Daisy’s family has passed down a special power sealed within a brooch, and those chosen to inherit it gain strength beyond human comprehension, as well as the solemn duty to protect Adela. Since only one heir from each generation can receive this power, it was once a source of great pride, even sparking fights among potential candidates. But Daisy, born an only child and already chosen as the next successor, instead feared the idea of inheriting it, unlike those before her.

The day the Invaders attacked Adela, Daisy’s father, the baron at the time, defended the city with all his might. To Daisy, her father was a hero, the strongest man in the world who could not be defeated by anyone. But at the same time, he became a wall she could never surpass. Unlike others in her family, Daisy was timid and always ranked last in swordsmanship classes. She believed that she could never become like her father and slowly withdrew from the pressure. Her once-bright personality grew unsure, self-conscious and overly cautious.

Noticing her distress, her parents reassured her, saying she was already strong enough, but Daisy dismissed this, thinking they were just being supportive parents. In truth, they believed she was a suitable successor due to her gentle heart. They believed that her reluctance to hurt others, even by placing last in swordsmanship classes, was proof enough of her compassion and strength needed to protect the city and kingdom. Of course, it would be a long time before Daisy came to truly understand their sincerity.

After becoming baroness, Daisy faced an unexpected obstacle- a towering stack of paperwork, taller than she was. As someone who disliked studying and was still young, Daisy found the official documents, filled with difficult words, scarier than any monster. All her protests that she would give up the title if this was to be her job, were dismissed. But the princess took pity on her and ordered Anna to give Daisy special tutoring. Thanks to this, rumors have spread that the sound of crying echoes daily from the baroness' estate.

Karin once served as an officer of the criminal syndicate Reservoir Snakes, but now she wanders without a purpose.

Long ago, an elven elder coveted the throne of the Spirit King. To seize the spirit essence said to birth a Spirit King, he sparked a war—a madness that only ceased after half the Elven Forest burned. Even after the elder was purged, one problem remained: the fate of “Karin,” the sole survivor among the half-elf child soldiers he had created by illicit means.

In the end, the Forest Elves chose exile. They would not further stain their woods with the impure blood of a mixed being. Cast out, Karin left the forest alone. Adrift, she still held a small hope—that humans, and somewhere her mother, might accept her even if the elves would not.

Years later, Karin resurfaced in the underworld of the Kingdom of Adela. Whether she found her mother, or what she endured along the way, is unknown. What was known was the ruthless contract killer she’d become, unrecognizable from her past self. Recruited by Reservoir Snakes, Karin shared a long-harbored plan with the “Great Grandmother”: a scheme to annihilate both the Elven Forest and the Kingdom of Adela. It matched the syndicate’s grand design, and the operation moved swiftly.

But Karin’s vendetta ended in failure. Even after invoking the spirit power she had always denied, she was utterly defeated by Defender of the Forest Estel. Stripped of purpose once more, she wished never to open her eyes again as the building collapsed around her.

Yet, against that wish, Karin survived. She awoke beneath the gaze of a Desert Elf dressed like a sheriff and a half-elf who seemed to be her apprentice. The two took the unconscious Karin in and carried her to an unfamiliar desert. Afterward, Karin answered none of their questions and vanished without a trace.

Since then, rumors have drifted across the desert of madness about a “Wanderer”—a strange elf who cuts down outlaws and pursuers alike, clinging stubbornly to life. No one knows why Karin, having lost her purpose, keeps fighting to survive. All that is known is this: every night, she gazes up at a sky strewn with stars, lost in deep thought.

Angie, an angel driven by righteousness, once served as the captain of Heaven’s order of knights, the 'Guardians', and now holds the position of Secretary of the Heaven Treasury.

As captain, Angie was feared by her enemies and revered by her allies. She won countless battles to defend Heaven, and believed that protecting Heaven equated to justice. In every battle, she actively served as the vanguard on the front lines to prevent her allies from being sacrificed. Upon witnessing her valor, some gods referred to Angie as the 'Sword of Heaven.'

When Kaden and his comrades headed to Heaven to stop the flames of destruction, Angie joined them in their journey. Along the way, Angie met Plitvice, who was grappling with amnesia. Angie diligently assisted Plitvice until her memories returned. Even after her recovery, Angie continues to follow her, and Plitvice considers Angie to be the only angel she can rely on.

As the power of the World Tree faded and Heaven’s finances crumbled, Angie unexpectedly found herself taking on the role of Secretary of the Treasury. Despite her lack of expertise in finance, Angie, driven by her sense of duty from her days as captain, tirelessly worked to restore Heaven’s finances. However, passion alone wasn't enough, leading Angie to take on various jobs. After trying out all sorts of work, she eventually found herself working at a convenience store.

Although Angie excelled at challenging tasks despite adverse conditions, working at Gabriel's convenience store was no easy feat. The unthinkable amount of overtime and overwhelming workload ignited her desire to quit. But every time she felt this way, Gabriel would mention Plitvice, extinguishing Angie’s thoughts of resignation.

Fortunately, Angie's experience as a knight proved beneficial in her convenience store duties. Her impeccable display of triangular kimbap and milk, always perfectly aligned, amazed the customers, while her resilient and patient demeanor helped her endure the relentless complaints from demanding customers. After finishing another challenging day at work, Angie usually returns to her home and ends the day imagining the joy of breaking Plitvice’s seal.

Rimuru Tempest is the ruler of the Jura Tempest Federation and a member of Octagram, the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

Originally, Rimuru was an ordinary office worker living in Tokyo. However, after being stabbed and killed, Rimuru was reincarnated into the Central World. Realizing that he had been reborn as a slime with memories from his previous life, Rimuru successfully adapted to this new world with the help of his Unique Skill, ‘Great Sage.’

Rimuru’s ability to transform into a human form is thanks to ‘Shizu,’ who comes from the same hometown. Shizu, an otherworlder summoned by Demon Lord Leon, caused chaos in Rimuru's village after transforming into 'Ifrit,’ the Greater Elemental of Flame. Although Rimuru managed to regain Shizu by absorbing Ifrit, Shizu's remaining lifespan was short. Consequently, Shizu asked Rimuru to absorb her, enabling Rimuru to take on a human form.

While residing in the Great Jura Forest with the Goblins and the Direwolves, Rimuru resolved various incidents and became the chancellor of the forest. With the assistance of the diverse monsters living in the forest, Rimuru further developed the village. The Dwarf Kingdom, which had been keeping a close eye on Rimuru’s achievements, recognized the village as a nation and signed a treaty with them, establishing the 'Jura Tempest Federation.'

When Rimuru's comrades are killed in a raid by humans who are wary of the rapidly developing Jura Tempest Federation, Rimuru decides to become a Demon Lord to save them. After successfully becoming Demon Lord and evolving the Unique Skill 'Great Sage' into the Ultimate Skill 'Raphael,’ Rimuru resurrects his fallen comrades and is invited to 'Walpurgis' as a new Demon Lord. There, Rimuru confronts and kills Clayman, the true mastermind behind all the incidents, and officially becomes a member of Octagram.

As a food enthusiast, once Rimuru became capable of tasting food in human form, Rimuru contributed to the development of his nation's culture by introducing the food and festivity culture from his previous life. However, Rimuru continues to avoid Shion's cooking, even after she acquired the Unique Skill 'Master Chef.’

Natsume is an executive member of the Snow Blossom Clan, a ninja group led by Sumire.

After being saved by ninjas in the past, Natsume swore never to hesitate again. In the past, when a fire broke out in her village, Natsume tried to help but couldn’t bring herself to act, too afraid of the flames. Fortunately, Sumire and her ninjas were patrolling nearby. They charged into the blaze and saved the villagers, preventing any casualties. Watching them, Natsume felt both admiration for the ninjas and frustration with herself. She left her village, determined to train under Sumire and become a true ninja.

Natsume’s eagerness to act made her stand out, though not always in a good way. Rushing through tasks, she often made mistakes and was frequently scolded by senior ninjas. At one point, she even began doubting her decision. But Sumire encouraged her, saying that on missions, sometimes hesitation isn’t an option. This reassurance fueled Natsume to focus on decisiveness over caution, allowing her to complete more missions than anyone else. Though the mistakes didn’t vanish, she became remarkably quick at fixing them—especially when it came to repairing walls and fences damaged in the chaos.

Her dedication and results didn’t go unnoticed, and, despite her young age, Natsume was unanimously promoted to senior ninja. The applause on her promotion day was one of her happiest moments, sparking her desire to become someone everyone could admire. Still, her hasty nature and occasional slip-ups made her more of a friendly leader than an awe-inspiring one.

Despite clashing with Mikke, a cat yokai, over a series of mishaps, Natsume ultimately agrees to teach Mikke swordsmanship at Sumire’s request. However, the lessons proved challenging. Mikke would often perch in random spots or fall asleep whenever Natsume tried to read to her—a typical cat-like behavior that drove Natsume crazy. Eventually, Natsume stopped trying to keep up appearances, and her lively bickering with MIkke quickly became a source of amusement among the other ninjas. Whenever it was MIkke’s lesson time, they’d all gather to watch—supposedly to "observe" the training.

The AA from AA72 stands for Amusement Android. Unlike the standard MK series, this new android is specialized for entertainment and games.

The new AA android series was designed to feel a sense of accomplishment after performing their specialized functions and duties. This was done to improve the common personality traits androids have of not wanting to work. In AA72’s case, she’s loaded with a fireworks feature to decorate the summer vacation’s finale to entertain the user.

AA72 lost her will to live from not receiving any orders until summer arrived. Since AA72 was specialized for summer vacations, this was obvious. However, AA72 didn’t get a proper hand-off of her duties during her release. She mistook her absence of orders for her being useless. AA72 considered herself as trash and headed to the trash can at the beach near Heavenhold. That’s where she met Lifeguard Yuze. AA72 figured out her misunderstanding and learned about herself. Along with her newly formed memories, she also earned the name Stella. AA72 took a liking to her new name, and always adds her custom name Stella whenever she introduces herself.

Due to her trauma caused by concerns about being disposed of, AA72 gets anxious if she doesn’t get any orders. When she doesn’t get any orders, AA72 approaches her user with a hopeful look of receiving some while appealing her features. The other androids do not understand her. They feel envy towards AA72 getting to rest year-round after launching fireworks once. Mk.99, who’s particularly busy from battling, recently got caught changing her label to AA.99.

AA72 constantly searches for work to prove that she’s needed. She usually helps Yuze in protecting the beach or runs errands for Loraine. If it’s helping others, she usually accepts even if the request is slightly overbearing. She even accepts Sohee and Marianne’s request of being a subject for experiments. Thanks to Heavenhold’s residents’ reports and Loraine’s vigilant watch, the experiments were stopped. However, after the incident, Loraine became tired and halted all production of the AA series, claiming the Mk series is better.

Seira is a signal soldier for Kanterbury and a messenger of counterattack who fires off signals of hope amidst despair.

Before the Invader invasion, Seira was an ordinary signal soldier in the Kanterbury regular army. Learning from her reliable mentor, 'Kael,' and listening to the peaceful radio chatter was her simple daily routine and source of pride. However, on the day the Invaders attacked Kanterbury, that familiar life collapsed in an instant.

In the chaos of the battlefield, with communication networks paralyzed and indiscriminate bombing raining down, her unit and the refugees were cut off. In a moment of dire crisis, Kael pushed Seira to safety and dove alone into the center of the bombardment. He sounded the evacuation signal until the very end to save others, but when the dust settled, he never reappeared.

The sense of loss from losing the mentor she admired seemed to drive her into total darkness. Yet, instead of succumbing to misfortune or collapsing in grief, Seira gripped the broken radio he had left behind and asked herself:

'If there were someone like him to stay until the end and warn of danger, couldn't we prevent such terrible tragedies?'

The question she posed through her tears soon became the great mission that would guide the rest of her life.

"Someone must warn of the danger."

Since that day, Seira began to rush to wherever signs of bombing appeared to sound the alarm. Thanks to the urgent signals she sounded at the risk of her own life—just as her mentor had done for her—the survivors found the strength to take up arms and fight back against the Invaders.

Watching this, Seira realized something: battle is not just about wielding bayonets to strike down enemies. Saving lives and keeping hope alive is also the most powerful counterattack against the foe.

She can never change the painful past of losing her mentor. However, she can prevent others from losing their comrades and the precious people by their sides.

Today, Seira tunes the frequency of her worn-out radio amidst the flames of the battlefield. As long as she lives, Kanterbury's communication network will never fall silent.

Seira is a signal soldier for Kanterbury and a messenger of counterattack who fires off signals of hope amidst despair.

Before the Invader invasion, Seira was an ordinary signal soldier in the Kanterbury regular army. Learning from her reliable mentor, 'Kael,' and listening to the peaceful radio chatter was her simple daily routine and source of pride. However, on the day the Invaders attacked Kanterbury, that familiar life collapsed in an instant.

In the chaos of the battlefield, with communication networks paralyzed and indiscriminate bombing raining down, her unit and the refugees were cut off. In a moment of dire crisis, Kael pushed Seira to safety and dove alone into the center of the bombardment. He sounded the evacuation signal until the very end to save others, but when the dust settled, he never reappeared.

The sense of loss from losing the mentor she admired seemed to drive her into total darkness. Yet, instead of succumbing to misfortune or collapsing in grief, Seira gripped the broken radio he had left behind and asked herself:

'If there were someone like him to stay until the end and warn of danger, couldn't we prevent such terrible tragedies?'

The question she posed through her tears soon became the great mission that would guide the rest of her life.

"Someone must warn of the danger."

Since that day, Seira began to rush to wherever signs of bombing appeared to sound the alarm. Thanks to the urgent signals she sounded at the risk of her own life—just as her mentor had done for her—the survivors found the strength to take up arms and fight back against the Invaders.

Watching this, Seira realized something: battle is not just about wielding bayonets to strike down enemies. Saving lives and keeping hope alive is also the most powerful counterattack against the foe.

She can never change the painful past of losing her mentor. However, she can prevent others from losing their comrades and the precious people by their sides.

Today, Seira tunes the frequency of her worn-out radio amidst the flames of the battlefield. As long as she lives, Kanterbury's communication network will never fall silent.

Rachel, the beach racer who showed up by boat to take on the refreshing seas this summer!

She and the Guardian previously defeated the Graybeard Pirates and rescued a group of children, returning them back to their families. After that day, the children were so inspired by Rachel that they joined her on her adventures as part of her pirate crew. As they were about to declare their departure and set off to the seas, they realized they were missing the most important thing pirates need: a boat.

Rachel rushed to the shipyard to order a pirate ship with an impressive hull and a captivating crimson rose painted on it, but to the carpenters of the shipyard, the Crimson Rose Pirates had already been famously blacklisted. This is because while the boat she requested was the type of work any carpenter longed for, she wanted to pay for it using the treasure she was certain she’d find in the future.

In dire need of money, Rachel got a job as a duck pedal boat lifeguard. However, while working, she received a report from a customer saying that their boat had been seized by a strange man. Rachel immediately hopped onto a spare duck pedal boat and hurtled to the seized boat. Inside the swaying duck pedal boat, Rachel unexpectedly met Graybeard, her former captain. The Graybeard Pirates were trying to make a fresh start using the duck pedal boat after being brought down by Rachel’s betrayal. Now, once again, Rachel was blocking their path. Graybeard, unable to hold back his rage, charged towards Rachel’s duck pedal boat. Both boats capsized.

Rachel returned with the two broken duck pedal boats. Her boss burst into fiery anger over the two broken boats, but Rachel felt proud for catching Graybeard and the customers cheered her on. In the end, her boss had to settle up by giving her a boat, the thing she wanted most. While the boat they were able to procure in this manner was worn-out and shabby, it was more than enough to set the Crimson Rose Pirates sailing. 

Their goal is the Milkyway Race, which determines the best captain in Star Cluster Island! The epic story of the Crimson Rose Pirates on the high seas starts now!

Cornet is a rebel and the King of the Hill of Pixie Village.

Always perceived as the troublemaker of the village due to her rebellious nature, Cornet is treated as an airhead. She has been ignored her whole life for not having an innate skill like the other pixies. When Cornet realized that she couldn't overcome her fate through effort alone, she decided to go astray. However, being inherently good-natured, Cornet's idea of rebellion was merely scribbling graffiti on people's walls. Having a refreshing personality, Cornet is also popular among the children and takes on the role of their leader. Regardless, Cornet isn’t genuinely hated in the village. While she may seem pathetic, everyone knows she's not so bad as to commit any serious wrongdoing.

On the surface, Cornet appears confident, seemingly unaffected by any discrimination, but deep down, she harbors a certain insecurity. No matter how much the children praise her as their leader, she cannot shake the thought that she is just an airhead. After all, even those kids have at least some basic skill, being from Pixie village. Because of this, she often casually throws self-deprecating remarks. Even if someone tells her that she can do it, she quickly becomes pessimistic, thinking they're just mocking her.

Yet, there are moments when Cornet feels proud of herself. There was a time when a kid following Cornet disappeared in the forest. Even when everyone else gave up searching, Cornet didn’t. The moment she found her precious friend was not only a relief but also a confirmation of her own persistence. On that day, a small hope blossomed within Cornet, who had always doubted herself. She began to think, “'Maybe I can do it too...?'"

Cornet may be the village's oddball, but she values and wants to protect the village more than anyone else. She often detects and acts on problems that occasionally arise in the peaceful Pixie Village. The problem is that she does it without anyone knowing, so no one is thankful to Cornet. Despite appearing to be inept, when problems arise, she is the first to step up to protect what is precious to her, showing her loyalty.

The innuit girl who pushed aside her fears and awakened her power for the sake of her friends and herself.

Having inherited the ice witch's power, Coco got involved in a certain incident with the residents of Mt. Shivering who feared her. As a result, she left her hometown for good and arrived at Heavenhold. She received a warm welcome there and was no longer picked on or held in contempt for her power. Still, Coco continued to worry that she would one day lose control and go on a rampage like the ice witches before her. She was unable to completely feel at home even in Heavenhold for this reason.

After much thought, Coco decided to observe her predecessor, Ice Witch Lupina, to find the cause of the rampages. Lupina was delighted to hear that Coco wanted to learn about the power of the preceding ice witch. She agreed to teach her, but in return asked Coco to spread the word about whom she learned it from. Coco watched Lupina hunt and continuously asked about the reason behind her huntings but received no concrete answers.

Lupina, who caught on to the motive behind Coco’s incessant questioning, asked whether she was worried about the ice witch legend that those at Mt. Shivering spoke about. Lupina described all the efforts she made to keep up the legend, saying it wasn’t an accomplishment that could be made with just the Red Ice. The longer Lupina talked, the more Coco realized how different she was from Lupina, who had lived alone at Mt. Shivering for so long. After the talk, she came to understand how foolish it was to have been so worried since she had already left Mt. Shivering and was now living a life surrounded by friends.

Returning to Heavenhold, Coco no longer feared her own power and became more affectionate toward the residents. Some were taken aback by Coco’s changed attitude at first, but they soon became close enough to share jokes. Coco also visited Lupina from time to time so the ice witch wouldn’t feel lonely. It is said the residents of Mt. Shivering trembled in fear on these occasions, believing that if not hunting, the two ice witches must be doing something even worse.

Lucy is a world-renowned criminal who puts fear into even the wealthiest man with the most powerful security systems.

She is a master of disguise, escape, misdirection and magic. If you thought you caught a glimpse of her, she’ll vanish. The moment you think she’s in your grasp, you’ll be empty-handed. Lucy is a genius in any knowledge or skills related to crimes. She is naturally talented in magic, gymnastics, and athletics. She also has doctorates in Medicine, Security, Psychology, and Alchemy. Each degree she earned has a different name written on them, though. She's known as the princess of crime among criminals, and lots of them uses her name out of admiration.

She only commits crimes for the fun and thrill. Her crimes' patterns and their severity fluctuate depending on her mood. If you can see her and she’s almost within your grasp, that means she wants to play. When she’s not in the mood, you would pass by without even noticing her or her criminal act. Lucy’s favorite part of committing a crime is the thrill, excitement, and chaos happening during the chase. Apparently, a just hero tenaciously chasing after her gives her the most fun. Using her fantastic wordplay to cloud the hero’s judgment and playing mind games is also an added bonus. Of course, just because she had fun, that doesn't mean she'll return the stolen items or money.

There’s very little known about Lucy. No one knows her exact age, her past, even whether the name ‘Lucy’ is her real name. Some people suggest Lucy became a trickster because of her troubled youth or the corruption in society, but she merely laughs at all these analyses. ‘It’s a grave mistake to think something other than me created my identity,’ she claims. She’s just having fun!

Despite being a criminal for her enjoyment, Lucy’s not great at making jokes. She wants to deliver a fitting joke during the act but always ends up delivering the punch line in the wrong way. Even if she comes up with something clever, her delivery usually ruins it. Lucy’s feelings get very hurt when the tension dies down from her bad delivery of jokes.

Estel is a forest elf and defender who protects the forest and the Elemental Tree.

Forest elves are a race that live in the forest, coexisting with elementals and nature. Having formed a group of defenders with the mission to protect the Elemental Tree that provides vitality to the forest, they patrol the vast woods to defend it from external enemies. This closed-off situation sparked strong curiosity among humans and has even led to rumors of treasure hidden in the forest.

Estel, despite being the youngest among the defenders, is the most skilled in combat. With her exceptional senses, she can instantly detect the presence of distant enemies or read their breathing and pulse to understand their psychological state. Due to her immense confidence in her abilities, unlike other vigilant elves, she tends to be optimistic rather than overly cautious.

The Elemental Tree guarded by the forest elves contained the Elemental Essence, which bestowed power upon the chosen individual who had the potential to become the Elemental King. Then one day, the forest came under attack by a mysterious group intent on seizing the Elemental Essence. In the process, the Elemental Tree was destroyed, which caused the Essence to be scattered. Following the destruction of the tree, the vitality of the forest began to fade, plunging the elementals into chaos.

To revive the Elemental Tree,  the Elemental Essence was required. Through deliberation, the forest elves deemed Estel, the most skilled defender capable of locating the Essence, to be the most suitable candidate to retrieve it. Entrusted with this crucial mission, Estel embarks on a journey beyond the forest, with the support and prayers of her fellow forest elves.

Despite appearing flawless in every aspect, Estel has one flaw: she is irredeemably tone-deaf. Since elves communicate with nature through song, they all possess heavenly voices. But as for Estel, her rhythm, tempo, and pitch are all in disarray. Consequently, Estel never sang in front of other elves, leading her companions to believe she is just shy about communicating with nature.

V is a train conductor.

V is missing a part she was never born with: a brake.

As a child, V could never understand the point of homework assignments like writing a diary. No matter how it was explained to her, she would only tilt her head, wondering why one would bother writing down a yesterday that had already passed. Concepts like regret, or even nostalgia, were simply not in her vocabulary. People would often tell V that she needed to stop and look back once in a while, but her only response would be the most innocent question in the world: "Why look back when I could take another step forward?"

It wasn't a matter of conviction or resolve. V was just born that way. If the path is blocked, break through it. If it cannot be crossed, jump over it. There is always time to think after you've collided with something. Or rather, she doesn't really think about it even then.

Then one day, V saw a train racing along the tracks. A mass of steel that didn't linger on the stations it had passed, but raced only toward its next destination. In that moment, V was certain she had met her "kind" for the first time in her life. That she became a conductor was less a matter of destiny and more a matter of physics.

When the Invaders struck and Kanterbury was reduced to ruins, V's gaze did not waver in the slightest. If anything, her eyes sparkled more than ever. Obstacles on the tracks were meant to be smashed, and there were plenty of passengers to carry everywhere. The day the world stopped—that was when her true business, the one that never stops, began.

If someone were to ask V why she became a conductor, she would surely answer like this:

"Because I can just keep running forward!"
Money is more important than lives.

Kahlor is one of the Fire Dragon King’s avatars.

Even the benevolent Fire Dragon King Nidhogg had once been naive and immature. Her first avatar, Kahlor, who was born during that time, is a mischief-maker with a personality that is the perfect copy of that of young Nidhogg. Even though she suddenly found herself with a reckless younger sibling, Nidhogg deeply cared for Kahlor, who also thought of Nidhogg as an older sister. Kahlor is Nidhogg’s oldest avatar and she has been by Nidhogg’s side since before the sealing.

While they were twin-like in personality, time and destiny pushed their views apart. To protect everyone in Volver, the Fire Dragon King chose to seal herself. Kahlor, who cared for Nidhogg more than the other avatars, tried over and over to hold Nidhogg back from sealing herself. But there was no denying Nidhogg’s will to give up her freedom. Left behind, Kahlor visited the Sealed Chamber on the anniversary of that day every year, crying out Nidhogg's name like a small child. Even the carefree fire dragons didn’t dare to make a peep on that day.

She’s a hedonist who loves freedom. Fire dragons often have difficulty distinguishing between freedom and self-indulgence, and Kahlor is largely responsible for this. Because she puts her desires above all, she often causes incidents while trying to see them through. Once, she tore off the entire neighborhood of Muspelheim and relocated it on the volcano’s crater. While Kahlor laughed and called the fire dragons' houses that were floating in the lava ‘floating homes’, a sudden eruption from the crater sent lava surging out, destroying many of the homes.

She’s waiting for the Fire Dragon King to be liberated and find true freedom at Mount Volver. Ever since the day that she pledged to protect Volver on behalf of Nidhogg, Kahlor has sat on the empty throne, wiping the usual smile off her face and deepening her resolve. Still, every once in a while, when a worthy challenger appears, she can’t help but smile in anticipation, wondering if this one will be any different.

Kamael is the God of Harvest supervising the fauna and flora through the powers of the earth and life itself.

He is a god serving under Prometheia and performs the tasks of reviving the World Tree. Kamael was once a great wizard with powerful mana. He became a deity after being blessed with divine powers by Prometheia when she needed a lower god to manage the World Tree. Kamael’s current top priority is restoring the burnt World Tree. He will cut down anyone, human or deity threatening it.

Kamael is the founder of the mega corporation, Kamazon. Kamazon is an online shopping mall that receives orders and ships products using drones. It was founded to achieve Kamael’s goal to obtain the world’s greatest financial power. His business tactics are severely aggressive. He is infamous in the business for taking down his competitors and removing the thinking circuit of ‘An android can ignore an order it does not like’ on the ones he hired. Kamael’s been buying the ruins of the World Tree with the money he earned from Kamazon. It seemed Kamael searched for clues to restore the World Tree himself, but for some reason he completely halted all investigations. He built and opened a part of the ruins into the Kama-ZONE theme park. Kama-ZONE is famous for having numerous mystical artifacts and even now, groups conducting investigations within the closed off areas of Kama-ZONE are seen from time to time. After the investigation groups disappear, the area goes under maintenance and becomes a new area for Kama-ZONE. 

He may be a cold and infamous CEO of a mega corporation, but he’s warm hearted towards Bari and Mayreel. He considers the two disciples he lovingly raised like his own children, but his love rarely gets reciprocated like all other parents. Mayreel is especially annoyed of Kamael's attention and it often causes him to get a bit mopey. Despite worrying about Bari and Mayreel, Kamael always sends his two disciples on far away journeys. Whether it's to restore the World Tree, or to hide his life as a corporate man, is unknown.

Shapira, the dragon knight who wants to give Aisha the best vacation this summer!

This sweltering summer, all the troops including Shapira were given time off. However, Shapira had to stay behind in Heavenhold on guard duty. Shapira, who wanted to spend the vacation with Aisha, had no choice but to make the most of her remaining holiday. She devoted all her heart and effort into planning the perfect vacation for Aisha.

The following day, as soon as the next shift arrived, Shapira headed straight to the beach. Changing into a swimsuit, she excitedly stepped onto the beach, where she was reunited with Aisha. Contrary to her expectations that Aisha would be enjoying a relaxing vacation, Shapira found her carrying out a coastal survey in full military attire. As soon as Aisha saw Shapira, she began to discuss military strategies, leaving Shapira torn between the sudden tactical discussions and her vacation plans.

Before they knew it, the sunset had disappeared beyond the horizon, and Shapira hadn't even started to implement her vacation plans. When the discussions finally wound down, Aisha proposed they get dinner after cleaning up. Shapira arrived at the agreed-upon restaurant, her mood deflated, and shortly after, Aisha showed up in beachwear. Shapira, accustomed to seeing Aisha in nothing but military attire, was strangely moved.

They enjoyed a cozy meal without any interruptions, spending their time watching the beach. Deep down, Shapira blamed herself, believing that if she had been a more capable lieutenant, Aisha could have enjoyed her vacation more. Then, Aisha told Shapira, 'Short as it was, this was the best vacation of my life.' Upon hearing this, Shapira blushed, and they both quietly watched the waves as the crashes echoed across the beach. After their short vacation, while tidying her home office upon returning to Heavenhold, Shapira discovered that the note with her vacation plans had been included in the report she submitted to Aisha. Since then, Shapira could not bring herself to meet Aisha's gaze for several days.

Haruka is a middle schooler living a double life as a magical girl.

All around the world, young protectors rise to protect their cities. They are called magical girls—chosen ones who wield mysterious powers and fight the monsters that creep from the shadows. With strength beyond their years and bravery shining bright, magical girls became beloved icons and figures of admiration for countless young girls.

But Haruka was different. Her mother, Ayane, always said, "Standing out isn't a good thing. It's safest to be quiet and ordinary." She wanted her daughter to grow up unhurt, following a steady, secure path. And so Haruka did just that. The unintended side effect was a shy, forgettable personality, so invisible she once ended up playing "Tree No. 2" in her elementary school play. Haruka often thought, 'If life were a book, I'd just be one of the nameless extras.' The word "special" always felt distant, and magical girls belonged to a story that wasn't hers.

So when the familiar Shibarin appeared and told her she had the makings of a legendary magical girl, she was left speechless. Not just any magical girl, but to be one born with destiny flowing within her veins? She, who had no talents, no real friends, and nothing remarkable about her, could never imagine saving the world. Yet the more she compared her plain self to the shining image of a magical girl, the more a hidden yearning surfaced: a secret wish to be special. After a brief period of hesitation, Haruka finally signed the contract with Shibarin.

Even as a newly awakened magical girl, on the surface, her life appeared unchanged. She still dashed to school with a slice of toast in her mouth, still tripped on loose shoelaces, and still stumbled into class without catching anyone's attention. But in her quiet corner seat, Haruka listened with Shibarin at her side, stifling a smile as her classmates chattered excitedly about the mysterious new magical girl in town. Reminding herself, silently but firmly, of the mission she had chosen—her mission as a magical girl.

All around the world, young protectors rise to protect their cities. They are called magical girls—chosen ones who wield mysterious powers and fight the monsters that creep from the shadows. With strength beyond their years and bravery shining bright, magical girls became beloved icons and figures of admiration for countless young girls.

But Haruka was different. Her mother, Ayane, always said, "Standing out isn't a good thing. It's safest to be quiet and ordinary." She wanted her daughter to grow up unhurt, following a steady, secure path. And so Haruka did just that. The unintended side effect was a shy, forgettable personality, so invisible she once ended up playing "Tree No. 2" in her elementary school play.
