Saya is an exorcist swordswoman who travels and takes on various quests.

Born as the eldest daughter of a famous exorcist family, Saya was raised with high expectations to continue the family legacy. However, it was soon discovered that Saya possessed almost no spiritual power, which is essential for an exorcist. As news spread that her younger sister, Miya, was born with strong spiritual powers, people's attention shifted entirely to Miya. Miya quickly became the new heir of the family, and Saya was gradually pushed into the background and forgotten. Saya was often compared to Miya and became a topic of gossip.

Feeling like a burden without any spiritual power and worried she would hold back her sister, the future head of the family, Saya decided to run away from home. While living as a wanderer, Saya ventured into a forest to find food and was discovered by a yokai, putting her life in danger. Fortunately, an elderly swordswoman passing by slew the yokai in one swift move, saving her life. Impressed by how the swordswoman defeated the yokai using only a sword and no spiritual power, Saya begged her to teach her swordsmanship. Initially skeptical, the swordswoman soon recognized Saya's potential and took her as her apprentice. Although their training was brief, Saya managed to acquire significant sword skills. Before they parted ways, the swordswoman gifted Saya her earrings and returned to Demon World. 

Since then, Saya has traveled alone, taking on exorcism quests to help people. Recently, she has noticed increased activity from the large yokai organization "Dark Immortals" and has been investigating various leads to eradicate the threat.

Saya cares deeply for her only sister, Miya. Unlike the family members who ignored Saya when she was young, Miya was the only one who showed her affection with an innocent smile. Although Saya feels guilty for burdening her precious sister with a heavy responsibility, Miya, in reality, spends her days merely worrying from afar about how her older sister is doing.

Veronica is the Archpriestess of the Chosen One.

The Chosen Ones is a group of people with a belief that "the legendary Chosen One will give them salvation from all the torment of this land" - a new religion that came about since the Invaders started to attack mankind. Their fate and goal are to find the legendary Chosen One. Because no one knows who the Chosen One is, nor whether one actually exists, they believe that they must find Chosen One candidates who might yet not be aware of them being "Chosen One," and awaken their abilities as the Chosen One through the Chosen One trial. Nothing is known about the specifics of the trial for the Chosen One, yet it is told that no one has survived it so far.

On the outside, Veronica is a kind and naive leader who guides the people to faith and devotion with the pure religious faith of hers. So naive, that she would even approach an enemy ten times the size of her to preach to them. Yet when someone refuses to believe in the Chosen One, it becomes a whole different story. It is said that Veronica's eyes give off a gruesome sparkle when she compels the non-believers to kneel and repent. There is one other occasion when her eyes sparkle; that is when she encounters a Chosen One candidate. The details of the Trial is unknown, but no one has survived it so far.

Veronica's faith in the immaterial Chosen One well deserves to be called fanatical - her unconditional faith has attained great power in itself and transformed into holy power, after all. As the World Tree has been burnt away, there are few Gods left who can officially bestow holy power. Thus however powerful, Veronica's holy power is a dangerous gift with its doubtful origin. Yet to the believers, there's no stronger living proof of the Chosen One. Veronica uses this 'Holy Power bestowed by the Chosen One' to propagate to the whole world, convert the non-believers, and arrest those who have escaped the cult. Recently, reports of a new Chosen One Candidate, the Guardian Knight, engrosses her attention.

Kanna is a rare white tiger anthromorph among the already rare tiger anthromorphs. Tiger anthromorphs are born in their tiger form. When they begin to realize their abilities, they can change freely between their tiger and human forms at will. Kanna also had a hard time changing into her human form at first, but she can now change freely from practicing. She can even transform only certain body parts as well. Kanna usually stays as a tiger, but she fell in love with using human objects after coming to Heavenhold. Now she stays in her human form instead. 

She’s Kang’s older sister, and loves her little brother very much. There are only a few Tiger anthromorphs, and they have strong family bonds. However, Kanna’s love for Kang is quite eccentric even for the rare white tiger anthromorphs. Kanna taught her little brother how to take his first steps and guided him on his first hunt. She came to Heavenhold because Kang had followed the Knight there first. She’s always watching Kang from a distance, but rarely intervenes. She believes personal growth can only be achieved by overcoming threats. 

Kanna calls herself an exceptional Druid, but everyone else seems to think differently. Everyone rather believes the title of ‘Super Anthromorph’ is more fitting because of her amazing grip strength. She loves animals and plants. Despite Kanna’s love, all the animals are afraid of her and the plants she raises end up wilting. Kanna severely injured a cute puppy by accident from petting it. After the incident, she claims she can only watch the cute and lovely animals from afar and does so. Kanna still calls herself a ‘Druid’ because of her ability to tame predators. No matter how ferocious, a loving and ‘powerful’ embrace from Kanna turns them into gentle lambs. Everyone can tell Kanna’s strength is what definitely makes the predators submit. But no one has objected to Kanna’s claim that she's a Druid because she can transform freely from beast and human form and tame predators.

Lacrima is one of the Avatars of the Flame Dragon King.

In the past, Nidhogg struggled with his own fiery temperament. At peace summits involving numerous dragons, his temper would often flare up, causing the negotiations to collapse. Because of his behavior, the Flame Dragons became known as a race that was always hot-headed and impossible to reason with. Nidhogg eventually sought a being who could correct these flaws in himself.

Thus, Lacrima was born as an Avatar to fill the void within Nidhogg. In stark contrast to Nidhogg's fiery nature, she was always calm and composed. She governed all her actions by set principles, judging right from wrong through sound reasoning and established rules. On the day when all of Mount Volver was plunged into sorrow over the loss of their idol, Lacrima could not afford to indulge in grief even as the Flame Dragon King Nidhogg was being sealed. Believing that the collapse of order following the disappearance of the volcano's pinnacle would betray Nidhogg's will, she established even stricter regulations.

After surviving the crisis of extinction, Nidhogg was released from his seal and abolished numerous treaties and regulations for the sake of everyone on Mount Volver who had been burdened by them. While everyone else rejoiced, Lacrima alone was deeply shocked. For Lacrima, who had lived every moment based on principles, this was a fundamental shaking of her values. In a world without rules, she found herself speechless. Countless legal codes and ancient texts taught her how to uphold principles, but none taught her how to live in a world where they no longer existed.

Leaving the happy crowds behind, she went to the library and came across a picture book titled "The Flower That Always Smiles." The story told of how other flowers gathered around a smiling flower to create a garden, while an angry flower was left all alone. Perhaps inspired by this, Lacrima set out for the plaza to meet people for the first time without any prior appointment or agenda.

Maam is Hero Avan’s second student, and a Martial Artist with superhuman strength.

She was born under a Warrior father and a Monk mother and got both talents from her parents. While Maam was a Monk, she couldn’t use attack spells. After meeting Master Avan, she obtains the Magic Bullet Gun from him. Maam was hesitant at first, using a powerful weapon like the Magic Bullet Gun. However, she was deeply inspired by Master Avan’s words ‘Just as strength without justice is powerless, so too is justice without strength’. Maam surpassed using healing and support spells and can now use attacking spells using the Magic Bullet Gun. Later, Maam comes up with her motto of ‘One can’t protect others with only love and kindness’. She trained continuously and yearned for power. As a result, she got the strength to protect her own village, and graduated from Avan's lessons to become a disciple of Avan. 

After hearing about Avan’s death, she wanted to avenge her master, but couldn’t leave because of her duty to protect the village. However, thanks to encouragement from her mother and the rest of the villagers, Maam decides to leave the village, so she can carry on Avan’s will, and avenge him. Afterwards, she officially becomes a companion for Dai and Popp.

During their adventure, the Magic Bullet Gun ends up breaking. After much consideration, Maam decides to become a Martial Artist by using her new weapon, the powers she got from her father, instead of the Magic Bullet Gun. Later she seeks out the God of Martial Arts Brokeena, and becomes a true Martial Artist through limit breaking training. 

She has a confident personality and is usually seen as being headstrong. However, she has a kind heart and cares about her companions more than anyone. Maam will offer her kindness to those with emotional scars, even if it’s an enemy. Even when Hyunckel attacked Maam and her companions to avenge his father, she heard him out. Then Maam convinced Hyunckel to return as a disciple of Avan.

Dabin is a novice heavenly maiden who carries a large coffer on her back.

Though her skills are not extraordinary, she never gives up due to her characteristic perseverance. Heavenly maidens, following the will of the sages, defeat yokai that disturb the world and save sentient beings. On these lines, Dabin has completed all of her missions flawlessly. Senior heavenly maidens, who were suspicious of her impressive achievements for a novice, once secretly monitored her. However, they withdrew their suspicions after witnessing Dabin climb a mountain for two days straight just to find a child's lost dog. Since then, the senior heavenly maidens have placed their full trust in Dabin, granting her more freedom despite her novice status.

To assist the sages, heavenly maidens use various tools. Among them, Dabin is particularly fond of a large cannon called Heavenly Cannon. Dabin was fascinated by the earth-shaking explosive sound and tremendous destructive power of the cannon. It's said that when firing it, she would become noticeably excited as if she had turned into a different person. Although Dabin carries all necessary equipment in her magically expanded coffer to be ready to use the cannon at any time, due to its great power, she has never been permitted to use it in real combat. As a result, she often consoles herself after missions by eating the snacks she hides in a corner of her coffer.

One day, Dabin unknowingly encountered the Sea Witch, a dangerous entity previously sealed away by the sages. When the heavenly maidens later discovered this, they panicked, realizing the urgent need to track down the Sea Witch. As the only one who had seen the Sea Witch's face, Dabin is now pursuing her. However, with all the suspicious activities the yokai have been orchestrating lately, finding the Sea Witch has become even more difficult. Nevertheless, Dabin continues her pursuit, hoping that another encounter with the Sea Witch will give her the chance to freely use her beloved cannon.

Mk.99 is the only surviving combat android unit at Heavenhold ever since they were mostly disposed of.

Combat androids were designed to support the Heroes defending Heavenhold. They can instantly exhaust their remaining power to commence heavy artillery strikes against the enemy. They are capable of free-flight but tend to avoid it at other locations except for Heavenhold to conserve power. Even their self-charging units can't meet the power demand. They have the least restrictions on their behavioral software, which enables them to make active decisions compared to worker androids. 

After Mk.2, one of the combat android units deployed by Heavenhold in the past, became corrupt and threatened Heavenhold’s safety, Android Association decided to dispose of all units and also stop the production. Mk.99, the youngest and the lowest rank among her fellow combat androids, was considered a ‘B-tier’ unit and became excluded from disposal. The Android Association finally woke her up from her long slumber after judging they can’t defend Heavenhold with just the Heros. Mk.99 may not be up to the specs of the combat androids from the past, but she is definitely the only one left. 

When Mk.99 was awakened, all Heavenhold’s androids were programmed with the Three Laws of Androids to prevent another Mk.2 fiasco.
-First, an android may not harm Heavenhold or, through inaction, allow it to come to harm. 
-Second, an android may ignore orders except where such orders would conflict with the First Law.
-Third, an android must protect the owner of the Champion’s Sword as long as such protection does not conflict with the First or Second Law.
Android Association expected the Second Law to give individuality to each android, but somehow they all ended up with 'lazy and dodging work as much as possible' personalities. Mk.99 was famous among androids for having the easiest job because she did not have to wake up at all until Heavenhold’s emergency protocol level 9 was in effect.

Girgas, a reckless young dragon with no interest in White Day!

Ever since he arrived in the human world, Girgas has had no worries aside from finding the Dispel herb. That is, until Valentine’s Day, when he encountered an unexpected dilemma. He had received an overwhelming amount of chocolates from Ameris. He was used to Ameris looking after him, but this time, something felt different. Her strangely flushed face, the way her gaze constantly avoided his, even the strange chocolates that didn’t suit his tastes. It wasn’t like her at all. Seeing her act differently than usual, Girgas came to an absurd conclusion. That Ameris must’ve been cursed.

On White Day, Girgas was still on the hunt for the Dispel herb when he caught wind of a so-called ‘magic candy’ and set out to find it. <Longevity, good health, successful confession of love, magical girl transformation, dispel effects… etc.> His eyes sparkled at its incredible effects. However, upon setting sight on the candy’s ludicrous price tag, Girgas started causing an uproar, declaring that a great fire dragon shouldn’t have to pay a human money for a purchase. In the commotion, the box holding the magic candy was burned up, but Girgas managed to secretly snag a piece before leaving.

Girgas was giddy at the thought of finally being able to break the transformation magic. But just as he was about to eat the candy, he hesitated, thinking of Ameris, who was still under a curse. Unable to ignore Ameris after she constantly took care of him, Girgas decided to give up the magic candy and give it to her instead. 

Of course, Ameris knew full well that it was just an ordinary piece of candy with no dispel effects, and that this was no White Day gift, but she was still deeply moved that Girgas had thought of her. Meanwhile, as Girgas watched Ameris perk up at the candy, he became convinced that the candy must have some truly powerful effects and slightly regretted not eating it himself.

Sohee! The super-popular scientist, hitting the beaches this summer!

Sohee never forgot the taste of popularity she briefly enjoyed during her infiltration to Kanterbury high school for the Invader crystal investigation. So she went through a complete makeover based on her research on ‘popular women of the summer season’ to achieve it once again. She pushed ahead with her weight loss using her new diet machine involving electrical shock and rapid cooling. A fashionable swimsuit and custom-made contact lenses all set, which helped her lose the glasses, and now she's ready to bewitch all those on the beach! Her extremely well-working dieting machine continues to be denied a patent under safety issues, though.

She used her ‘try until you succeed’ stubbornness and learned how to surf despite her nearly non-existent athletic skills. Sohee is no longer a scientist cooped up in her room doing research and lacking vitamin D, but a strong and powerful one who can wield her modded Magiton Buster surfboard freely. Why would she swing her surfboard around on the beach, nobody knows. Sohee’s surfboard is equipped with a Magiton pack, and it quite frequently creates huge waves out of nowhere causing other surfers to wipe out. 

Sohee goes out to the beach to show off her makeover only to cause trouble. Ever since Sohee started going around so proudly, more people have been getting injured on the beach. Causes of injuries include: trying to hit on Sohee and getting beaten, being hit by her surfboard while taking a leisurely stroll on the beach, getting swept up by the waves while out surfing nearby, etc. Thanks to her, there are never enough lifeguards around at the beach. Whether Sohee achieved the popularity she wanted so much is unknown, because everyone is usually busy running away from her. Sohee herself seems to be very content with her makeover, so everything is fine except for those who get hurt while hanging around her.

Loraine, the innkeeper who’ll gift everyone unforgettable memories this summer!

She works without rest and always greets adventurers with a mysterious smile. Loraine never shows it, but even she wants to take a break without having a worry in the world. There just wasn’t any available time for her. 

Loraine finally decided to go on vacation she’d been putting off for years, and she built an amusement android that only existed in a blueprint for the first time. That’s how a specialized android AA72, different from the MK series tasked with battle or housework came to be. Loraine was so touched from how the AA series would actively search out tasks. She ordered a specially made swimsuit from Kamazon for it to wear.

When AA72 disappeared on the beach, Loraine lost her usual composure and became quite flustered. An android running away was unprecedented. On top of that, a cooling device, which was AA72’s major component, had gotten loose. She immediately sent androids to search the beach, and even asked for help from the lifeguard. Loraine didn’t expect the lifeguard would run away with AA72.

After she returned to Heavenhold from vacation, Loraine first established a duty hand-off procedure for androids. Various improvements in different fields, such as enhanced hand-off procedures, additional monitoring systems, and duty confirmation systems were added to prevent similar incidents from occurring. Some androids complained about how their vacation made more troublesome tasks, but all of them fell silent after they had a meeting with Loraine.

This year’s ‘Summer Focus’ picked Loraine as ‘The top hottest trending woman’. Sohee caused a scene asking why she wasn’t picked for 1st place while Loraine said such rankings are meaningless. According to a testimony from a maid android, she found a mysterious album in Loraine’s room. The Focus special article about Loraine is preciously placed within the album.

Mk.2 is an ex-Heavenhold combat android. She’s gained her freedom and now has no master.

Mk.2 leads the infamous android crime gang, ‘Turing’. She gathered abandoned androids in Demon World and formed the gang. She committed numerous crimes and hurt many for the excuse of 'just following orders' to be valid. However, she was freed from her previous master manipulating her through control codes, and became her own self. It seems she left her life of crime behind after being freed. Mk.2 got rid of her stuffy suit and neat hair. She now looks happier and freer than ever, as she rides her bike down the night streets with her gang. 

A long time ago, Mk.2 was a combat android of Heavenhold. She opposed the engineers' unethical attitude of indiscriminately disposing of androids. Heavenhold’s technology at the time was so advanced that it was more efficient to build a new android instead of fixing a broken one. Mk.2 awakened the disposed androids to incite a rebellion, but it was subdued through an intense battle.
She barely escaped Heavenhold alone, and took refuge in Demon World. After this incident, the engineers of Heavenhold added another rule to the Laws of Androids which frees androids to ignore certain orders as their will in order to improve the android disposal process.

After she arrived in Demon World, Mk.2 briefly worked as an aid for the police department’s detective Odile. Odile’s colleagues simply considered Mk.2 as a tool to be used in dangerous situations. They even once lured Mk.2 upto the roof of a high building for an 'important mission' and pushed her off as a durability test. From this incident Mk.2 had to replace 31 parts in her body. Odile advised her claiming “the responsibility falls to one being fooled for such an obvious trick” to teach her a lesson, but Mk.2 harbored deep resentment from Odile’s advice instead. Even as a freed android, Mk.2 still holds deep hatred towards Odile.

Ameris, the girl determined to express her feelings with sweet chocolates!

During her brief time studying abroad at a magic school with Girgas, Ameris was introduced to the many facets of human culture. Among them, the one that left the deepest impression on her was Valentine’s Day. She watched countless girls confess their feelings to their crushes with heartfelt gifts of chocolate and couldn’t help but think of Girgas. Yet, burdened by her long-standing, unrequited love and Girgas’s utter obliviousness, she never dared to imagine confessing her feelings. To her, Valentine's Day was simply something to observe from afar—something she believed had nothing to do with her.

But as this year's Valentine's Day approached, Girgas made an unexpected comment. He had heard rumors about some delicious chocolates being sold in Kamazon and wanted to try them. This threw Ameris into a whirlwind of emotions. Could Girgas be hinting that he wanted chocolates for Valentine’s Day? Or was he even hoping for a confession? Encouraged by this, Ameris decided to muster her courage and convey her true feelings through chocolates.

When Ameris visited Kamazon to buy chocolates, however, she was disappointed by the small, unimpressive box of chocolates she found. Doubting whether something so insignificant could truly convey her feelings, Ameris expressed her concern to the vendor. The vendor reassured her that what mattered most was the size of her heart, not the size of the gift. However, misunderstanding this advice, Ameris concluded that she needed to give Girgas an enormous amount of chocolate to match the size of her feelings. Determined, she decided to buy every single chocolate in Kamazon as a gift for Girgas.

As a result, Ameris gifted Girgas all the chocolates Kamazon had to offer, including bizarre creations like "Slime Chocolate" and "Mace of Stench Chocolate," forcing Girgas to endure quite the ordeal tasting them all.

Popp is Hero Avan’s third student and an excellent mage.

He received mage training as Avan’s student. Popp was born the son of an arms merchant in a small village called Lankarks. But upon feeling a sense of admiration towards Hero Avan who visited the village one day, Popp leaves his hometown immediately to become Avan’s student.

Popp began to gain courage after meeting companions. Before, Popp would usually avoid hard training and fights. However, seeing his companions Maam and Dai fight against the Dark Army, he also came to pluck up his courage. Popp, who wanted to become stronger, thereafter receives hard training from Matoriv, a former member of Avan’s party. He learns powerful magic and grows to the next level as a mage. One example is the Extreme Annihilation Spell, Medroa, which is an arrow-shaped form of magic that can wipe out an entire area.

He has a secret crush on Maam. Popp first met Maam in a forest after embarking on a journey from Dermline Island with Dai. He quarrels with Maam at first, but later falls in love with her kind and righteous heart. Though Popp tried to confess his feelings to Maam before she left to train as a martial artist, he fails. And after finding out that Maam likes Hyunckel, he becomes worried about their relationship and hides his feelings.

Popp, who admired heroes but was a coward himself, grew to gain almost as much courage as Hero Avan by overcoming numerous hardships while journeying with Dai. He usually behaves like a jokester, but in dire times he is shown to be serious and courageous. There was a time when they faced a crisis as the Dark Army continued to attack while Dai was in a state of memory loss. At this time, Popp used Megante, a self-sacrificing spell that turns all life energy into attack power, to protect his companions. Even the enemies saluted him seeing how he continued to use spells to save Dai even after losing consciousness due to Megante.

Eleanor is one of the supreme heavenly deities who used to supervise the world. 

She’s the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Eleanor is fated to earn money even if she stays idle. Her fate allowed her to become a root-like figure in Heaven’s financial matters, but it also caused Heaven's finance to be irreparably damaged the moment Eleanor left Heaven after the World Tree lost its power. Heaven still hasn’t overcome this recession, and Angie the angel, who happened to be appointed as the Secretary of the Heaven Treasury, is hard at work to pay off Heaven’s debt. But Eleanor herself is not aware and unwilling to aid in Heaven’s financial matters. 

She’s also the goddess of art with refined tastes. Eleanor enjoys epic poetry, classical music and is also a skilled harp player. Melodies from her harp are told to soothe the hearts of warriors. The only issue is that warriors who hear her music become too drunk on her melodies and lower their guards too much. Her favorite events are concerts where she’s the main performer. She doesn’t consider an event unless the stage design, lights, and outfits of every performer are top quality. 

Eleanor is an indecisive loafer who wants to just spend her money lounging around and not deal with any important matters. Eleanor does not or want to think deeply about any serious issues. She can just ignore them. Thanks to this, she easily obeys and adjusts to any environment. According to her, change requires difficult work with a low chance of success, and most of all irritating. It's told that Eleanor did have hopes and dreams about leading the world in a better direction as a supreme goddess from Heaven and worked towards her goals. But, repeated failures made her give up slowly as time progressed. Now, Eleanor only focuses on matters that don’t require focus or any work and runs away from important matters or problems in disgust.

Odile is a private investigator who runs a PI office in Demon World.

Formerly a detective at the Demon World Police Department, she used to be a role model for her fellow officers for her excellent focus and ability to find evidence. She was even awarded a certificate of commendation by the central government for dramatically increasing crime arrest rates.

After leaving the police force and temporarily living a life of debauchery, Odile set out to pursue a new career. After much deliberation, she decided to become a private investigator where she could utilize her investigative skills. Odile spent all her money to set up a small office and began searching for a partner to work with. That is when she meets ‘Gremory’ again by chance, a five-time convicted felon whom she once met at the police department. Although Gremory was an ex-convict, Odile remembered how helpful Gremory was with her investigations and offered her the chance to become partners. Gremory willingly accepted under the condition that Odile funds her research. They later named the office "O&G PI Office" after their initials.

However, the PI business wasn’t as smooth sailing as they had hoped. While they had a steady stream of work, they were mostly errands like finding missing pet monsters or searching for evidence of affairs. This was hardly enough for Odile, who wanted to take on bigger cases. On top of that, between office rent and covering the cost of repairing the vandalism caused by Gremory's research, Odile was always short of funds. Thus, Odile often goes on business trips to places even outside of Demon World.

Though Odile is constantly tired from non-stop work, she feels rewarded when she sees how happy people are after their case is solved and when they thank her for it. Whether it's a major or minor request, she always takes on a great deal of responsibility to help people solve their problems.

Callie is the marquee star of the La Ventura arena.

In the deep-sea city of La Ventura, there are plenty of attractions, but none compare to the arena. The arena’s battles, where both blood and sweat are shed, offer an unparalleled spectacle and have become the signature tourist attraction of La Ventura, which draws people solely for that thrilling event. As the face of the arena, Callie is extremely popular thanks to her exceptional fighting skills, dazzling looks and showmanship.

Callie’s life before her wrestling career remains a mystery, even to Callie herself. Her earliest memory is waking up alone in a dark, abandoned ruin. It was thanks to the village elder of the slums who first discovered her 5 years ago that she was able to step out into the world. Even after leaving the ruins, Callie’s life has been anything but easy. To someone with no memories or knowledge, life in the slums, where failing to pull your weight meant going hungry, was an unforgiving environment. Callie wouldn’t be here today without the people of the village, who helped her become a valued member of the slums.

To her, the people in the slums are as good as family. In the same way they helped her, she has always believed that it's her duty to be of help to them. Even as a marquee star who earns vast sums of fight money with every fight, Callie still lives in the slums and devotes most of her earnings to supporting her community. She remains there because it's more than home, and because she wants to protect her family.

In the city, Callie’s level of fame is unmatched, even by most celebrities. Her die-hard fans even try to mimic her every move. However, there’s one thing that even they have given up on: her taste in food. Callie’s favorite dish is a triple cheeseburger, always ordered with no pickles and extra cheese. Most people can't even finish a bite because of how greasy it is.

Alef is an alchemist who makes golems out of woods. 

An aesthetic who covets beauty. Though it's not quite easy for other people to understand, he has his own sets of "philosophies" on appreciation of beauty. Not only does he appreciate the outer beauty but he also recognizes the inner beauty that's "reflected on" one's looks. He has his own "Lady Radar" and believes one that is ugly on the inside cannot make the radar ring, however beautiful on the outside. When he finds "the real beauty," he willingly becomes a loyal servant of it. 

Though he looks like a child, he's actually 38 years old. He made a potion to make him younger because some women didn't care for older men. Yet he accidentally made the potion too strong, and turned himself into a child. It's not impossible to turn him back, but he chose to live on as he is, after seeing women become less cautious with him. 

His full name he used back at home was Alefiod. He was the smart one in the prestigious alchemist family, but he always made some trouble with his laziness and fondness for women. His talents had been wasted on creating a gem as a gift for a neighborhood sweetheart, or creating a golem to do all his chores, and such. When a war broke out with a neighboring country, he created the ultimate golem out of birch woods at the request of the royal family and successfully protected the country. Thinking golem's powers as an opportunity, the royals tried to start another war. He persistently refused to use his golem for war and was eventually exiled eternally. After leaving his country, he vowed to start a new life and named himself Alef.

Anna is an intelligence agent of Adela Kingdom and a secret agent in the royal special division known as NEST.

Born into a military family, Anna joined the army to follow in the footsteps of her parents, who died in an accident. Throughout various operations, she demonstrated exceptional tactical abilities, earning recognition and eventually a place in the intelligence division. While serving as an intelligence agent, Anna accidentally discovered that her parents did not die in an accident but during a covert mission. Determined to uncover the truth, she investigated further, only to be suspended by the intelligence division. Thinking the kingdom intentionally covered up her parents' death, she became devastated.

The one who came to her in this state was none other than the newly crowned princess. The princess revealed the truth that Anna's parents had been forced into a reckless and dangerous operation by the nobility. She then shared her plan to dismantle the corrupt noble factions and invited Anna to become a secret agent for NEST. Anna was given the codename "Osprey," symbolizing her swift and lethal ability to eliminate threats lurking beneath the surface, just as an osprey swiftly hunts fish underwater.

Now serving as the princess's deadly weapon, Anna carries out missions to eliminate anything that could bring chaos to the kingdom. Never failing a mission and leaving no evidence behind, NEST remains so elusive that certain nobles in Adela Kingdom doubt their reality, questioning if such a group could be real.

Though years of military service and covert operations have made her extremely quiet, Anna flawlessly performs any role during undercover missions. During one such mission in Burywood, she disguised herself as the cheerful manager of movie star Eugene, to the point where even the lively Eugene struggled to keep up with Anna's energy and tried to avoid her.

Serena is a middle school student who moonlights as a magical girl.

All magical girls lead double lives, hiding their identities to act as students by day and magical girls by night. While many admired magical girls are merely introverted students during the day, Serena, who operates as Near Black, is different. Excelling in both academics and sports, and possessing striking beauty, Serena is the object of admiration for many schoolgirls at all hours of the day and night.

While the primary goal of a magical girl is to protect world peace by eliminating yokai, each holds slightly different values. Some seek peace through moderate means, but the path chosen by Near Black was to possess power greater than anyone else. She believes that becoming the strongest magical girl to eliminate yokai is true justice, and she is convinced that overwhelming strength can solve everything, even if it requires minor sacrifices.

Serena's determination to become the strongest magical girl stems from memories of her frail childhood. Unlike now, she was once alienated by her peers and even neglected by her parents due to the burden of her medical expenses. The fear that her weak self was useless and could be discarded at any time led her to develop an abnormal obsession with power, creating her own rule that only the strongest magical girl is the truth.

Though Serena always maintains a cool and elegant demeanor—whether as a student or a magical girl—she has an unexpected hobby: collecting magical girl merch. As a secret, die-hard fan of the legendary magical girl from the previous generation, Rainbow Twinkle, she frequently buys vintage merch through second-hand markets. She even loves Rainbow Twinkle more than herself; once, when a seller remarked that Rainbow Twinkle was a has-been and that Near Black was the new trend, she held a grudge and left a malicious review on the transaction.

Miya is an exorcist who fights evil spirits with her dutiful souls.

She was born in a distinguished exorcist family, with a destiny to eradicate the foul and make the world a purer place with her innate spiritual powers. She can see things that are not visible to other people. Either by gently soothing them, or by conducting an exorcism, she leads the lost spirits to heaven. Though she has to constantly face the dark, she never loses her high spirit and kindness. She is affable to everybody, and willingly helps those who suffer from the evil deeds of demons and spirits.

Yet she has an issue, which is that she is very addicted to entertainment, especially to the festivals and gambling. Miya's family had the custom to hold a festival after a successful exorcism. It was to please the living, comfort the dead and to give a proper conclusion to everyone, so the elders said. Miya used to love these festivals. Perhaps a bit too much. Young Miya was greatly captivated by festivals filled with bright lanterns, music, fireworks and games.

Miya played three-card monte as her first gambling game. Until she was dragged home in her neighborhood's hand who ran into Miya having too much fun, she won two times and lost six times in a row and nearly lost everything she had. She couldn't just forget the excitement, though. She secretly ran around playing games with her family treasures at stake, and ended up losing all her family's dutiful souls to all over the world. Her grandmother and the elders kicked her out of the house and ordered never to come back home unless she was with all the spirits she lost. Yet she still can't quit gambling, for she believes she can "make it big with one shot" and bring all of the lost spirits home. She often loses all her money earned from her exorcism, and always blames the ghosts saying "they constantly tell her what to do and confuse her."

Yun is a dragon of the vast sea and a protector of the Devil Dragon’s blood.

When Yun was young, her mother used to tell her an old story. It was the story of how three elder dragons and a hero joined forces to defeat the Devil Dragon and seal its blood deep in the sea. It was through this story that Yun first found out that it was the duty of her kin to guard the blood of the Devil Dragon. But before Yun could fully comprehend it all, her mother, a former protector, suddenly disappeared.

The reason Yun volunteered to become a protector was not only to fulfill the duty of her kin but also to resolve the questions she had about her mother. Yun’s senior, unaware of this fact, even questioned why she would volunteer for a task that wasn't particularly honorable or noble. Ironically, many of those who were ensnared by the blood of the Devil Dragon were former protectors. In other words, being a protector meant guarding the Devil Dragon’s blood but at the same time being in the most susceptible position to its allure. Although Yun confidently stated that as long as one's heart wasn't ensnared, it would be fine, in moments when she thinks about the disappearance of her mother, she worries that she too may drop the ball.

Yun is an idealist who wants to protect everyone without anyone having to be sacrificed. Although Yun clearly understands the reason for guarding the blood of the Devil Dragon, harboring discontent with the protectors having to be sacrificed in the process, Yun eventually decides to seek her own solution between the duty of her kin and personal values.

Being virtuous and strictly decorous, Yun might come off as a cold-hearted person. However, in truth, Yun is a well-known social butterfly among several underwater kinds. As a matter of fact, Yun has a close friendship with Sia, a mermaid whom she asks for help in times of hardship.

Yuze! This summer, she's the lifeguard in charge of safety on the beach!

Upon hearing the news about rising injuries on the beach when it’s supposed to be a fun vacation spot during the sweltering summer, Succubus Adventurer Yuze took on the role of a lifeguard. Even when there aren’t any accidents happening, the sight of Yuze standing on the lifeguard tower overseeing the beach with binoculars makes it feels as if dangers in and out of the water disappear. If an accident really does happen, Yuze will rush to the scene. Whether they're on the sands, in the middle of the ocean, or deep underwater she always rescues those in danger. Yuze will not stop, no matter how sweaty or wet she gets! Thanks to her, people struck by 'someone' while on a stroll or swimmers flailing in the water because of a sudden grenade launched by 'someone' are able to make it to safety.

She uses her monster-handling skills and powerful grip as an adventurer to face off against the dangers without any hesitation, whether it's a shark or Sohee. Her specially enchanted lifebuoy aids those she rescues by giving them a speedy recovery with healing spells and makes suppressing threats easier with offensive spells. 

Yuze takes her role as a lifeguard with utmost seriousness, but can't just understand why she’s gathering more energy faster compared to when she streams her adventures on NewTube. The conclusion Yuze could come up with was: ‘the scenes of rescue are direr compared to adventuring on NewTube, so that’s why they must be more popular.’ There’s been a shortage of lifeguards on the beach ever since Sohee emerged, but when Yuze started volunteering as a lifeguard, more people recently started signing up for the task as well. Luckily, safety and danger on the beach now hold a frail balance, and the beach became an enjoyable vacation spot for many once again.

The conclusion Yuze could come up with was: ‘the scenes of rescue are direr compared to adventuring on NewTube, so that’s why they must be more popular.’ There’s been a shortage of lifeguards on the beach ever since Sohee emerged, but when Yuze started volunteering as a lifeguard, more people recently started signing up for the task as well. Luckily, safety and danger on the beach now hold a frail balance, and the beach became an enjoyable vacation spot for many once again.

Dual-personality Maid Amy, who arrived this summer bringing special customer service!

As always, she travels and does mercenary work with her partner, magician Dolf. After getting used to taking over work for the lazy bluffer, Amy was overjoyed when one day, Dolf proposed going to the beach for the summer to get some rest. While on the outside she stonily nodded her head, on the inside she looked forward to it, even setting aside lots of things to take to the beach. 

However, it didn’t take long before Amy realized she had been fooled. Dolf’s real motive was to earn money from beach tourists, and soon Amy became a server dressed in an upgraded maid swimsuit at Dolf’s demand. ‘Once we rake it in at the beach, we can relax at a swanky hotel!’ Hearing Dolf say this, Amy sighed saying she was the dumb one for having believed him.

Like that, Amy took over waitressing, which she had never done before. She became stressed dealing with rude customers from day one, feeling especially baffled by male customers who made a move on her after seeing her dressed in a swimsuit. ‘Always put on a smile when dealing with customers!’ She tried to force a smile, as Dolf said, but after continuously holding back against worsening rude behaviors, her second personality erupting was inevitable.

Afterwards, the shop had to close after going through a commotion at the beach. Dolf apologized for treating Amy so badly and asked for her forgiveness in exchange for a special week-long vacation. Dolf expected Amy to forgive him and reject his offer as usual. But contrary to his expectations, Amy said she would take a day off to go sightseeing around the town with her friend. While she didn’t say who she spent time with, Amy was beaming. In her calendar, which Dolf peeked at, she had already marked the day next year she would visit the beach again.

The Plague Doctor is a mysterious figure renowned for granting one’s wish in exchange for their soul.

The Plague Doctor appears before individuals who are deep in despair, fear, or madness and offers them the power they yearn for. All those who were granted such power acted on their desires, which resulted in the destruction of not only their surroundings but also themselves. While some claimed that they were simply manipulated by the Plague Doctor who stood beside them, there have been no witnesses confirming the Plague Doctor's presence. Also, due to their mental instability, speculation among some people arose that the Plague Doctor's existence might just be an illusion.

The reason people accepted the Plague Doctor's power was not just because they were forced into a corner. Although records of the Plague Doctor are rare, one common narrative is that despite his unsettling and peculiar attire, the moment he speaks, he instills a sense of salvation in those he encounters. Even those who were familiar with the rumors say they felt compelled to follow him once they were in his presence. No one has ever found a good explanation for this, but it is speculated that it is part of the Plague Doctor's abilities.

Since the Plague Doctor neither sought money nor affiliated with any organization, determining his identity remains a challenge. While there are records suggesting he aimed to treat the plague, the only evidence linking him to the disease is the black bacteria he carries, which can mutate organisms and is believed to be the plague he talks about. After the invasion of the Invaders, there were claims that the Plague Doctor was an advance agent for the Invaders, sent for terrorist purposes. Yet, given that many Invaders were also victims of his experiments, his true identity and motives remain shrouded in mystery to this day.

Lilith is the Chief Leader of Demon World. 

She is a charismatic and wise ruler of the Demon World. A long time ago, when she adventured with the previous generation of warriors Kaden and Erina, her cold and calm tendencies made her an excellent comrade for the party. After finishing their adventure, she united the chaotic nation and made herself Queen with her stern and realistic features that make her a perfect leader.

Lilith is assisted by the Old Swordsman Erina. They met each other while Lilith was still a young child and Erina was still an active Warrior. The two of them have been taking care of each other for over hundreds of years as friends and annoying family. It’s obvious why Lilith worries about Erina since she has lived past the life expectancy of an average human, but Erina doesn’t pay no mind to Lilith’s nagging and usually wanders off somewhere. Lilith’s desk is rumored to be always neat and free of any objects, because she would end up tossing all them at Erina and breaking everything. However, when Erina is in a dire situation, Lilith would always show up to help. Albeit she nags and clicks her tongue when she arrives.

She is famous for taking care of herself. She maintains a strict diet and exercise regimen and is the founder of the famous “Morning Routine for the Success” in Demon World, consisting of waking up early morning, jogging, meditation, and cold showers. She abstains from eating sweets, so when she does, she only allows the best. Lilith is especially strict on the quality of cookies. If there’s one thing everyone isn’t aware of about perfect Lilith, it’s that she is in a constant battle against her less-perfect self. When she can’t win against her sloth every few decades, she uses low blood pressure as an excuse to get out of working out.

Yuna is a grim reaper and inspector who works for After World Inc. 

Born an orphan, Yuna lived without a home, moving from village to village. Despite her hard life, she carried a kind heart. Though she met her unfortunate demise at the hands of a monster, in being guided by a certain grim reaper, she avoided becoming a wraith and embarked on the path of becoming a grim reaper.

Demonstrating remarkable skill in handling tasks even amidst the lack of staff at After World Inc., Yuna earned the title of Inspector. While the title of Inspector acknowledges her exceptional abilities, it also signifies that she takes on more work than the other grim reapers. Although Yuna tried to maintain a smile even during challenging times at first, as time passed, her face gradually turned expressionless. Eventually, her smile transformed into a permanent frown. Nevertheless, she explains that it is not out of anger but simply because she is tired due to the overwhelming workload.

Unlike her seemingly lethargic appearance, Yuna does her best to thoroughly handle the mountains of work she receives. Since she always calculates how she can get her job done in time, she hates when her workload is increased by poor execution. Because of this, she avoids any work that is more trouble than it's worth and hopes it isn't assigned to her. Nevertheless, it often seems to fall in her lap. Now, after hundreds of years, she has somewhat given up. She now draws up tight schedules, which include any potential work that may be assigned to her. 

She works with Hana, who recently earned the title of Inspector. Given how clumsy Hana is, Yuna has had more reasons to sigh in exasperation as of late. However, she's also been told more and more lately that she isn't frowning as much, and that it's nice to see her smile.

Ruri is a famous streamer in Dungeon Kingdom, known for her game streams and live on-site coverage.

Originally, Ruri was an engineer who designed drones and mechanical devices. She began her first broadcast in Dungeon Kingdom to test if her creations could function in harsh environments full of heat and dust. The high-definition footage of adventurers' various actions and incidents captured during this time gained immense popularity. This newfound fame sparked a new ambition in Ruri, prompting her to transform her dingy little workshop into a vibrant broadcasting studio and reinvent herself from engineer to streamer.

Ruri insists on live, on-site reporting, which has earned her a reputation as a faster and more reliable source than any media outlet. This stems from her engineering days, when she felt compelled to verify her designs personally. As she often ventured into dangerous areas, she frequently encountered fallen adventurers and would rescue them with her drones, saying the sight was unappealing on camera. Many of those she saved have become her subscribers, though Ruri still believes her popularity comes from her flashy commentary and looks rather than her rescue efforts and live broadcasts.

As people became reluctant to go on adventures due to the Invader invasion and various strange anomalies, Ruri's broadcasts gradually shifted to focus more on game streaming than on-site reporting. However, she declared that a true streamer doesn't just sit still when there's no content, and announced her own adventure. She equipped her drones with combat gear and set out herself. Having watched adventurers up close for so long, Ruri turned out to be more skilled than expected, and her courage inspired other adventures to regain their courage and venture out once more.

Klen is a Lord of Dark Beasts in the form of a humanoid boy.

His true identity is "Clevatess of the Moonlight," one of the Four Lords of Dark Beasts residing in Luna Mountain to the south. Clevatess once had absolutely no interest in humanoids, but a single event changed his perspective: humanoids armed with a red sword invaded his territory. Judging that humanoids could become a threat to his existence, Clevatess slaughtered the party of heroes, including Alicia, and immediately marched on the humanoids' stronghold, annihilating an entire kingdom.

Clevatess was fully prepared to go beyond the kingdom and wipe out every humanoid on the continent of Edthea, but he received an intriguing proposal from an unexpected source. It was a servant boy, dying amidst the ruins, holding a crying newborn in his arms. The boy begged him to spare the infant, claiming the child would prove the value of life, before breathing his last. Though the boy died before hearing an answer, Clevatess accepted his request. To a Lord of Dark Beasts, the time it took for a humanoid to grow up was merely a fleeting moment.

However, contrary to his expectations, raising a humanoid baby was an incredibly difficult task. To feed the hungry, crying infant, he revived the female hero Alicia. But having never given birth, Alicia could not produce milk. Realizing that raising a humanoid child required humanoid knowledge, Clevatess took on the appearance of the page who had entrusted him with the baby and named the child Luna. He made Alicia his servant and later added Nelluru to the group to act as Luna's wet nurse.

Now, Klen devotes himself to raising Luna, concealing the formidable power of the Lord of Dark Beasts. Should anyone dare to harm Luna, every humanoid in Edthea will pay the price.

Mayreel is the god of harvest Kamael's divine beast, an alpaca with the power of grass and flowers. Usually, she tags along with Bari in her alpaca form, but she can change into human form.

She's a whiner who hates almost everything. She dislikes everyone, even including the god of harvest Kamael. She does appreciate that Kamael raised her with love and care, but she can't help rolling her eyes at  Kamael's relentless ""nagging"" at her. Kamael hopes Mayreel to look at him the way she twinkles her eyes at Bari, but Mayreel would rather spit out on the ground and demand him not to bother her. How sad it is for Kamael when there seems to be no end to Mayreel's rebellious phase.

Mayreel hates humans. She can never understand why Bari willingly helps those greedy humans; sometimes even consuming her own happy memories. There was a time when Mayreel used to like humans since anyone who set their eyes on Mayreel would immediately fall in love with her adorable figure. But a long time ago, some crowd of people abused Bari's compassion and wished for outrageous things wasting Bari's memory. If Mayreel did not punish them on time, Bari would have not even remembered Mayreel and Kamael. Since then Mayreel became wary of humans to protect Bari from the selfish species.

Mayreel hates her human form. She constantly whines about how it's uncomfortable and cumbersome to be in a human form, about how many customs she has to uphold. That's probably why she looks so annoyed and wears her priest outfit sloppily when Bari asks her to turn into her human form. Bari tidies up Mayreel's outfit whenever she can, but in a blink of a second Mayreel will untidy her clothes. Although she, certainly, is a handful, Bari stills love the way she is.

V is a train conductor.

V is missing a part she was never born with: a brake.

As a child, V could never understand the point of homework assignments like writing a diary. No matter how it was explained to her, she would only tilt her head, wondering why one would bother writing down a yesterday that had already passed. Concepts like regret, or even nostalgia, were simply not in her vocabulary. People would often tell V that she needed to stop and look back once in a while, but her only response would be the most innocent question in the world: "Why look back when I could take another step forward?"

It wasn't a matter of conviction or resolve. V was just born that way. If the path is blocked, break through it. If it cannot be crossed, jump over it. There is always time to think after you've collided with something. Or rather, she doesn't really think about it even then.

Then one day, V saw a train racing along the tracks. A mass of steel that didn't linger on the stations it had passed, but raced only toward its next destination. In that moment, V was certain she had met her "kind" for the first time in her life. That she became a conductor was less a matter of destiny and more a matter of physics.

When the Invaders struck and Kanterbury was reduced to ruins, V's gaze did not waver in the slightest. If anything, her eyes sparkled more than ever. Obstacles on the tracks were meant to be smashed, and there were plenty of passengers to carry everywhere. The day the world stopped—that was when her true business, the one that never stops, began.

If someone were to ask V why she became a conductor, she would surely answer like this:

"Because I can just keep running forward!"

Dai is the Dragon Knight, born to bring balance to the world. Dai’s the hero who continued the will of hero Avan to defeat Dark King Vearn, and is also Avan’s fourth student.

In the past, he was separated from his parents and raised by Lump Shaman Brass in Dermline Island. Brass told stories of past heroes and taught him various magic spells. Brass wanted Dai to grow as a great mage who aids the hero, but Dai always dreamt of becoming a hero himself instead.

The monsters at Dermline Island became savage due to Hadlar being revived by the Dark King. Avan, the hero tutor from Papnica Kingdom, gets a request to train Dai and arrives on the island. After Avan subdues the rampaging monsters, he trains Dai to become a hero. Not long after, the reborn Hadlar attacks Dermine Island. At the end of a fierce battle, Avan attempted to defeat Hadlar by sacrificing himself. That was when the Dragon Crest emerged on Dai’s forehead. Dai used Avan’s ultimate technique, ‘Avan Strash’ to take down Hadlar. Then he goes on an adventure to defeat The Dark King Vearn.

Dai couldn’t sleep before his showdown against the Dark King Vearn. Hel falls asleep after consuming the dreaming fruit Merle gave him. Suddenly, a mysterious rift emerges. Dai and his companions were sucked into a rift and ended up at Kanterbury kingdom. 

Dai’s courageous and doesn’t back down no matter how powerful an enemy is. When his companions are in danger, Dai will never give up on the battle however hopeless it may seem. Despite being seriously outclassed, Dai courageously fought and stopped the Dragon Master General Baran, the leader of the Dark King’s greatest army, and his father multiple times.

- [c][8F80FF]Command Headquarters[-][/c]: The Conquests’ main goal where the enemy force’s boss appears. The hidden Supply Trucks will be revealed once it’s occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF]Supply Truck[-][/c]: A reward base that gives Gems and Battle Medals. All rewards from the Supply Truck will be accumulated for Round Rewards and be given to all Guild Members after the round is over.
- [c][8F80FF]Control Tower[-][/c]: A Base that differentiates areas and Stages. Occupying it will result in complete occupation of the area and Step. Occupying it will also unlock the next Step. 
- [c][8F80FF]Camp[-][/c]: A Base to form defense systems for each Step. The defenses of the following Step will be broken by a certain amount if occupied.
- [c][8F80FF]Communication Center[-][/c]: A tactical Base to weaken the enemies of each Step. All enemy boss and monsters’ levels within the Step will be lowered once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF] Armory[-][/c]: A Base to strengthen allies for each Step. Allies will be given advantageous effects for the battle within the Step once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF]Ammunition Deposit[-][/c]: A tactical Base that deals damage to nearby areas. It can deal a certain amount of damage to the target Base’s Boss monster or increase the Clear Count. However, it cannot make the Boss monster’s HP into 0 or achieve all Clear Counts.
- [c][8F80FF]Command Center[-][/c]: A tactical Base that applies Special Rules of the Base to the placed area. The Special Rules will be removed once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF]Cannon[-][/c]: A tactical Base that directly deals damage to the enemy Boss monster. It will deal a certain amount of damage to the Boss by bombarding once occupied.

When the portal that could send the Guardian back to the past opened in the future Heavenhold, this Guardian Knight, among all the Knights in the infinite number of parallel universes, decided to "stay in the future world" and spent 10 years since.

As the Knight gazes upon the portal, the Knight did know this future can be prevented. And that the Little Princess from 10 years back would not be abandoned. However, the thought that the Future Princess, who just finally coped with her past, might cease to exist, and the thought that the 10 years she and her friends had to endure without the knight would be for nothing. So the Knight made a decision. A decision to stay in the future and continue the battle.

And 10 years have passed since. Battles became way harder than the showdown with the Dark Magician waged on. Turning the table of the war seemed impossible. Heavenhold was reclaimed, but the Dark Magician was only one of many Invader Corps Commanders. Most of the Earth was still under-occupied by Invaders, and not many Resistance were alive. However, the Resistance did not disperse or give up. With the trust that the Knight would not abandon them again, the Resistance rallied behind the Knight and Princess and made small but precious progress in taking back some of the lands. This was the reason why the Knight could comfort the Princess with confidence, who was blaming herself for not letting the Knight go back to the past. With people fighting alongside, the Knight doesn't regret the decision to stay in the future. There are still many hardships to overcome, but the Knight, the Princess, and the rest of the Resistance rely on each other to take another step forward.

Orca is a Warlord Mercenary who always shows up in areas with large conflict.

She is a firm believer in money and power. To Orca, it’s natural for the powerful and wealthy to dominate over the weak, and taking down stronger foes is a must for taking a higher position. Orca is determined to be on top of this food chain, and she will pay any cost to do so. Any job worth money must be taken, and she can sleep when she’s dead. Orca’s completely addicted to stimulants like energy drinks and coffee. Due to her lack of sleep, she’s constantly exhausted and irritable, but her determination to become an ‘apex predator’ never wavers.

However, she completely abandoned social norms, customs and responsibility. To Orca, ‘those things aren’t worth any money or fun’. Many subordinates follow Orca for her skill and high success rates on jobs, but Orca herself doesn’t manage, take care of or trust them. She just gathers people for fun when she feels like it, then neglects them from losing interest.

Recently, Orca was hired by the Invaders attacking Adela, and fought a great battle against the kingdom’s navy. Marina, Adela’s Grand Admiral, fought against Orca in the battle. The tense battle resulted in Orca taking Marina’s eye, while she took Orca’s arm. This is why Marina wears an eye patch on her left eye, while Orca has a prosthetic left arm. Orca obsesses over Marina, who cut off her arm, because she believes she’s the only one worthy and capable of killing Marina. After hearing the news about Marina staying in Heavenhold, Orca headed there herself while looking forward to the moment she finally kills her nemesis and becomes more powerful.

Erina is the legendary hero, Lilith’s knight and Demon World’s Chief of National Security.

She’s usually in the form of an elderly woman, but she can temporarily awaken back into her younger self. Erina’s still an experienced and powerful warrior in her older form as well, but she will gather her strengths in a pinch to regain and use her abilities from her glory days. However, returning back to her younger form requires a large amount of energy. When she reverts back, her memory and strengths become faint, and she needs a long recovery period afterwards.

Erina is a living legend, whose name would show up every so often in history books for almost 1500 years. Numerous poems recite her victories, but the most famous is how she defeated all four demon gods and sealed them within herself. The demon gods' mana she held onto changed her body to surpass average physical human capabilities, and allowed her to continue adventuring for an impossibly long period. However, even the legendary hero couldn’t withstand time, and turned into an old woman after 1500 years passed. Now she is an elderly woman, who's forgetful and sometimes goes in a daze.

Erina's passion and spirit of Hero faded over time and now she thinks and acts in a more practical, detached manner. She realized centuries of time will take away her loved ones, comrades, and even her cause. Therefore, she follows rules instead of kindness and focuses on adventuring alone instead of with comrades. Lilith, her longtime companion who’s almost like family, is the exception to this rule. Lilith might not agree with this, since Erina's silent, wilful attitude drives her crazy almost every day.

Xiaoman is an adorable werepanda who loves sleep and food.

Werepandas are a rare tribe, much like the white tiger werebeasts. The forest where the werepandas now live became a refuge for several werebeast groups who once fled discrimination. They have since lived in relative seclusion from other races. Unlike the Demon World, where werebeast rights are a source of ongoing violent conflict, this forest has fostered a peaceful and quiet atmosphere. And the youngest werepanda among them is none other than Xiaoman.

The things Xiaoman loves are simple: sleeping, eating, and zoning out! Of these, eating is her greatest passion. Unlike other werebeasts who are wary of human food, Xiaoman enjoys all kinds of cuisine without hesitation. Each time she tastes something new, her ranking of favorite foods changes, except for her absolute, unchanging number one: bamboo. Her inexplicable obsession with bamboo is well known throughout the forest. The other werebeasts often say they'll never understand her taste, as she happily munches on bamboo every day despite it having neither flavor nor nutritional value.

Xiaoman is impressionable and extremely literal, which often leads to her misunderstanding what others say. For example, when she was still a baby panda, Kanna once called her "mochi" because she was so soft and cute. Xiaoman took it literally and genuinely believed she was mochi. One day, she even jumped into a lake, thinking she could eat her reflection. Kanna had quite a time clearing up the misunderstanding. Although it was eventually resolved, Xiaoman still sometimes licks her lips when she sees her reflection in the water, almost out of habit.

Tasha is an exorcist who eradicates yokai using her family’s ancestral puppet arts.

Tasha was raised in the village of the House of Jade Mountain, one of the three great exorcist families. Growing up, she looked up to the senior exorcists who protected their village from yokai. Inspired by her seniors, Tasha aspired to become an exorcist herself. To become a full-fledged exorcist though, family tradition dictated that all candidates must pass a succession trial. Determined to succeed, she entered the trial alongside her closest friend, Tilda. Together, they overcame numerous challenges and reached the final trial. But in the end, only Tasha passed, officially earning the title of exorcist.

Upon earning her title, she was presented with the "Mask of Dominion," which allows her to control yokai through puppetry. Though this magic is immensely powerful, it carries a grave risk of slowly corrupting the user's mind. Nonetheless, Tasha's strong and steadfast spirit allows her to wield this power without succumbing to its influence.

Having lived her entire life in the village, Tasha harbored a deep curiosity about the outside world. During an exorcism mission to another region, she encountered the Teatan Rangers, who were rescuing children while wearing masks. Though their flashy costumes and dramatic speeches initially shocked her, seeing the children's admiration for these heroes sparked something within her.

Inspired by the Rangers, Tasha began introducing herself as the "Jade Exorcist" when saving people from yokai attacks. As tales of her heroics spread, more and more people have expressed a desire to become an exorcist like Tasha.

Gabriel is a former archangel running a supermarket.

After the world tree burnt down, she lost her powers and now runs a convenience store in the human world. Although her days as the archangel are gone, she still lives a glamorous life exploiting her part-time workers. She claims that her ultimate mission is to "maintain world peace and to spread good deeds all around the world," so she has earned herself the title of "Madam Archangel" and "Honest Role Model of Business Person."

However, hidden behind the angelic face is a very crooked and oppressive boss. She doesn't guarantee minimum wage and refuses to write an employment agreement, and also sells the store's expired food to part-time workers. Surprisingly, she still has her divine power even when she oppresses her part-time worker harder than the devil. Gabriel's blessing raises one's morale and strength, and she abuses this "blessing" to make her workers work without a break.

Gabriel's longest employed worker is Angie the angel who used to serve Plitvice. Gabriel enticed diligent Angie, who is already busy bringing back sealed Plitvice and paying back debt as the Secretary of the Heaven Treasury, to be her part-time worker. Then she gradually increased Angie's working hours longer than the time she spends in the Heaven Treasury. Whenever Angie tries to get away from the store, Gabriel would provoke her, saying how "she is disappointed that her loyalty to Plitvice is frivolous." Angie, who is oblivious to human affairs and also poor, is grateful she can buy expired frozen food at a reduced price, and she is also grateful she can work hard to buy a pudding for Plitvice someday.

Lynn is a chef running a bento shop in Shen City.

She's a chef using monster meat as the main ingredient. Lynn's shop was doing quite well until one customer's review bomb completely decimated her business overnight. That night, while on her way back home after drinking her sorrow away, she rescued a child almost getting run over by an automobile and got fatally injured. After miraculously waking up, she somehow gained insight into cooking and operating a shop, and decided to try again one last time.

Lynn's misfortune started way before her shop went bankrupt; she is truly the incarnation of bad luck. The restaurant run by her parents went bankrupt during the time of clashes between the Tiger clan and the Viper clan. Every other little diner Lynn started to work at went straight bankrupt. Eventually, she had no choice but to go learn how to cook from an old chef she met in the first diner she worked. Since everything goes south when she tries to do anything, she got into the habit of drinking tea and getting drunk every day to soothe the bitterness.

She loves every kind of tea, but her favorite is Shen City's most beloved grain tea. When she drinks tea she'll befriend anyone next to her, and get into a fight with the person next to them the following moment. She's lively and friendly when she's drunk, but always anxious when she's sober. The same thing goes for her combats; with her drinks, she gets more powerful, full of confidence, and without any hesitation. It's hard to tell if she's performing martial arts or she's just too drunk to control her body when she fights, and that is her own signature 'Drunken Swordsmanship' move.

- Evolution Stones of fully evolved Heroes or Myth Stones of Heroes that have achieved Myth can be exchanged for Hero Crystals.
- {0} Rare Hero Evolution Stones can be exchanged for 1 Hero Crystal.
- {1} Unique Hero Evolution Stones can be exchanged for 1 Hero Crystal.
- {2} Hero Myth Stones can be exchanged for 1 Hero Crystal.
- You need to own enough Rare or Unique Hero Evolution Stones, or Myth Stones, to make an exchange.
- When you press the Exchange button, eligible Evolution Stones and Myth Stones of Heroes that have fully evolved or have achieved Myth will be automatically selected.
- The Stones will be selected in the order of Rare Hero Evolution Stones, Unique Hero Evolution Stones, and Hero Myth Stones.
- The Material Exchange button activates through two stages.
- When pressed the first time, all eligible Evolution Stones and Myth Stones, except for their reserved quantities, will be moved to the exchange window, and an "Add All" button will be added at the top-right corner of the window.
- Remaining quantities are 40 for Rare Evolution Stones, 20 for Unique Hero Evolution Stones, and 10 for Hero Myth Stones.
- When the Add all button is pressed, all exchangeable Evolution Stones and Myth Stones are moved to the exchange window.
- You can remove Evolution Stones and Myth Stones that you don't want to exchange by tapping on them.
- At this point, some of the Evolution Stones and Myth Stones of the same rarity in the last slots can also be removed from the window to adjust for the correct exchange ratio.
- Normal Hero Evolution Stones cannot be exchanged.
- Max of 25 types of Evolution Stones can be selected per exchange.

Toga is an executive of the werebeast organization ‘Tooth and Fang’.

Tooth and Fang was once a notorious armed group. Back in those days, Toga, who was actively involved as a raid captain, was considered a nightmare to the demons of Demonshire. This was because she would break off and collect a horn from each demon she defeated, sparking fear amongst them and earning her the nickname ‘Horn Huntress’. However, after Toga’s childhood friend Rey became the leader of ‘Tooth and Fang’ and the group became mild-mannered, rumors about the Horn Huntress’ victims have also stopped circulating.

Since childhood, Toga has sharpened her swordsmanship skills by sparring with Rey. As she grew older and started to care more about efficiency, she tried using guns, but by then her swordsmanship skills had already been deeply ingrained in her. Because of that, when circumstances became urgent, she would often swing her guns like swords and break them. Now, she wields a weapon that is a combination of both a sword and a gun.

She enjoys climbing without using any climbing gear. While young werebeasts idolize her for being able to ascend and descend steep cliffs in seconds, their parents worry that they might imitate Toga's dangerous behavior.

Despite her blunt and tough appearance, she likes soft and pretty clothes. But because she doesn't like others seeing her in them, she usually doesn’t wear them unless they are made by Rey. Recently, Rey showed Toga how to make clothes using her own hair. Toga gifted the first garment she made to Rey, but due to a mistake in her measurements, Rey currently uses it as a handkerchief.

Beth is a magician within the invaders, a high ranking priest of the invader order.

She is a drama queen strategist. War is brain before brawn. She crafts her plans while predicting and reacting to her opponent's move as if she is playing a game of chess. Beth likes to add some dramatic elements to her plays, especially when she is planning her grand entrance. It probably would have been better to pose as a nobody to infiltrate the Rah Empire's Kanterbury refugee camp. Choosing to pose as Penny, who was beloved by everyone, and go around the camp while betraying everyone's love has to be her adding that dramatic aspect to her plan. She can sacrifice without hesitation any piece on her chess board to achieve her goals, because all those moves are steps to serve a greater good for the invader's mission and to fulfill the Savior's prophecy that was never wrong.

To the invaders the Savior's prophecy is a "maxim" that cannot be doubted. Beth, like all other invaders, learned and preached the words of the Savior and trained to "reclaim" the world. Beth's cunning game of chess based on the maxim should always prevail. Pitiful savages would never understand it, and she pities the pitiful savages for not understanding it. Then who is this Guardian that casts doubt on Beth's faith? Everything else is as the prophecy, but this Guardian causes chaos and discord and it annoys Beth. Is the Savior wrong, or is the Guardian's heresy corrupting savior's pureness? Beth has no choice but to be in doubt.

She loathes when someone calls her real name and everyone is required to call her 'High Priest.' It seems to be a dearest name for her.
