Hana is a Grim Reaper, who guides the souls of the deceased to the right path.

Due to her clumsy personality and unlucky nature, everything she did usually ended up in disaster. Hana didn’t have much luck in life as well. It was safe to say everything she did proactively would end up in failure. Because of this, Hana is still afraid to act even as an employee of After World Inc.

Hana works hard as a Grim Reaper, but thanks to her mistakes she’s not coming up with results. Her mistakes and bad luck mount up to making the matters worse instead. Her performance review is rock bottom and Hana’s been branded as a useless Grim Reaper in the company.

When Hana was alive, people around her would suddenly end up dead to the point of arousing suspicion. Some just considered it as superstition, but those who became close to Hana all ended up dying after a while. As these incidents continued, the villagers left Hana one by one, and soon Hana was all alone. This left a deep mark within Hana’s soul, and she started getting scared of becoming closer to other spirits.

Spirits who leave strong resentment and regret in life lose all of their memories when coming to the After World. The spirits who lost their memories end up wandering the nether or become Grim Reapers in the After World. 

Through some event, some Grim Reapers regain their memories and solve their resentments and regrets to be reborn, but these cases are very rare. Most end up working for eternity. Through this process, Grim Reapers are growing in numbers, but because the population is growing faster, After World Inc is constantly needing more manpower.

Carol is the elemental of light tasked with protecting Christmas.

Light elementals send in forces to fight off demons crossing over from another dimension that attempt to take over Christmas every year.Carol is that elemental force’s commander. Her wish and joy is to safely complete her mission so people can spend a merry Christmas. After Christmas is over, she returns with her men and trains diligently to prepare for the next one. Carol’s forces are famous for training a lot, but her men stay infinitely loyal to their bright and joyful commander. She’s so popular there’s even a fanclub of her.

Carol’s elegant swordsmanship is also a contributor to her popularity. According to one of the soldiers who trained with her, she gracefully deflects the enemy’s attack before overpowering her foe. It almost looks like a beautiful dance performance is taking place. 

The only flaw to the seemingly perfect Carol is her atrocious fashion sense. She once left her base in civilian clothing, but her outfit ended up being chosen for ‘Worst Fashion of the Year’ on the elemental magazine. Carol fell into severe shock, and started to get fashion advice or outfit recommendations from her peers to broaden her horizons. Sometimes she goes into battle wearing the outfit her men recommended her. Everytime she does, her troop’s morale skyrockets. Carol’s confidence and passion about fashion is growing daily, thanks to her men’s enthusiasm. On her days off, Carol sneaks out to research fashion from the human world. Recently, she was deeply inspired by Mayreel’s fashion of wearing her priest outfit sloppily.

- Free-For-All Mode is a mode where 6 users battle one another individually and the last person standing wins the most Trophy Points.
- When a hero faints, a new hero is revived after 5 seconds, and until then you may freely switch heroes. Revived heroes are invincible for 2 seconds.
- Fainted heroes cannot be used again, and when all 3 heroes faint you are eliminated.
- Eliminated users may observe the match between players that are still alive, or choose to leave.
- If the last person standing is not decided within the limited time, the player with the most heroes left wins the highest rank.
- If the number of heroes left is the same, the user with the higher HP wins the higher rank.
- If a tie occurs due to multiple users being eliminated at the same time or having the same HP left, those users will all obtain the same rank.
- L-bacteria, which severely damages heroes, will close in every certain amount of time in Free-For-All Mode.
- When L-bacteria's movement ceases, Fever Time is activated and all users alive receive a 20% Atk increase effect.
- Heroes' HP are doubled. Other statistics modifications will apply the same as the standard mode.
- If you take down an opponent’s hero during battle, you earn a 20% Atk increase effect and your HP is restored by 15%.
- If you open up a box during battle, you earn a 20% Atk increase effect.
- If the hero faints, this Atk increase effect is reduced by half. The Atk increase effect of Fever Time will not disappear.
- The Atk increase effect total cannot exceed 200%.
- Your ranking will determine whether you win or lose as well as the Trophy Points you earn.

- To enter Co-op Expedition, the minimum stage requirements must be met.
- In Co-op Expedition, stage modification may occur in case the level of the hero, equipment, and accessory exceeds the minimum stage level. You can check the modified stats in the Matching Room or Hero Roster.
- In Co-op Expedition, Mystic Resistance may be modified if it exceeds the stage requirements by a certain amount. Additional Atk, HP and Heal stats may be applied in levels through modifications in Mystic Resistance.
- Co-op Expedition features Berserk. Berserk occurs at regular intervals, and as it progresses, monsters within the stage become significantly stronger.
- In Co-op Expedition, HP recovery and shield effects are reduced by 90% in proportion to the damage dealt.
- Some stages have Special Rules that can be viewed on the entry screen of each stage.
- In Co-op Expedition, the Exit button activates if one or more users leave the game.
- In Co-op Expedition, stages come in various modes and are played in real-time with up to 4 players.
- [Co-op] involves solving missions within the stage sequentially. The stage is cleared when the final room is finished.
- [Co-op(Defense)] involves protecting the Stronghold from incoming enemies by taking advantage of the landscape and loots. The stage is cleared if the number of monsters does not exceed a certain limit until the end.
- [Boss Battle] involves fighting a powerful boss. The stage is cleared when the boss is defeated.
- Challenge Stages unlock upon clearing all Normal Stages of the current season.
- Challenge Stages are significantly more difficult than Normal Stages.

Rue is Santa's helper aiding Santa to deliver gifts all around the world on Christmas.

She's a weredeer, a deer human existed since ancient times. She is by herself after poachers slaughtered her family when she was young. She possesses wild instinct and exceptional physical prowess, and also a special ability sealed under her name given by her family. Usually she uses her alias and hides her real name. Santa is the only one knowing her real name as of now.

She's a bit gloomy and cynical. And sometimes cold and indifferent. However, when it comes to fixing Santa's problem, she's fierce and passionate. She would burn down the entire house to fright the mouse. She is skillful in using explosives and huge weaponry, and also very adept in steering giant gears such as dump trucks and aircrafts with her "instinctive knack." There's even a famous anecdote. The day Santa bought the gift-delivery aircraft because the sleigh was too cold, Rue lifted off the aircraft with no problem. Confounded Santa asked, "When did you get a pilot's license?" and Rue answered, "I didn't." Santa slapped on Rue's back, telling her to go get one, so Rue did as Santa said: the very next day she got Tetis special pilot's license on her first try.

Rue used to be a weak cry baby at her young age. The cold weather made her nose red, and the kids would tease her, how she is sniffing and crying again. Then she would actually burst into tears. Only a sweet candy in her mouth could lighten her day. Even now when she's giving her loyalty to Santa under the "Real Name Contract," there's always a piece of candy in her mouth.

- [c][8F80FF]Command Headquarters[-][/c]: The main Base and Target for Conquest where the enemy’s final boss appears.
- [c][8F80FF]Control Tower[-][/c]: The Base that differentiates areas and Step within Conquest. Conquering it will unlock the next Step.
- [c][8F80FF]Camp[-][/c]: Redcues the Def of the Control Tower within the Step when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Node[-][/c]: The standard Base to battle.
- [c][8F80FF]Communication Center[-][/c]: Lowers all monster levels by a certain amount within all Bases and Target Bases within the Step when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Armory[-][/c]: Allies will be given advantageous effects for the battle within the Step when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Ammunition Deposit[-][/c]: When conquered, it deals damage to the Target Base’s boss monster or increase the Clear attempts. However, making both the boss monster’s HP 0 and acheiving the Target Clear attempts is not possible.
- [c][8F80FF]Command Center[-][/c]: Removes the Special Rules of the Target Base when conquired.
- [c][8F80FF]Cannon[-][/c]: When conquered, bombards the Target Base and deals damage to the boss monster in ratio to its HP.
- [c][8F80FF]Large Button[-][/c]: A powerful hidden boss will appear when all existing Large Buttons on the field are conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Missile Launcher[-][/c]: A skill of a boss monster at the Command Headquarters will be weakened when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Supply Truck[-][/c]: You can get a large amount of Conquest Points when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Huge Button[-][/c]: Obtain additional Capture Score when conquered.

Parvati is the model employee of the unofficial post facto clean up team of Kamazon. 

The unofficial post facto clean up team takes out those who threaten or get in Kamazon’s way. Parvati always maintains top performance within the organization full of various assassins. Kamazon views Parvati favorably as well due to her obedience towards superiors and her capability to swiftly take out any target. Some areas fell into complete pandemonium due to her superior abilities. However Parvati herself is unaware she’s the cause behind the chaos.

There’s a sole reason Parvati got a job at Kamazon after being trained under her father with her younger sister at a young age. It was her father’s dying wish for Parvati to live an ordinary life and get hired by an ordinary company. She believed getting employed at the famous Kamazon meant living an ordinary life, so she kept applying. But the world wasn’t her oyster. After being rejected interview after interview, she finally got hired through a recommendation to a department that suited her skillset.

Now that she’s finally achieved her father’s dying wish, Parvati completely believes she’s an ordinary employee like everyone else. And she doesn’t doubt it at all. Because her job requires her to move from place to place, she gets really annoyed from moving constantly. Her only hobby is seeking out new local delicacies when she moves into a new town. Parvati’s life is satisfactory in all aspects, but her one wish is for Tinia, her younger sister, to live an ordinary life just like her.

Dohwa is the heir to the Motori Mountain soul mage family.

Dohwa has a twin sister named Seohwa. While Seohwa has a bright personality and is often lucky despite being in poor health, Dohwa is prone to small misfortunes, like frequently tripping or getting hurt, and is more timid. Though they may seem completely opposite at first glance, their love and care for each other are the same.

From a young age, Dohwa and Seohwa studied soul magic to become soul mages. But one day, after learning about grim reapers, they both decided they wanted to become grim reapers instead. They immediately begged their mother to let them become grim reapers, but their mother scared them by saying that to become a grim reaper, they would first have to die and forget all their memories of this world. Not wanting to forget each other, Dohwa and Seohwa never brought it up again. Afterward, they even started to feel a little sorry for grim reapers.

The primary duty of a soul mage is to resolve problems related to the souls of the residents of Motori Village. Most of the work involves treating nightmares or emotional distress caused by disturbed soul flows. After becoming the heir, Dohwa took over her mother's responsibilities in solving these issues. However, she often stumbles in front of the villagers and frequently apologizes for lacking confidence in her soul magic. Despite this, many people find her clumsiness endearing, and a secret group has formed to quietly support her. It's an open secret that Seohwa secretly joined and participated in this group.

Shuna serves as the chief economic advisor of the Jura Tempest Federation and is a princess of the Ogre Tribe.

After surviving the Orc Invasion, she journeyed with a group of Ogre survivors, seeking revenge on a masked Majin. During this quest, she came across Rimuru Tempest and engaged in battle due to a misunderstanding. However, Shuna quickly intervened, realizing Rimuru was not the Majin they sought. After hearing about their plight, Rimuru extended an offer for the Ogre survivors to join him as his subordinates, a proposition which they accepted.

As a token of their allegiance, Rimuru bestowed upon her the name "Shuna." Subsequently, during Rimuru's evolution into a Demon Lord through the Harvest Festival, all the Demons spiritually connected to Rimuru, including Shuna, received a gift, resulting in her transformation into an Oni.

Shuna played a significant role in the cultural development of the Jura Tempest Federation while assisting Rimuru. Although she mainly trained students in culinary and sartorial arts, given her status as the Ogre princess, she also exhibited adeptness in negotiations and foreign affairs.

Shuna cares deeply for her lord, Rimuru. Thanks to her faith in Rimuru, Shuna is able to use Holy Magic despite being a monster, with which she once used to overpower Clayman's subordinate, "Adalmann." Occasionally, she gets into friendly arguments with Shion, Rimuru's secretary, about taking care of Rimuru. The look of exhaustion on Rimuru's face during these moments is always an amusing sight.

Scintilla is from the family of Harpies, the flame elementals who possessed the throne of elemental king for many generations.

She’s a harpy from the land of flames. Most harpies are born with frail thin bodies. Due to the laws of homeostasis, harpies can’t strengthen their bodies through training. However, Scintilla’s hard work surpassed this limit and changed her nature. She's the first muscular harpy in existence, who ventured into the human world with a yearning to have a stronger and more powerful body. During her travels in Desert Kingdom, she ran into Marvin and started to idolize him. 

She’s an excellent physical martial artist, and her specialty is kicking. Scintilla’s been going around the human world and learning more martial arts. After seeing the Super Thunder Lightning Kick of the two fairies from the east, she set a goal to find a muscular comrade and create an ultimate move just like them. 

Scintilla’s addicted to training. She’s a passionate exercise maniac, obsessing over her muscles. She worries about losing gains the minute she stops training, and uses daily activities as a way to train. Scintilla loves any type of training that’s enough to be a challenge. She came to the human world for the same reason. She believes the unpredictable nature of the human world makes it the true training ground. Nothing’s impossible for Scintilla. She’ll try until she succeeds! Scintilla is prepared to do anything through her burning passion and will like an undying flame.

Lina Inverse is a Sorceress from Zepheel city, Zephilia Kingdom’s capital.

Lina succeeded in reading the magical Claire Bible. She also defeated powerful enemies like Hellmaster Fibrizo at the end of her long adventure with her past comrades. However, she fell into a mysterious dimensional rift at the last moment and landed on Kanterbury Kingdom with her party.

Lina uses her motto “villains don’t have rights” to take down numerous robbers and take their valuables. Lina’s known to tenaciously hunt robbers because she combined her hobby with practical benefits. Her infamy spread to earn the title of ‘Robbers’ Killer’, and she never lets anything slide. Most robbers lose their will to fight after hearing the name ‘Lina Inverse’.

She’s a tremendous glutton, and eats so much that she stacks a tall pile of plates after each meal. Even Amelia expresses concern over Lina’s food bills despite being a princess. Lina especially loves meat dishes, and does not hesitate over putting in effort or costs to eat delicacies and rare dishes.

Lina’s Demon’s Blood Talisman is a magical item that amplifies mana by borrowing the powers of the Demon Kings of the four planes: Ruby Eye, Dark Star, Chaotic Blue, and Death Fog. This talisman was originally owned by Xellos, but Lina half-force purchased the talisman from him and now wears it instead. Lina uses the Demon’s Blood Talisman to cast black magic like Ranga Blade that can’t be done by ordinary human’s mana.

Nifty is one of the twin android models specially developed by Cyber Robotics and serves as a secretary who assists the CEO.

Along with her twin Shifty, Nifty carries out secretarial duties and handles overall management of the company on behalf of the busy CEO. While the two androids share a similar structural design, being twin androids, their AIs are completely different. While Nifty considers multiple possibilities when solving problems, Shifty places emphasis on efficient solutions. The CEO deduced that, by working together, the two AIs would complement each other and become perfect, and instructed them to carry out duties as a pair.

They often bicker like sisters, and when they do, their work efficiency drops exponentially. The topic they argue about most is ‘who is older’. Both androids have their reasons for staking claim to be the older sister. Nifty argues that her android body was developed first, while Shifty asserts that her AI was developed first. When their disagreements began affecting their performance, the CEO declared that he would award the title of older sister based on work efficiency. Ever since then, their productivity has tripled.

It’s easy to tell Nifty and Shifty apart now because of their different hair colors, but they originally had identical hair. At one point, the CEO deliberately mixed up their names to spark competition between them, leaving them speechless. When they returned the next day, they had dyed their hair different colors.

Milim Nava is a Dragonoid, born between a True Dragon and a human. Like Rimuru, she is also a member of Octagram, the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

As the longest reigning Demon Lord, Milim's combat prowess is mighty and admired by all. When Rimuru first encountered Milim’s ambition, he noted that it was every bit as powerful as that of ‘Storm Dragon Veldora.’ Milim once demonstrated her combat capabilities by effortlessly destroying a Charybdis that was unaffected by Rimuru's attacks with a single blow and wiping out the Beast Kingdom after being attacked by the Demon Lord, Carrion. However, despite her immense power, she is often underestimated due to her childlike appearance.

Although Milim possesses overwhelming combat prowess, she does not solely rely on her strength to subdue her enemies. Her years of experience as a Demon Lord have taught her to be cunning when it comes to discerning her enemy's intentions and to endure unpleasant tasks when necessary.

Milim and Rimuru became best friends when Milim, who had been living a dull life, decided to move to "Jura Tempest Federation" in search of excitement. Initially, they were bound to be ordinary friends, but Rimuru couldn't resist Milim's pleading eyes and ended up forming a close friendship with her. Milim even brags to her fellow Demon Lords about the gifts Rimuru gave her. Despite typically doing as she pleases, Milim tends to follow Rimuru's orders well, perhaps because she values their friendship greatly.

Noxia is a necromancer girl who can summon spirits and create monsters from dead body parts.

She sees and communicates with dead souls with her innate power. She can summon monsters formed by 'fragments' she gathered all around the world. Noxia befriends everything that's lifeless and assigns them roles as if playing make-believe. Among them, a huge friend-a protective big daddy-always stands by Noxia.

In her childhood before she realized that her power was 'power', Noxia, who couldn't distinguish the living and the dead, befriended the latter. When other children played with dolls, Noxia 'created' dolls to play with. Adults were terrified to see Noxia create monsters from dead animal bodies and argued to banish Noxia, and even her parents turned their back against her. Even before turning 10 years old, Noxia left her hometown and started traveling around the world. Noxia feels most comfortable in a tomb or graveyard.

Noxia never learned how to express or feel emotions like normal people. Living among the dead made her facial expression and her voice aloof. Since almost every living person feared or abhorred her while the dead greeted her, it should be obvious for her to side with the dead. Although dealing with living people is always hard and unpleasant, she still admires the extravagant culture and sweet snacks created by them. Especially, the chocolate she saw in a store display in her childhood is truly the magnum opus to Noxia.

- To enter Co-op Expedition, the minimum stage requirements must be met.
- In Co-op Expedition, Stage Modification exists to modify a part of a hero's stats in the case it exceeds the appropriate stats for a certain stage. You can check whether the stats have been modified and the extent in the Matching Room or Hero Roster.
- Co-op Expedition features Berserk. Berserk occurs at regular intervals, and as it progresses, monsters within the stage become significantly stronger.
- In Co-op Expedition, HP recovery and shield effects are reduced by 90% in proportion to the damage dealt.
- Some stages have Special Rules that can be viewed on the entry screen of each stage.
- In Co-op Expedition, the Exit button activates if one or more users leave the game.
- In Co-op Expedition, stages come in various modes and are played in real-time with up to 4 players.
- [Co-op] involves solving missions within the stage sequentially. The stage is cleared when the final room is finished.
- [Co-op(Defense)] involves protecting the Stronghold from incoming enemies by taking advantage of the landscape and loots. The stage is cleared if the number of monsters does not exceed a certain limit until the end.
- [Boss Battle] involves fighting a powerful boss. The stage is cleared when the boss is defeated.
- Challenge Stages unlock upon clearing all Normal Stages of the current season.
- Challenge Stages are significantly more difficult than Normal Stages.

Oghma is a giant mecha robot.

2.1m tall and weighs 527kg. A gnome inventor created by renovating an invader's armor. Nobody except the inventor and the invaders would know exactly what basic materials have been used. It can attack with a giant sword, and it can equip up to 6 missiles in the magazine behind its head. It can also create a vibration field and convey pressure on specific targeted areas by vibrating its body.

The pilot of Oghma is a gnome boy named Aidan. When the invaders invaded the Inn, Aidan almost gave up his life to protect Lord Smiley Face. More than half of his bones were broken after the malicious attack but was revived by the gnome inventor with the technology from the invaders' armor. Parts of his body parts were replaced with machines, transforming Aidan into a half cyborg. This made him the one and only pilot that can become one even to the soul with Oghma as he can control the mecha by connecting parts of his body to it.

Before becoming the Oghma pilot, Aidan was a boy with nothing but exaggerated heroism, acting as a self-appointed 'the hero of the Inn.' But after the battle with invaders and gaining a second chance in life, he has awakened to the real meaning of his life. That is to be the one to protect Lord Smiley Face, Loraine. Now, Aidan pretends to be a human to perform his sole duty to protect the world of Loraine the Smiley Face from the evil and the invaders.

- Free-For-All Mode is a mode where 6 users battle one another individually and the last person standing wins the most Trophy Points.
- When a hero faints, a new hero is revived after 5 seconds, and until then you may freely switch heroes. Revived heroes are invincible for 2 seconds.
- Fainted heroes cannot be used again, and when all 3 heroes faint you are eliminated.
- Eliminated users can observe the players that are still alive, or choose to leave.
- If the last person standing is not decided within the limited time, the player with the most heroes left wins the highest rank.
- If the number of heroes left is the same, the user with the higher HP wins the higher rank.
- If a tie occurs due to multiple users being eliminated at the same time or having the same HP left, those users will all obtain the same rank.
- If you open up a box during the battle, your Atk increases by 30%. If the hero faints, this effect disappears.
- L-bacteria, which severely damages heroes, will close in every certain amount of time in Free-For-All Mode.
- When L-bacteria's movement ceases, Fever Time is activated and the Atk of all users alive increases additionally by 30%. Even if the hero faints, this effect does not disappear.
- Heroes' HP are doubled. Other statistics modifications will apply the same as the standard mode.
- Your ranking will determine whether you win or lose as well as the Trophy Points you earn.

Bianca is a succubus lady from a prominent high-class noble family. 

She was raised like a princess at home. The high-quality private education from her family, along with her natural strength and intelligence, made her an outstanding elite with both the brains and battle skills. She is extremely beautiful. She always wears tailored clothes, showing off the look of a perfect combination of a gentleman and a lady. She has extravagant taste and has a knack in "aesthetics."

Unlike normal succubi that seduce humans and absorb their energy, she summons and throws ice, pushing the enemy to move away from her. Due to this, although she aced her school subjects, her grades for the "Seduction" class were close to failure. It's very fortunate of her to have been born into a rich family, where she still can live without gaining human energy by herself.

She's from the same class as Yuze. She graduated second place after Yuze, who aced the mandatory Seduction class essential to the succubi. After having a tough time accepting her defeat, she thinks of Yuze as her rival—so much so that she changed her future career job from "an orchestra maestro" to "an adventurer" after seeing Yuze exclaim her dream to become one with such enthusiasm. In contrast to all this, Yuze considers Bianca as a smart and pretty friend. Bianca can't help herself sulking and pouting at Yuze, who is so undesigningly kind to her.

Alicia is a Hero resurrected by an infusion of the Lord of Dark Beasts’ dark ichor, who wields the regalia as a warrior.

A Hero from Sogo Village, Alicia grew up under the tutelage of her father, a genius swordsman, nurturing her dream. Her goal was to slay the Lord of Dark Beasts who stood blocking the Far Side of the World and widen the world beyond. After relentless training, she became one of the 13 heroes. The King of Hiden presented her with the regalia, and she set out to hunt the Lord of Dark Beasts. But she was no match for Clevatess, the Southern Lord of Dark Beasts, and died in defeat, leaving only a shallow cut on his horn.

Soon after her death, she was revived by her nemesis, Clevatess. The Kingdom of Hiden that had hired her had already been annihilated during the single night she lay dead, and to make matters worse, Clevatess’s blood now ran in her veins.

Alicia despaired that the Hero who had taken up arms to slay the Lord of Dark Beasts had become his thrall instead. Yet, oddly enough, the Lord of Dark Beasts before her was engrossed in raising a child. Seeing his interest in Luna, a royal infant, she sensed that the child’s survival held the fate of their world. At the very least, she had to stop him from destroying everything after Hiden.

Even now, Alicia does everything she can to save the world of humanoids. Even in undeath, she remains a Hero.

- If you own enough Evolution Stones to fully evolve a Hero or own Evolution Stones of a fully evolved Hero, you can exchange them for Hero Crystals. 
- {0} Rare Hero Evolution Stones can be exchanged for 1 Hero Crystal.
- {1} Unique Hero Evolution Stones can be exchanged for 1 Hero Crystal.
- You need to own enough Evolution Stones of either Rare Heroes or Unique Heroes for the exchange.
- Press the Exchange button and Evolution Stones of fully evolved Heroes will be automatically selected.
- The Evolution Stones will be selected in the order of Rare Heroes, then Unique Heroes.
- The Exchange button is activated through two stages.
- When the button is pressed for the first time, all Evolution Stones except their spare quantities are moved to the exchange window. The button will change into the ‘Add all’ button.
- The spare quantity for unique Evolution Stones is 20, and 40 for rare Evolution Stones.
- When the Add all button is pressed, all exchangeable Evolution Stones are moved to the exchange window.
- You can remove Evolution Stones that you don't want to exchange by tapping on them.
- At this point, some of the Evolution Stones of the same rarity in the last slots can also be removed from the window to adjust for the correct exchange ratio.
- Normal Hero Evolution Stones cannot be exchanged.
- Max of 25 types of Evolution Stones can be selected per exchange.

Garam is a nine-tailed fox sage.

He became a sage after a long, long training in the fox cave. As Nari's old friend, supporter, and competitor, he wields more powerful magic than Nari since he has one extra tail than her.

While Nari was in a deep, long sleep inside a stone statue, Garam travelled the world with Dallae, who had nowhere to go, and nurtured those in need. However, the greedy humans, who got help from Garam, pulled a scheme to steal Sage's magic which ultimately led to Dallae's death. Garam got engulfed in sorrow and rage and went on a frenzy. Nari, awakened from her sleep, alleviated Garam's frenzy and reminded him about the duty as a sage, and Garam finally calmed himself down and went on a path of training to once again uphold his duty as a sage. This time, he hopes to learn to control himself and his power through archery, and he aims to nurture a wider world with his warm heart without settling at one place.

After training for ages in the mountains, Garam had no idea what was going on with the world. It's a shock that there are now so many people wielding magic. So many things are incomprehensible or seems without obvious purposes, no matter how much he looks at them. Magic is the only conclusion Garam can come up with when encountering all these advanced technology. He is especially sure that Sohee is a some kind of ill-tempered sage.

- [c][8F80FF]Command Headquarters[-][/c]: The Conquests’ main goal where the enemy force’s boss appears. 
- [c][8F80FF]Control Tower[-][/c]: A Base that differentiates areas and Stages. Occupying it will also unlock the next Step. 
- [c][8F80FF]Camp[-][/c]: Occupying it will reduce the following Step’s Control Tower defenses.
- [c][8F80FF]Communication Center[-][/c]: All enemy boss and monsters’ levels within the Step will be lowered once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF] Armory[-][/c]:Allies will be given advantageous effects for the battle within the Step once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF]Ammunition Deposit[-][/c]: A tactical Base that deal a certain amount of damage to the target Base’s Boss monster or increase the Clear Count once occupied. However, it cannot make the Boss monster’s HP into 0 or achieve all Clear Counts.
- [c][8F80FF]Command Center[-][/c]: Removes Base’s Special Rules once occupied. 
- [c][8F80FF]Cannon[-][/c]: It will deal a certain amount of damage to the Boss by bombarding once occupied.
- [c][8F80FF]Large Button[-][/c]: A powerful hidden boss will appear when all existing Large Buttons on the field are conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Missile Launcher[-][/c]: A skill of a boss monster at the Command Headquarters will be weakened when conquered.
- [c][8F80FF]Supply Truck[-][/c]: You can get a large amount of Conquest Points when conquered.

- Heroes' level and their equipment's level will be modified to level 115.
- Heroes’ Level, Evolution, Limit Break, Awakening, and Blessing are modified to the highest level.
- In the case of Myth or Ascended Heroes, all Awakening Nodes unlocked through Myth or Hero Ascent are modified to the highest level.
- The Evolution, Limit Break, Basic Option, owned Sub-Option, and Engraving Option of Heroes’ Equipment are modified to the highest level.
- However, in the case of Normal and Rare Relics, only the Basic Option and owned Sub-Option are modified to the highest level.

- If the number of members changes during a game, the Heroes' statistics will be modified accordingly.

- Base occupation will progress via normal battles and Boss battles.
- Normal battles will not have a time limit.
- The battle will commence on different stages against the enemy’s normal monsters within the Stage.
- Stage clears will be counted instead of damage when the Stage is over.
- If the Base is conquered by another Guild member when the Stage clear records are being written, then your entry will be canceled.
- Entry will be canceled on failing to clear the Stage as well, and the Hero who participated in the battle can be used again. 

- Boss battles will go on for [c][8BFF23]60[-][/c] seconds.
- The Stage will be over if the Boss monster or the Player is taken down, or after 60 seconds pass and the battle results will be recorded.
- If the Base was already occupied while damage is being counted, then your entry will be canceled.
- The canceled entry’s results will not be recorded, and your Challenge Count will not be consumed.
- If you leave the Stage during the battle due to Network Error or other reasons, damage will not be counted and your Challenge Count will be consumed.
- But, your Challenge Count will not be consumed once a day for leaving the Stage during Battle. 
- Damage will not be counted after the Stage is over from the Round being finished.

Nell was born into slavery. Her mother was a slave of the bandit group, the Ravens. The bandits looked down on the slow and clumsy Nell, treating her like livestock. Her only talent lay in caring for babies. With her exceptionally strong maternal instincts, Nell took charge of looking after the infants the bandits had captured. It was only when caring for a child that she felt like a useful being.

One day, a new infant was entrusted to her. The baby was "Luna," a royal child kidnapped by the bandits. Nell fed, rocked, and cared for the baby as she always did. Luna's guardian, Klen, was also being held captive at the bandit stronghold, but Nell had no idea who he really was. Even when Klen personally approached her and suggested she become Luna’s wet nurse and leave the bandits, Nell did not understand the true meaning of his offer.

Although she refused, she was falsely accused of betraying the bandits by dreaming of the outside world and was placed in mortal danger. Even in her final moments, Nell tried desperately to protect Luna from the bandits.

Klen, deeming such a person useful, decided to revive her under the name "Nelluru." Nelluru was resurrected with a sturdy body. As Alicia put it, simply watching Nelluru take care of Luna brings a sense of happiness.

- Guardian Points can be acquired in Guardian Base Camp which unlocks after [c][FE902E]clearing World 2 quest The Iron Teatan[-][/c].
- As Guardian Level increases numerous bonus and special features will be unlocked.
- Special condition has to be fulfilled to increase Guardian Level at specific point.

- Same weapons will not be counted twice in the number of Exclusive Equipments and number of Exclusive Equipments' Limit Breaks.
- If you have a higher evolution grade than required then you will automatically fulfill the requirement.
- If you have a higher number of limit break for either Hero or Exclusive Equipment than required then you will automatically fulfill the requirement.

- There is a limit to Guardian Level. 
- Once reaching max level all leftover Guardian Points will disappear.
- After reaching max level, Guardian Points earned from Guardian Base Camp will convert to golds.

- You can engrave equipment using identical equipment or Epic Limit Breaking Hammers as material.
- Engraving increases the maximum level cap.
- Epic Limit Breaking Hammers can be used as material for engraving Epic Exclusive Equipment, while Legend Limit Breaking Hammers can be used as material for engraving Legend Exclusive Equipment.
- When using Exclusive Equipment that has already undergone Limit Break as engraving material, your equipment will only be engraved once and the material's remaining number of Limit Breaks will be returned in the form of the corresponding Exclusive Equipment.
- You cannot use Exclusive Equipment that have undergone Grade 6 evolution as engraving material.
- Upon equipment engraving, you can obtain 2 types of Engraving Options and 1 type of Engraving Sub-Option.
- You can Re-Engrave to change the Engraving Sub-Option.
- If you are not content with the Engraving Sub-Option you obtained through Re-Engraving, you may cancel Option Endowment.
- When Re-Engraving, if you use a different equipment as sub-material, the chances of an option appearing increases.
- The more you engrave, the higher your chances of obtaining a better Engraving Sub-Option.
- If you engrave 5 times, you will be guaranteed the Maximum Engraving Sub-Option.

Despite being raised in a conservative family, she was always concerned with social/economical equality. She often got in trouble for her progressive views during her knight training.

To circumvent this, Lapice started her adventures by disguising herself in a fancy dress as if she's attending snobby social events. She also developed an unique skill of masquerading weapons as harmless accessories. Because she is tall and has long arms and legs, she can attack unsuspecting enemies at distance.

- Yutnori is an event where you use Event Tokens to throw yut and move pawns to obtain various rewards.
- Event Tokens can be obtained by clearing Event Missions.
- When you throw yut, it will result in Do, Gae, Gul, Yut or Mo.
- If you roll Yut or Mo, you will have an additional chance to throw the yut. Event Tokens will not be used in this case.
- After throwing the yut, you can choose the pawn you'd like to move and move it.
- On the Yutnori board, there are tiles with Invaders and special rewards.
- If you stop on an Invader tile, you will catch the Invader and have an additional chance to throw the yut.
- If you stop on a tile with special rewards, you will obtain them immediately.
- When all pawns return to the starting point, you can enter the next round.

- Blue Lucky Pouches can be obtained by stopping on the tile or passing the starting point.

- Red Lucky Pouches can be obtained by fulfilling the following requirements.

10 by simultaneously passing the starting point with 1 pawn
25 by simultaneously passing the starting point with 2 pawns
40 by simultaneously passing the starting point with 3 pawns
100 by simultaneously passing the starting point with 4 pawns
100 when all 4 pawns pass the starting point
25 by catching the Invader

- The Tale of the Tetis Hero follows the heroes through various incidents that happen in the continent of Tetis.
- The stories within The Tale of the Tetis Hero become available as you progress through the stages, regardless of difficulty.
- The Tale of the Tetis Hero operates on a season-based basis, and each season consists of several rounds.
- A different element is designated to each day, and you can earn points by undergoing battles for each element. Sundays are an exception, as it alternates between the 6 elements.
- Scores earned through challenges will be retained until the round ends. You can earn First Clear Rewards and Repeat Rewards based on your highest score for each element.
- First Clear Rewards can be earned once for reaching each reward score and Repeat Rewards can be earned by spending Stamina through Sweep.
- As Repeat Rewards from Sweep, you can earn The Tale of the Tetis Hero Coins or Growth Resources such as Gold, Strengthening Hammers, and Mystery Equipment.
- Seasons will be archived after the last round has ended.
- Archived Seasons can be replayed at any time. You can earn First Clear Rewards by replaying them. However, you cannot earn Repeat Rewards and the Ranking Board will not be supported.

Stark is a warrior who serves as the vanguard in Frieren’s group.

Born in a warrior village, he lost everything when demons razed his homeland, leaving him an orphan. He was later taken in by the seasoned warrior Eisen, becoming his first disciple.

One day, during one fateful argument, Stark voiced his reluctance to fight monsters and, in the heat of the moment, was accidentally struck by Eisen's attack. This incident left him deeply traumatized. 

Despite this, Stark eventually earned the title of a village hero when he defended a settlement near Riegel Canyon from the fearsome Solar Dragon. Known for his soft heart and timid nature, he initially met Frieren while trembling in fear of the beast. Yet, after gathering his courage, Stark faced the Solar Dragon and defeated it with his own strength, even though his hands shook just like his master’s once had. From that point on, he joined Frieren on her journey.

Stark’s motivation for traveling with Frieren is to repay his debt to Eisen. As his master had grown too old to adventure himself, Stark resolved to return one day with stories of lighthearted and joyful travels—a gift to honor the man who raised him before he passes on.

Frieren is a mage of a peaceful era who has lived over 1000 years.

After her village was overtaken by demons, her master Flamme, taught her magic that would allow her to eliminate them.

She lived alone in a forest for a long time after Flamme’s death, until she was recruited by Himmel, Heiter and Eisen with the goal of vanquishing the Demon King. They journeyed for 10 years, went through countless adventures together and ultimately defeated the Demon King.

This journey with her comrades slowly brought about change in her heart. On the day of Himmel’s passing, Frieren expressed her regret over not getting to know him better despite knowing how briefly humans lived. This induced her to learn more about them. Since then, she has been travelling with Fern and Stark to the Land Where Souls Rest, Aureole, located in Ende, the northernmost tip of the continent, to speak to the deceased Himmel.

Just like her skills, Frieren herself is widely-known amongst demons. The mage who contributed significantly to the research and analysis of Zoltraak, the human killing magic, and has slain more demons than anyone else in history. Demons call her Frieren the Slayer.

Fern is a first-class mage and an apprentice of Frieren.

Fern, who lost everything and became an orphan during a past war, was on the verge of ending her own life by jumping off a ravine when she was saved by a priest named Heiter. Deeply respecting Heiter, who raised her, she sought to repay his kindness by learning to live independently. 

After receiving a staff from Heiter, Fern trained diligently under Frieren's guidance, never missing a single day. She surpassed a barrier that would normally take ten years for an average person to overcome in just four years, achieving her goal of piercing a boulder across the valley. Following Heiter’s passing, she sets off on a journey with her master, Frieren.

Fern possesses exceptional mana control and detection abilities, impressive enough to awe even long-lived elf races. She became the youngest mage in history to pass the third-class mage exam with the highest score. During the third test of the first-class mage exam, the Great Mage Serie, recognizing her talent, personally invited her to become her apprentice. However, Fern declined, firmly stating that Frieren was her only master.

- [Help] Reward is an additional reward you can obtain when you assist other players who are attempting to gain their [First Clear] Reward. Even if multiple players receive the [First Clear] Reward simultaneously, you will obtain only one [Help] Reward.

- You can engrave equipment using identical equipment or Epic Limit Breaking Hammers as material.
- Epic Limit Breaking Hammers can be used as material for engraving Epic Exclusive Equipment, while Legend Limit Breaking Hammers can be used as material for engraving Legend Exclusive Equipment.
- When using Exclusive Equipment that has already undergone Limit Break as engraving material, your equipment will only be engraved once and the material's remaining number of Limit Breaks will be returned in the form of the corresponding Exclusive Equipment.
- Upon equipment engraving, you can obtain 2 types of Engraving Options and 1 type of Engraving Sub-Option.
- You can Re-Engrave to change the Engraving Sub-Option.
- If you are not content with the Engraving Sub-Option you obtained through Re-Engraving, you may cancel Option Endowment.
- When Re-Engraving, if you use a different equipment as sub-material, the chances of an option appearing increases.
- The more you engrave, the higher your chances of obtaining a better Engraving Sub-Option.
- If you engrave 5 times, you will be guaranteed the Maximum Engraving Sub-Option.

Eugene is a movie star in Burywood.

Before she made her way into the stardom, she endured long and arduous period as a stunt double. She got her lucky break when the quirky director Vale discovered her for the action film "Bat Queen." The movie was an instant box office hit. She continued to work with Vale on "Queensman" which was another instant hit. 

Her career dwindled when she signed a contract with the infamous Invader Pictures, Inc. She had constant clash with the studio while shooting the film "War of Stars." The movie was eventually cancelled and her streak seemed to be over as well. Her career revived when she rejoined with Vale for the indie film "Guardian Story" where she played a young aspiring guardian.

Due to her roles as heroes, she has cemented her image as an honest and righteous hero. However, Eugene mentioned in one interview that she actually enjoys B rated gore/kaiju films and that she would love to play a villain.

She is known to be a very positive and hard working person. Because of her prolonged stunt career she is extremely durable, a master of various weapons, and an expert bike rider.

Nari is an eight-tailed fox sage.

She is born missing a tail and uses her bead to use magic. She grew up training with the nine-tailed fox, Garam. Because of her missing tail, she lacks magic powers and trained with the help of Garam. While in a long sleep in the form of a stone statue, she was awakened from desperate rituals and prayers from villagers asking for help.

She does want to allure everyone with her cute and adorable looks but detests being treated like a child. She bluntly plays the role of a cute kid, but when the opponent falls for it and treats her like one, she becomes instantly angry for thinking of her as a naive kid. Because of her short temper, she tends to be unexpectedly frank.

She may look like a child, but she has lived long ages. She speaks plainly to everyone and tends to blow on her own trumpet, which often makes her appear like a repulsive child. She's very wise and acts as the sage, helping humans in trouble. She also has old-fashioned taste compared to her looks. She likes "sweet and savory" butterscotch candy and prefers "hot" tea than cold drinks that make her tummy cold.

Gourry Gabriev is a descendant of the warrior who slayed the chimera Zanaffar. He’s a skilled swordsman who has no match among humans.

Gourry has looks that would make anyone’s head turn, but his intelligence is slightly lacking in contrast to his appearance. If a topic becomes even slightly complex, he fails to understand it. Gourry also doesn’t know common sense that even a child might have. However, he still remembers every little detail about Lina. 

Gourry’s a great glutton, but doesn’t like bitter foods like bell peppers and coffee. Even if a bell pepper is diced into little pieces and mixed in with other ingredients, he can pick them out with inhuman ability.

Gorun Nova, the Sword of Light, is the Gabriev family sword passed down for generations. It has the ability to change one’s willpower into a blade of light. It’s an amazing sword with an ability to deflect magic or absorb it. The sword can even channel powerful magic like Dragon Slave or Giga Slave. Lina Inverse covets this sword of light, but Gourry has managed to keep it from her clutches for now and is still using it.

Vishuvac is one of many avatars of the Fire Dragon King.

Following the treaty with humans, the Fire Dragon King sealed herself to suppress her powers while letting other fire dragons roam free. The successor of the king must isolate oneself from the world, which is Girgas, the son. Vishuvac and other avatars are looking for the runaway Girgas in the human world. Vishuvac is the only avatar who wants to free Girgas of his destiny. Unlike other avatars who are cold and rational, Vishuvac is filled with pity and isn't willing to push Girgas into the endless seclusion. Though she is in search of Girgas as her duty as an avatar, it's why she must find him before anyone else does. 

She loves and is loved by mortals. Her cordial and genuine character attracts humans, though it's considered an odd trait for dragons. Wherever Vishvac stops by, she leaves a trail of friends who remember her. She's obsessed with food, especially the goods and delicacies of human food. She favors exotic and spiced-filled foods but avoids all types of greens and raw foods.

- In Co-op Expedition, you can mainly earn gems and Co-op Expedition Coins that can be used in the Shop.
- [First Clear] Reward is obtained by clearing a stage for the first time.
- [Challenge] Reward is obtained by clearing stages from seasons with Challenge reward benefits. You can get Co-op Expedition Coins and High-grade Jewel Boxes once a week from each Challenge stage.
- [Random] Reward is obtained by clearing a stage through Random Entry.
- For [Random] rewards, there are [Daily Random] rewards and [Weekly Random] rewards.
- [Daily Random] You can obtain free gems once every day as a reward, and you will find vaults.
- Buy a vault key and open the vault to obtain Mid-grade Jewel Boxes.
- [Weekly Random] You can obtain Co-op Expedition Coins and Low-grade Jewel Boxes up to 14 times a week.
- [Help] Reward is an additional reward you can obtain when you assist other players who are attempting to gain their [First Clear] Reward. Even if multiple players receive the [First Clear] Reward simultaneously, you will obtain only one [Help] Reward.

- The Power Swing mini-game is played using Pickaxes obtained from Daily Pickaxe Missios.
- The Power-Swing mini-game deals damage to the Meteor to progress excavation. 
- The Power Swing’s damage will increase when the arrow is closer to the shining Perfect Zone.
- If you fail the swing for the Perfect Zone, then it will be expanded for the next attempt. 
- The Perfect Zone’s will be expanded upto 3 times, and it will aid in reaching the Perfect Zone. 
- If the Meteor is excavated during a Power Swing by other Guild members, then the excavation will be cancelled. 
- The canceled Power Swing’s damage will not be recorded and the Pickaxe will not be consumed. 
- Caution:  If you exit the Excavation Screen due to a Network Error, then damage will not be recorded and the Pickaxe will be consumed. 
- If the Excavation is over while the Power Swing button is pressed, then its damage will not be recorded.
- You can clear Daily Pickaxe missions when joining a new Guild, but you can’t play the Power Swing mini-game on the same day.

Bari is a disciple of the god of harvest. Her mission is to resurrect the burnt world tree by collecting happy memories from people.

Bari grants you one wish and takes your happiest memory away in return. The greater the wish, the bigger chunk of memories it'll cost. Bari always tries to remain distant to her clients to avoid getting involved with humans but often fails due to her compassionate nature. When she sees someone desperately in need but does not have enough happy memories, she chips in her own memory to grant the wish. You should not get frustrated if she doesn't remember you - it just means she cherished the memory with you and passed the happiness to another in need. 

She has two rules when granting wishes. One - if her client becomes greedy and attempts to exploit her, she will make sure the client pay for the sin whether it's by her own hand or by curse of mother nature. Two - she won't bring anyone back from dead. It always made clients' lives worse.

Tinia is a dancer/assassin active in Desert of Madness.

She works as a dancer by day but moonlights as one of the most effective assassins with her favorite bow. Her white hair and dress makes her shine as a dancer but also allows her to hide in moonlight when waiting for her target. She tries to keep her night job secret from her mother.

She has one rule - she'll only kill bad people. However, it doesn't take a lot of effort to convince her someone is bad due to her inherent naiveness. One time, she was convinced her target is evil because he uses twice as much toilet paper. In her own mind, she is a righteous superhero who punishes bad guys.

Tinia's parents separated when she was very young. Tinia went with her mother, and her sister went with her human father. Tinia misses them, but her mother never allows her to talk about them. She can't even remember what her sister looks like, but she often daydreams about having a miraculous reunion with her sister.

A statue of the Chosen One found in a Chosen One Believer’s corpse.
The following passage is densely written in small letters.

The blizzard of doom will blow, and the Frost Queen will emerge from the snow covered Mt.Shivering leading death with her. 
The Frost Queen’s steps will freeze the earths, and within the heavy blizzard monsters will follow. Only death will remain instead of life.
When the world meets its doom amidst blizzard and frost, a savior will arrive to those who didn’t lose faith and reclaim the light.

Because of the witch that meddles in us following the prophecy multiple times, I witnessed many of our brothers and sisters wither into red ice.
Forgive me for hesitating in fear in front of a great trial that I couldn’t handle.
I couldn’t find the trace of the witch despite taking steps forward with my rekindled faith.
Your guidance and protective light must have made that cruel witch leave far far away, Archpriestess.
Thank you!

- You can set up up to 8 heroes in your party.

A needle extracted from Saintess Clara’s body. A tremendous amount of mana emanates from the sharp point. The item is a lost body part of a Demon God, and it destroys anything it comes into contact with. If this was placed in one’s body it will destroy every single cell one by one and turn it into mush.

The archpriestess visited the woman every night. She abused and violated her frail body.
The holy power healed her wounds, but the repeated breakdown and regeneration of her body resulted in prolonging the woman’s pain.
Goddess and the Hero. She desperately called out for the ones who were her brightest light to rescue her, but her voice didn’t reach anywhere.
The prayers she repeated while weeping turned into cursing fate.
The woman couldn’t withstand the pain any further and let herself go.
Within the dirty room stained with blood and tears, the Saintess of The Chosen One raised her head amidst despair and resignation.

Marina is the youngest admiral of Adela Navy, a trusted ally of Kanterbury kingdom.

She lost her ship, Irmina, along with her crew to the invaders the day Kanterbury fell. The agony of losing her crew made her leave the navy and start  a one-woman crusade against the invaders.

Marina's fleet was known to be the best of Adela Navy. Her precise and quick directions allowed the fleet to release deadly barrage to any enemy. She is also well known for her powerful swordplay. Despite her small body, she wields swords almost as big as herself with incredible strength. With her signature hookshot, she can even throw ogres around.

She may look aloof and cold, but that doesn't mean she lacks passion. She's just selective when it comes to what she actually wants to focus on. In other words, don't expect any attention from her unless you can make yourself her priority.

- The Event Unexplored Expedition is a dungeon where you use three parties, each consisting of a single Party Leader, to defeat as many monsters as possible within the time limit and achieve a high score.
- You can play without limits during the event period. Once the event ends, a Claiming Period will be provided to exchange any remaining rewards at the Event Exchange.
- You can swap between your formed parties using Party Switching during battle. The game ends if all Party Leaders are defeated.
- Scores are calculated based on the remaining time, monsters defeated, surviving party members, and the number of times Party Switching was used. Achieve a high score to earn more Event Coins and Ranking Rewards!
- You will earn 1 Event Coin for every 16,800 points scored. You can earn up to 320 coins through gameplay, which can be spent at the Event Exchange.

Elvira is a rising star in the notorious crime syndicate, Reservoir Snakes.

Reservoir Snakes was founded by Elvira's grandma, who survived a traumatic wolf attack with her granddaughter. Traumatized by the incident, the grandma recruited private contractors armed with illegal weapons to protect her family. In such process, the grandma discovered her talent as a mafia boss and quickly evolved the small army into the biggest crime syndicate in Kanterbury. Elvira, longing for grandma's affection, became the member of the syndicate and hunts down anyone that came in its way. 

The syndicate is ruthless to failures. Any member who fails is disavowed and no one knows what happens to them. Naturally, Elvira's always bit on the edge. Her basket is no longer filled with delicious foods for her grandma. Instead, deadly explosives and firearms fill the void.

A orb holding the Frost Elder Dragon’s curse.
It now seems like a simple decorative item since there’s not a shred of mana left, but it’s a haunted object that makes the owner have nightmares.

The dragon that had its vengeance within its sights, was betrayed once again and failed.
The injured dragon no longer wished for its happiness.
No, it prayed for no one to be happy.

The dragon sacrificed its soul and wings for soaring across the skies to leave a dense curse behind.
Cursing the sisters, the children and Mt.Shivering.
The Dragon was sealed off, but the grudge and curse materialized into an orb.

Despair, and drown in sorrow.
For there’s no peace for thee.
Your betrayal done for your children will become fetters and choke your children…
The children of Mt.Shivering will hate each other and be loved by no one. Eternal night will fall.

- Players who can play Arena and Death Match can freely participate in Friendly Matches.
- Friendly Matches allow unlimited play in Arena and Death Match, regardless of time or number of matches.
- Battle in Friendly Matches follows the same basic rules as Arena and Death Match.
- Certain features, only adjustable in Friendly Matches, can be set by tapping the settings button below Random Entry or when creating a room.
- Random Entry allows you to easily match with other players in public rooms for a battle.
- Code Entry allows you to join a private room by entering a code for a match.
- Players can be kicked out for inattentive play in public rooms of Friendly Matches. However, they will not be banned.
- Players cannot be kicked out for inattentive play in private rooms of Friendly Matches.
- No rewards can be obtained from Friendly Matches.

- If you craft a super costume you already own, you will acquire a mystic thread you can use to exchange with a different super costume.
- You can exchange a blueprint you own for a blank blueprint.
- Crafting with a blank blueprint can craft any type of merch, but the chance to craft each merch is relatively low.

Lahn is a scrivener of the ancient scriptorium that records the history of the world.

Her family has been observing and recording the world since its beginning. They write in an ancient language whose letters channel powerful waves generated by the world's memory itself. As the latest of her bloodline, Lahn masterfully wields the letters both as a talented historian and as a powerful protector of the scriptorium. 

She uses archaic dialects and often talks as if she is writing poetry. Because people often misinterpret the trait as being smug, she secretly practices talking normally but has hard time grasping the concept of urban slangs.

She recently discovered her letters emanating unusually powerful waves. Sensing something drastic is occuring in the world, she ventured out of the scriptorium to witness the event with her own eyes.

She is both revered and feared by her crew. She is the most skilled soldier and at the same time the most unstable killer.

Arabelle spent her teenage in agony and pain, going through cruelest trainings and surgeries to replace body parts with machines.

Arabelle appreciates the Great Grandma for giving her power to take down the world. She cherishes the red hood that the grandma gave her. She is fiercely jealous of Elvira and competes with her every moment.

- Once per account, [SSR] Exclusive Equipment is guaranteed to appear in the first thirty Equipment Summons.
- If you haven't summoned an [SSR] Exclusive Equipment for 29 Equipment Summons, an [SSR] Exclusive Equipment will come out on 30th Equipment Summon.
- This rule no longer applies once you summon an [SSR] Exclusive Equipment within 29 Equipment Summons.
- This rule still applies if you summon a [SR] Exclusive Equipment within 29 Equipment Summons.

- The counting of the first thirty Summons is regardless of Pickup Event season period.

- Equal Stat Mode can be enabled in Friendly Matches for both Arena and Death Match.
- When Equal Stat Mode is enabled, the following adjustments are applied.
- Heroes' level and their equipment's level will be modified to level 115.
- Heroes' Level, Evolution, Limit Break, Awakening and Blessing are modified to the highest level.
- In the case of Myth or Ascended Heroes, all Awakening Nodes unlocked through Myth or Hero Ascent are modified to the highest level.
- The Evolution, Limit Break, Basic Options, owned Sub-Options, and Engraving Options of Heroes’ Equipment are modified to the highest level.
- However, in the case of Normal and Rare Relics, only the Basic Options and owned Sub-Options are modified to the highest level.
- Buffs from Guardian Level, Knowledge, and Heavenhold Buildings are modified to the highest level.

Idol captain Eva is the 19th captain of the guardians, who sings and dances in a cute diva dress.

Contrary to her usual strict and stern voice, her singing is nothing short of an angel. This is because she flows mana into her voice which also makes it deadly to her enemies. Even though she likes to sing, she is worried that it will make her look weak as a knight. She therefore puts on the diva dress and accessories to disguise herself as a mysterious idol before she sings. Of course, everyone in Kanterbury knows that the beautiful idol is captain Eva. 

Her singing has built a cult fan base. She sometimes announces a small concert for her fans, which always turns into a massive fan gathering. Free from her duty as a knight for the moment, she presents the fans, or rather, her companions beautiful songs & dances full of smiles.

Neva is a descendant of a legendary warrior tribe that hunts dragons.

Although she's from a tribe that considers dragons as enemies, she is a stubborn girl who wants to befriend dragons. Since her youth, she was taught that dragons were pure evil and prey to hunt, and she was trained by the best warrior in the tribe, her aunt. However, when she heard the tale of a hero who defeated the wicked magician alongside a dragon, she dropped the bombshell that she would befriend a dragon. She was cast off from her tribe and she embarked on a journey around the world to find a dragon friend, 

Bold and vigorous, capricious warrior. When she gets too excited, she would lose control and start swinging around her huge battleaxe. One can imagine how out of control Neva was when she met Girgas, a real dragon, for the first time in her life.

- You can form a party with up to 8 heroes.
- After clearing a floor, you can automatically challenge the next one using the auto play feature.
- The battle starts as soon as the challenge begins.
- Once heroes are deployed, they automatically use Weapon Skills and Chain Skills to fight.
- During battles, you can use energy, which is replenished regularly, to deploy heroes or use Guardian Spells that are available after a cooldown.
- If a deployed hero dies, they can be redeployed after a certain amount of time by spending slightly more energy.
- If you defeat all the enemies before your ally's Summoning Stone is destroyed, you successfully complete the challenge and move on to the next floor.
- As you continue with your battles, stronger enemies will appear. Use certain Season Artifacts and Guardian Spells to overcome them.

- Use clay, circuit board, dye, and blueprint to craft merch.
- Depending on which blueprint you use to start crafting, the required materials and crafting result can vary.
- Whichever blueprint you use to start crafting, there is a low chance super costume can be crafted.
- If you craft a super costume you already own, you will acquire a mystic thread you can use to exchange with a different super costume.
- You can exchange a blueprint you own for a blank blueprint.
- Crafting with a blank blueprint can craft any type of merch, but the chance to craft each merch is relatively low. 
- Crafting merch will take some time to complete after you start crafting merch.
- Receive All allows you to view all crafting results at once.
- If you use the crafting accelerator, you can immediately complete crafting and see the result.

- In Co-op Expedition, you can mainly earn Co-op Expedition Coins that can be used in the Shop.
- [First Clear] Reward is obtained by clearing a stage for the first time.
- [Weekly] Reward is obtained by clearing stages from seasons with weekly reward benefits. This reward can be obtained only once per stage every week.
- [Help] Reward is an additional reward you can obtain when you assist other players who are attempting to gain their [First Clear] Reward. Even if multiple players receive the [First Clear] Reward simultaneously, you will obtain only one [Help] Reward.
- [Random] Reward is obtained by clearing a stage through Enter Randomly. It can be earned up to 2 times per day.
- [Random] You will find vaults when obtaining rewards. Buy a vault key and open the vault to obtain additional Co-op Expedition Coins.

- You can set up up to 8 heroes in your party.
- You can freely place heroes by using their energy.
- You can start the battle whenever you are ready.
- Once the battle starts, your heroes will fight automatically. You can use Weapon Skills and Chain Skills manually depending on the settings.
- You can place additional heroes during battle.
- You will not be able to place a hero who has died or used up all their energy.
- The challenge ends when you clear the last stage, when all your heroes’ energy or HP is depleted, or when there are enemies still alive after the timer runs out.
- You can earn loot by clearing stages.
- Loot can be divided into two types: those that have an ongoing effect when in your possession, and those that have an immediate effect when selected. Some are also both types at the same time.

Lupina is the legendary ice witch of the innuit tribe.

She is notorious for her cruelty and fickleness. She appears every once in decades and hunts people for pleasure. When she invades, the land suffers endless blizzard and snowstorms. If you dare to go out hunting in that weather, believe me, it will be you who gets hunted. She treats her victims in a variety of ways. Sometimes she would simply let them go. But most other times, she becomes very creative with killing the victims slowly and painfully. Every innuit folklore includes Lupina as a villain in some form.

She enjoys her infamy very much. She carefully calculates her reappearances so that her name will be never forgotten among people. She searches her name on web everyday. Her favorite keywords are "Lupina witch," "Lupina hot," and "Lupina cosplay."

- You can acquire artifacts in various stages such as winning a battle stage or purchasing it in Agatha's Shop stage.
- You can carry maximum of 8 artifacts. Once you have the maximum amount, you'll have to switch one of your existing artifacts with a new one if you wish to obtain it.
- When you have many artifacts of same effect, the effects will be stacked.
- Some effects, such as Heal, Shield, Crit Hit Chance, will be applied up to 100% according to their basic principle of application.
- When finishing a challenge, all your artifacts will be returned.

Red Ice made from the Ice Witch’s mana.

She made an oath to become a sentry, who will stop anyone approaching the Queen who sacrificed her own soul to become the bind’s core.
However, time passed, and the dragon and the binds were forgotten.
The treasure nobody coveted and changed children.
The endless mission, survivor’s guilt, and loneliness from being alone.
The witch broke down more and more.

One day, an Innuit stepped foot onto the binding site by chance, and the witch accidentally froze her.
However, for the already broken witch, she didn’t feel guilt, but rather felt stimulation.
The witch’s ice whiter than the permanent snow atop Mt.Shivering was stained crimson.
The mother who treasured her children more than anyone had now become the most frightening hunter.

- Guilds that are occupying fortresses will participate in Defense Battles.

This time, a freshman sent a ghost story! Shall we read it?

Last Wednesday, I was hiding in the greenhouse after skipping my astrology class.
I could see the outside from the greenhouse, so I was going to run when someone came near me.
But all of a sudden, I started hearing the sound of high heels.
I couldn't see anyone, but the tapping sound of high heels got closer.
When I was shivering in fear with my eyes closed, the greenhouse door opened.
"Student, are you skipping class right now?"
...a Teatan professor was there...
She was so short I couldn't see her coming.
As the punishment of skipping class, I'm cleaning the bathroom on the second floor all this month.

Well... different from what I expected, but still scary...
To have to clean the bathroom for a month....

- Starting from the Master tier, your Trophy Points decrease if you lose a game.
- Depending on the difference in Trophy Points between matched users, winning a game can earn you additional Trophy Points.
- Starting from the Diamond 3 tier, the additional Trophy Points you earn from the difference in Trophy Points gradually decrease.
- Starting from the Master tier, depending on the difference in Trophy Points between matched users, either the Trophy Points earned from winning decrease or the Trophy Points lost from losing increase more significantly.
