- In Co-op Expedition beta, you can mainly earn Co-op Expedition Coins that can be used in the Shop.
- [First Clear] Reward is obtained by clearing a stage for the first time.
- [Weekly] Reward is obtained by clearing stages from seasons with weekly reward benefits. This reward can be obtained only once per stage every week.
- [Help] Reward is an additional reward you can obtain after clearing all Normal Stages and when you assist other players who are attempting to gain their [First Clear] Reward. Even if multiple players receive the [First Clear] Reward simultaneously, you will obtain only one [Help] Reward. This reward can be claimed up to 3 times per day.
- If you clear stages through Enter at Random, you can earn Co-op Expedition Coins up to 5 times per day.

- Equal Stat Mode can be enabled in Friendly Matches for both Arena and Death Match.
- When Equal Stat Mode is enabled, the following adjustments are applied.
- Heroes' Level, Evolution, Limit Break, Awakening and Blessing are modified to the highest level.
- In the case of Myth or Ascended Heroes, all Awakening Nodes unlocked through Myth or Hero Ascent are modified to the highest level.
- The Level, Evolution, Limit Break, Basic Options, owned Sub-Options, and Engraving Options of Heroes’ Equipment are modified to the highest level.
- However, in the case of Normal and Rare Relics, only the Basic Options and owned Sub-Options are modified to the highest level.
- Buffs from Guardian Level, Knowledge, and Heavenhold Buildings are modified to the highest level.

- There are Battle stages and Event stages.
- Battle stages are divided into Normal, Elite, and Boss Battle. Each battle differs in difficulty and the amount of reward.
- Event stages are divided into Agatha's Shop, Resting Area, and Special Event Stage. You can experience different events of your choice.
- Clearing Boss Battle each floor grants you Kamazon Event Points as floor clear rewards.
- Floor clear rewards can be earned once for each difficulty within the season.
- If you did not earn the same floor clear reward for the difficulty easier than the difficulty you are on, you will be granted the reward for the lower difficulty as well.
- Clearing the last floor will also grant you a special reward.
- You can use Kamazon Event Points to obtain event rewards.

- You can participate in Meteor Excavations and obtain individual excavation rewards, and Guild excavation rewards. 
- Individual Excavation rewards: each time you start an excavation, Gold, Exp, or Strengthening Hammer will be given. 
- Guild Excavation rewards: For each completed Meteor excavation, all Guild members will obtain the excavated Meteor’s core. 
- There are Option Change Stone cores, Gold cores, Exp cores, Strengthening Hammer cores, and Mix cores that have both Exp and Strengthening Hammers.
- Gold cores, Exp cores, Strengthening Hammer cores, and Mix cores may vary in damage required to excavate, but give similar amounts of rewards.
- When all meteors are excavated, spare Pickaxes will automatically be converted and given as individual rewards.

- Battles proceed in auto-battle, and you can set up your party members' positions before each battle.
- You lose a battle if all party members faint and become unable to battle.
- When the time is up, all party members faint and become unable to battle and you lose the battle.
- Even if you lose a battle, all damages inflicted on the monsters are maintained.
- If you abnormally close a stage during a battle, all monsters and Heroes' HP returns to before the battle.
- If you win Battle stages, you acquire silver coins according to each stage's difficulty.
- If you win Battel stages, you choose an artifact as your loot.
- Clearing Elite or Boss Battle will grant you a higher chance to collect a higher grade of artifact than clearing a Normal battle stage.

- Free-For-All Mode is a mode where 6 users battle one another individually and the last person standing wins the most Trophy Points.
- When a hero faints, a new hero is revived after 5 seconds, and until then you may freely switch heroes. Revived heroes are invincible for 2 seconds.
- Fainted heroes cannot be used again, and when all 3 heroes faint you are eliminated.
- Eliminated users can observe the players that are still alive, or choose to leave.
- If you take down an opponent’s hero during battle, you earn a 20% Atk increase effect and your HP is restored by 15%.
- If you open up a box during battle, you earn a 20% Atk increase effect.
- If the hero faints, this Atk increase effect is reduced by half.
- The Atk increase effect total cannot exceed 200%.

- Use clay, circuit board, dye, and blueprint to craft merch.
- Depending on which blueprint you use to start crafting, the required materials and crafting result can vary.
- Whichever blueprint you use to start crafting, there is a low chance super costume can be crafted.
- If you craft a super costume you already own, you will acquire a mystic thread you can use to exchange with a different super costume.
- You can exchange a blueprint you own for a blank blueprint.
- Crafting with a blank blueprint can craft any type of merch, but the chance to craft each merch is relatively low. 
- Crafting merch will take some time to complete after you start crafting merch.
- If you use the crafting accelerator, you can immediately complete crafting and see the result.

- In the Capture Area Mode, the team achieving the target score by occupying the Capture Area will achieve victory.
- You can begin occupying the Capture Area by standing on the platform. If both teams are attempting to occupy it, then the team with more people in the Capture Area will occupy it.
- Points will be obtained based on the number of Capture Areas occupied after a certain time has passed.
- If the target score is not obtained by both teams within 120 seconds, the team with the higher score wins. If there’s a tie, then the team with more occupied Capture Areas will win when the game is over.
- Taking down heroes will not give points, and bounties will not apply.
- Statistics modifications and fever time will apply  the same as the standard mode.

- Raid battle stages last for 60 seconds. 
- If the time is up, or either the monster or the player gets defeated, the battle stage ends and the damage is recorded. 
- If another Guild member has already defeated the monster when your damage is about to be recorded (that is, when your battle stage ends), your entry is cancelled. 
- If your entry is cancelled, the damage you inflicted on the monster will not be recorded and your Daily Entry will not be consumed.
- When your battle shuts down due to network failure, damage is not recorded but your Daily Entry will be consumed. 
- However, if you deviate from the stage, your Daily Entry will not be consumed {0} times per day. 
- When the battle stage ends after the season ends, the damage will not be recorded.

Xellos introduces himself as the mystery priest, but he’s actually a high-ranking mazoku. He serves under one of the five subordinates, the Greater Beast.

Like his self introduction he’s a figure veiled in mystery. Many have attempted to figure out his identity and intentions, but the only response they got from him was “that’s a secret”.

Xellos uses negative emotions of life forms like fear, hate and depression as nourishment just like other mazoku. He extremely detests positive emotions such as love, and friendship.

Xellos is known to be the most powerful mazoku excluding the 5 subordinates. He exterminated thousands of dragons during the Koma War in the past. Due to this incident, Xellos is a feared entity among the elves and dragons.

Eva is the 19th captain of the guardians.

Born weak but talented in magic, everyone expected Eva will become a wizard. However, she chose to become a guardian against the odds. With exceptional leadership and chivalry, she quickly rose to captain. She completely transformed the guardians into the strictly merit based hierarchy where anyone, whether he/she is a noble or a peasant, can rise to higher ranks. The reform evolved the guardians into the most competitive and powerful knights in the world. She is dedicated to keep the guardians strong, to protect Kanterbury from any threat.

Such loyalty to the kingdom has earned her immense trust from queen Camilla and the royal family. She is not only a trusted servant but also a good friend to them.

Lavi is a demon attending the magic school as an exchange student. The queen of devildom sent Lavi and her twin brother Favi as a part of a talent exchange program between the human world and devildom, hoping they would learn the delicate ways of human wizardry.

While she is exceptionally talented at defense spells, she technically doesn't understand to cast them. She just intuitively uses them for brawls she often gets into. She hopes to become the ultimate fighting champion of the world much to the dismay of the devil queen (who is, by the way, funding her tuition).

She loves her brother but gives him a hard time because... well, because it's her brother. But she won't think twice to risk herself to help him in any situation.

A secret location discovered by a delinquent student while skipping class one day. Though it appears to be an ordinary, empty space, rumors have spread that it grants the wishes of anyone who enters.

Intrigued by these rumors, many Magic School students have tried to find a way inside, but the exact method remains a mystery. Baseless speculations abound, such as rubbing the wall three times or imitating the voice of a ghost.

However, according to the testimony of a delinquent student who recently claimed to have entered the room, it was filled with countless ghosts who desperately tried to drive him out. Perhaps the ones making wishes in that room weren't the students, but the ghosts who had resided there since long ago.

- Guilds that aren't occupying any fortresses will participate in Siege Battles.
- During Prep Rounds, Guild Masters or Sub Masters must designate a target fortress for the Siege Battle. If no target is selected before the round ends, one will be assigned at random.
- During Combat Rounds, Guild members will play gate stages and attack the Fortress Core.
- The damage dealt to the fortress by Guild members is totaled and recorded as the Guild’s individual score. The combined scores of all participating Guilds form the overall Siege Score.
- If the Siege Score exceeds the Defense Score at the end of the Combat Round, the fortress is seized, and ownership is granted to the Guild with the highest Guild Score.

Numerous tiny ice crystals piled up in front of an empty cave.
The concentrated mana held within the crystals makes it faintly glow even in dark places.

As the dragon recovered its strength, the cold from Mt.Shivering spread across the continent.
The dragon placed its children on the front lines and planned its revenge.
The dragon’s grudge was heavy and the sisters couldn’t persuade it.
The sisters were the dragon’s wives, but they were also mothers of their children.
While the dragon slept, the sisters’ mana began to bind the dragon.
The dragon awoke too late, and struggled to free the binds, but nothing changed.
Only the dragon’s roar filled with betrayal and helplessness filled the mountain.

A piece of fabric made of fancy silk. It is used to drape over one’s face. Covering one’s face symbolizes one’s dissociation with the world and attachment to the heavens.

When the world was peaceful, a lone woman believed that the world’s end was approaching.
This belief was not backed by evidence, but the woman was sure to a point of peculiarity, and was steadfast in her convictions despite people’s denunciations.
Therefore, she was chosen.
The prophecy came to the woman and showed her an illusion of the future. The woman, filled with joy, bolted out of her house barefoot.
And she did not return.
To the woman, who received an assertive answer, the past was nothing more than a worthless shell.

Fight Club is Demon World’s private combat arena.
There are numerous objects placed in the area, but its structure is designed to allow the distance to be closed quickly. Therefore, you cannot just keep fleeing.
There’s not one hero type that holds an advantage. Choosing the right time to attack and evade will lead to victory.
Fight Club’s motto is street fighting, and is making an uproar within the boring lives of Demon World citizens. Fight Club’s special rulings allowing fouls are causing endless injuries and casualties. Demon World’s police are cracking down and making busts, but Fight Club continues in secret at Demon World’s alleyways, waiting for newcomers to entertain the audience.

The ice witch carefully picks out her outfit before going on the hunt. A wide assortment of beautiful garments allows her to enjoy the hunt more.
A man and woman who climbed the mountain to collect herbs became the ice witch’s first prey. The man who left the frozen woman behind and ran away also met the same fate. His final words: “No”.
The ice witch’s second prey was a man in armor, but her hunt failed due to a missed attack. The ice witch demanded her failure be omitted from the records.
The ice witch’s third hunt was for a trapped young couple. They started to bicker amongst each other once the ice witch offered to spare only one of them. [b]In the end  both of them met their demise.[/b]

Sohee is a gifted student of magic school.

She actually doesn't have a shred of talent in magic, but understands the inner workings of magic better than anyone. By combining her understandings of magic and science, she has pioneered a new field of study called "magitech".

Although no one can deny she is smart, she isn't exactly the most sociable person around. She openly expresses how less evolved other people are and loves to correct other people. - Kama-ZONE is the dungeon of ancient ruins, run by Kamazon as a theme park. 
- Heroes' HP will not be restored after clearing a Kama-ZONE stage.
- Instead, you can get enhanced effects with special artifacts only available in Kama-ZONE.
- There are 8 floors in Kama-ZONE.
- Manage your Heroes' HP and try to clear the last floor.
- Kama-ZONE's contents change every time you challenge it.
- After attempting the challenge as many times as you like, you can end it and start a new one.
- You can claim rewards based on your highest record cleared this season by using Kama-ZONE entry tickets.
- Clear event missions to obtain Kama-ZONE entry tickets.
- You cannot enter Kama-ZONE when it is not in season.

Plitvice is a goddess of war.

She controls fire at will. She isn't at her full power as the tree of life was burnt down 500 years ago. But she is still a formidable warrior that can make any foe tremble. She appears authoritative. In fact, she's obsessed with looking that way. Perhaps, it's an over compensation for being a young goddess who is actually quite sloppy. She was sealed away in Heavenhold, waiting for the arrival of a worthy champion.

In her long life, she lost many loved ones. She even lost contact with her faithful servant, Angie, while she was sealed away. Making new friends is exciting but also terrifying to her. After all, it is highly probable that she'll outlive most of them.

The Tiara of the Spider Swarm’s queen Arachne.
The Tiara is the symbol of a queen and the ritual chief.

The tree’s ruin took mother’s holiness.
We, who could no longer share our consciousness, couldn’t communicate like new born children.
We suffered and cried, but didn’t leave our mother’s side.

Mother embraced us and began singing a lullaby to her children in a sorrowful tone.
The merciful singing lets us forget our pain and fall into a deep sleep.
Mother watched us and began to prepare for a long wait to return to her original form.

Like in ancient times, the tree will grow again.
Until then, we shall fall into an eternal dream and bide our time.

Since their ordinary lives have been deeply damaged by the cultists, some Desert Elves became bandits and make their living plundering innocent citizens. They tried to train themselves with gunnery in this field but it wasn't so successful, and the site has remained abandoned ever since.

To enter a stage, you must have at least one Hero formation that meets the stage requirements.
You can enter Public Rooms and Private Rooms from the Normal Stage information screen.
Random Entry randomly places you into a Public Room for any Normal Stage you have already cleared.
Public Room entry and Random Entry for Normal Stages use only the Hero in the first slot of each class in your Hero formation.
Public Rooms can only be entered during the designated Public Room entry time.
Challenge Stages can only be entered via Private Rooms.
For Private Rooms in Challenge Stages, you can register your room to the list to play with other players.

- Owned Awakening Stones can be converted or synthesized to different Awakening Stones.
- You can choose the exchange method by pressing Exchange or Synthesize
- Each Awakening Stone can be converted or synthesized within the daily limit.
- The daily limit is reset each day at 00:00.
- For Conversion, Awakening Stones are changed to another type within the same grade.
- Conversion is done in a 1:1 ratio, and consumes gold.
- Synthesis consumes Awakening Stones as material to exchange them to one with a higher grade.
- Exchange ratios for Synthesize is different, and you can check each one when selecting the Awakening Stone for Synthesis.

- Once per account, Epic Exclusive Equipment is guaranteed to appear in the first thirty Equipment Summons.
- If you haven't summoned an Epic Exclusive Equipment for 29 Equipment Summons, an Epic Exclusive Equipment will come out on 30th Equipment Summon.
- This rule no longer applies once you summon an Epic Exclusive Equipment within 29 Equipment Summons.
- This rule still applies if you summon a Legend Exclusive Equipment within 29 Equipment Summons.
- The counting of the first thirty Summons includes Pickup Summon and non-Pickup Summon as a whole.
- The counting of the first thirty Summons is regardless of Pickup Event season period.

- The first user to reach 10 Frenzy Points wins 1st place, and the remaining users will be ranked based on their Frenzy Scores.
- If no user reaches the Target Frenzy Score within the time limit, rankings will be determined by the users' Frenzy Scores.
- If the Frenzy Score is a tie, the user with the higher Highest Frenzy Score will be ranked higher.
- If the Highest Frenzy Score is also a tie, the user who reached the score first will be ranked higher.
- If the time taken to reach the score is also the same, all tied users will share the same rank.
- Victory is granted to ranks 1 through 3, whereas ranks 4 through 6 result in defeat.

The Dungeon Kingdom Octagon is an arena where mercenaries, who come from all over Tetis to defeat the Ancient Demon, challenge each other to prove their skills.

Among Dungeon Kingdom's various arenas, the Octagon gained its name due to its unique eight-sided structure.

Scattered throughout the arena are various mechanisms that reward the clever and punish the reckless. One might seize victory by strategically maneuvering an opponent into a pool of molten lava, or fall victim to the very same traps.

Mercenaries unanimously agree that there’s nothing quite like a glass of sparkling barley tea after a grueling battle in the Octagon.

Originally from Canada, she was hit by a truck one day and was thrown into the world of Kanterbury. She was initially excited in the hopes of becoming a hero, like many other dimensional travelers in comics do. But all she ever faced was threats after threats - monsters, dungeons, and humans. Craig is a D-list warrior in Dungeon Kingdom.

For 20 years he's been training to win the infamous dungeon race - the race held every 5 years to defeat resurrected archfiends at the lowest level of the dungeon. He never had any luck with the races and works as a bouncer in a local pub. The thought that his life will never amount to anything gives him the worst nightmare. - Selecting the Co-op(Defense) Tier will begin the matching with players who chose the same Tier.
- If tier is selected at Joint Matching, then you will be matched with all players within Joint Matching.
- Each player chooses 1 owned hero to enter the stage. The selected hero can be reselected during player-matching.
- After a certain amount of time passed or if all players are ready, the battle will begin.
- If there are fewer than 4 players participating in the Co-op(Defense), player stats are increased in proportion to the number of missing players.
- There are no limits in the number of Co-op(Defense) you can play.

Yuze is a succubus adventurer.

It is customary for a succubus to take a career in dream therapies or show business these days. After all, they need men's energy to survive. However, Yuze always held unmatched curiosity towards the outer world. The stories of dragon slayers always excited her more than that of a popular actress. Despite concerns from those around her, she made a bold choice to become an adventurer.

Despite having a pure adventuring soul, she still is a succubus. She often says things that may make others' faces red without realizing. Her innocent actions are often misconstrued as being seductive.

- Player-matching starts once you choose a Co-op Tier, among players that have chosen the same Tier. 
- If tier is selected at Joint Matching, then you will be matched with all players within Joint Matching.
- Each player chooses 1 owned hero to enter the stage. The selected hero can be reselected during player-matching.
- After a certain amount of time or if all players are ready, all players enter the stage together.
- If there are fewer than 4 players participating in the Co-op, player stats are increased in proportion to the number of missing players.
- There are no limits in the number of Co-op you can play.

- If a boss is defeated within 60 seconds, Carry Over Mode will activate and your Carry Over Party will be saved.
- The Carry Over Party can additionally attack the boss for the obtained Carry Over Time.
- Carry Over Time cannot exceed 60 seconds, and Carry Over Mode will not activated for defeating the boss within the Carry Over Time.
- You can select the Carry Over Party before entering the Guild Raid Stage.
- The Carry Over Party will be placed  behind the 8th party. When the Carry Over Party is selected, the number will turn green.
- Carry Over Mode will be disabled after entering the Guild Raid Stage once.

- Guardian Spells allow you to directly intervene in ongoing The Tale of the Tetis Hero challenges.
- Each Guardian Spell has different cooldowns and abilities.
- Guardian Spells range from those that can be equipped from the start to those that can be acquired through Season Specialties.
- Guardian Spells come in three types: instant-cast that activate immediately upon pressing, area-of-effect that can be used by dragging to specify an area, and hero-targeted that can be used on specific heroes. 
- Only one Guardian Spell can be equipped at a time, and you must have a Guardian Spell equipped to enter a stage.

- The Exclusive Equipment Slot has 4 effects: maximum Level, maximum Limit Break, maximum Options, and maximum Engraving.
- Each effect opens up based on the weapon level, the number of different Epic Exclusive Weapons owned, the total number of Limit Breaks applied to Epic Equipment you own, and the number of engraved Epic Exclusive Weapons owned.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.

- You can extract mystical Magic Metals from Equipment.
- You can extract Magic Metals only from Grade 5 Equipment. 
- You can extract 300 Magic Metals from Grade 5 Epic Exclusive Equipment.
- You can extract 100 Magic Metals from Grade 5 Legend Exclusive Equipment. 
- When you extract Exclusive Equipment or Epic Equipment, you'll receive rewards corresponding to each Equipment's number of Limit Break.

- You can extract a maximum of 25 Equipment at a time. 
- You cannot extract from Locked Equipment. 
- Extracted Equipment cannot be retrieved.

- The 'Slime Juice on Sale!' event challenges you to sell Slime Juice to customers within a time limit.
- Customers order various juices, each requiring different ingredients.
- You can check Slime Juice recipes in the Recipe Book.
- Successfully serving a customer earns Slime Coins, and first-time visitors during the event become SNS followers.

The historic first game of Arena was held in the Stadium.
You can use different walls to establish your battle strategy.
The Stadium is favorable to Heroes who can hit enemies over the walls or throw projectiles through the walls.
Long in the past, numerous people lost their fortune and lives fighting in illegal Arenas. The wise king of the Kanterbury kingdom, King Lili publicized the Arena to resolve the issue. Challengers got to compete fairly in hygienic fields, while the battle grew even more intense thanks to healing spells. The public Arena became a mega hit, and spread across the world in no time.

Ancient ruins are deep inside the forest with remnants of uncharted buildings.
Using the many pillars and narrow paths, you can come up with numerous strategies. 
Heroes who can attack over the walls or throw projectiles through the walls will have the upper hand. 
Ancient ruins with numerous pillars arranged in a seemingly mysterious way were enough to attract adventurer's curiosity. To unravel the secrets of the ruins, many adventurers head to the ruins in the forest, but none came back. Since then, adventurers heading the ruins deteriorated, and the ruins were gradually erased from people's memories.

Louis, CEO of Louis Industries.
A 55-year-old human male. Cause of death: asphyxiation due to airway compression.
His defense firm, Louis Industries, made a fortune after the Demon World Civil War and is infamous for ruthless, by-any-means tactics—such as seizing [b]Engineer Norton[/b]'s android technology patents.
He also arranged for [b]Pianist Linia[/b] to break off the [b]Ashika family[/b]'s marriage talks, causing them losses. Perhaps as a result, Linia has since retired as a pianist.
Rumor has it he abandoned his [b]own daughter[/b] in Tetis and fled to the Demon World, but the truth is unclear.

Sunday is a horse-shaped monster that received the blessing of the sun.

Its red mane is reminiscent of the sun, but the heat and light it emits depends on one's Friendship Level with it. The closer one is with Sunday, the weaker the light and heat it gives off. But, if you are not so close with Sunday, the light and heat that it gives off gets so strong that it becomes difficult to look at with the naked eye, and can even risk causing a fire.

Due to this trait, Sunday is considered a good riding monster to those who have built a strong trust with it as they are able to experience a pleasant warmth.

He disguises as a prominent court wizard and charges an expensive fee for his service. In reality, he dropped out of the magic school when his former noble family fell to poverty. Some may say he's a victim of circumstances, but even they can't deny how talented Dolf is as a con man. His natural charm and fluent talking skills produced many blissfully ignorant customers for him.

Although he dropped out, Dolf is still an exceptional wizard. Perhaps, if he was given enough time he would have made a great court wizard. He travels with his mercenary partner, Amy.

Hekate is a veteran freelancing sniper.

The only thing that matters to her is money and money alone. She finds pleasure in lavishly spending the money she earned. She is proudly obsessed with luxuries. After all, what is life without spending? She loves her job as a sniper. She's good at it. It earns good money. And she's a person who can forget the guilt with luxuries.

She is cynical as a result of spending too much time in warzone, but not too cynical to repel people. In fact, the right blend of cynicalness and wit typically makes her popular. Young girls especially tend to look up to her.

Shapira is a knight of Rah empire and a servant to its princess, Aisha.

She swore her life to protect the princess and always stood by her. Shapira can be a bit overprotective, as she still sees Aisha as a fragile baby. Aisha hates this, but Shapira can't help it. Shapira's face is always ice cold since her smiles are reserved for the princess and the princess only.

She is strict, stern, and always serious about everything. If someone makes a joke about her, she'll throw him a gauntlet for a duel. If someone makes a joke about Aisha, she'll make sure there is a new entry in Rah's graveyard.

Of course hypothetical but this Jercule Pierrot, had my life been just a little more off, I'd be paying my rent through contract murder.
Well I mean, I won't be sneaking in anywhere or using my splendid combat skills.
I won't even need to.
Because, this Jercule Pierrot, people die off whenever I go on vacation!
Cases of murder follow me around whenever I leave the town, and it really is a miracle that I'm not in jail yet.
So my dear residents of the Dungeon Kingdom, please take special care next week.
I've decided to watch the Dungeon race in the Dungeon Kingdom for my vacation this time.

Ranpang is a boss of Dragon Talon Clan rooted in the city of Shen.

Ranpang's stuffed dragon costume is not for kids. The dragon costume not only intimidates the most brave opponents but serves as a perfect armor to deflect any attack. Or that's at least what Ranpang thinks.

Dragon Talon Clan aims to conquer Shen and eventually dominate the world. This ruthless clan brainwashes the poor by distributing food for them or raises people's blood sugar level by slipping candies into their supplies. People of Shen tremble at the cruelty of the clan. Or that's at least what Ranpang thinks.

- Players in a Co-op tier clear quests one by one together.
- Fainted players can help the remaining players as a ghost.
- Challenge succeeds if one or more players clear the last room of the Co-op tier.
- Challenge fails when all players are defeated.
- Monster Level will be adjusted automatically to respond to the participating players’ tiers and levels. 
- For Joint Matching, each player’s level will be adjusted based on the participating players’ tiers and levels.
- Dungeon difficulty will be regularly adjusted to respond to new contents or expansion of Hero maximum level.

- Through Progression Skip, once certain rounds of an ongoing Guild Raid are reached, some early rounds of the following Guild Raid will be skipped.
- Progression Skip consists of two phases.
- The first Progression Skip is applied when you reach Round {0} in an ongoing Guild Raid. This enables the following Guild Raid to start from Round {1}.
- The second Progression Skip is applied when you reach Round {2} in an ongoing Guild Raid. This enables the following Guild Raid to start from Round {3}.
- You will obtain the Defeat Rewards for skipped rounds when the new Guild Raid begins.

- Events are available during specific seasons, and you can collect Event Points in Event Stages.
- Get various rewards with the Event Points you have collected.
- After the Event season ends, you can still collect unclaimed rewards during checkout period.
- You cannot play Event Stages but still can collect unclaimed Point Rewards during checkout period.
- You can continue playing Event Story stages when it's moved to the Side Story after the checkout period.
- Stage levels may be modified once it's moved to the Side Story.
- Event Rift stages will not be moved to the Side Story.

- Frenzy Mode is a mode where 6 users battle one another individually to take each other down and rack up Frenzy Points. The first player to reach 10 Frenzy Points will earn the most Trophy Points.
- If defeated by L-Bacteria or other objects on the map, your Frenzy Points will be deducted.
- When a hero faints, a new hero is revived after 5 seconds, and until then you may freely switch heroes. Revived heroes are invincible for 2 seconds.
- Heroes can be revived an unlimited number of times, even after being knocked out.
- Defeating an enemy hero in battle restores 15% of your HP.

- To start matching for a stage, you must have at least one hero that meets the stage requirements.
- In the Stage Information screen, you can create a public room or join an existing public room.
- In the Stage Information screen, you can create a private room that is only accessible via Room Codes or Friend Invites.
- Enter at Random allows you to randomly enter a public room of a Normal Stage you already cleared.
- The Challenge Stages can only be matched through private rooms.
- You can play Challenge Stages with other players in private rooms by adding the room to the list.

- Arena provides a battlefield to fight against other players with a team of 3 Heroes.
- Each battle is 1-on-1 duel that lasts for 30 seconds.
- Each Hero participates in the battle in their appointed order.
- If you open up a box during the battle, your Atk increases by 10%.
- Arena seasons last for a week.
- Getting a match costs a ticket, and you get 5 Reward Tickets daily.
- You earn Trophy Points and Battle Medals for the result of a match entered with a Reward Ticket.
- You earn Trophy Points but no Battle Medals for the result of a match entered with an Entry Ticket.

Someone sent me a story!
What kind of scary story is it this time?

Last night, I was lying down with my eyes closed to sleep...
It felt like someone was looking at me...
I was scared, so scared, and when I opened my eyes...
I saw Erina-chan with her long hair in front of me!
Hehe, Erina-chan, do you like watching me sleep?
That's why I always sleep with Erina-chan standing next to me!
Erina-chan, another lovely day with you!

This... this isn't a scary story, it's just a story!
I'm not a radio DJ!
Besides, why do you sleep with your pillow standing next to you! It's weird!

I received a ghost story just now!

I am a student who lives in room 9 on the second floor of the dormitory.
I've been hearing...this mysterious whisper every night.
I was wondering who was whispering, so I followed the sound...
And, the whisper was coming from room 14 on the second floor!
You know, No one lives in that room because it's been rumored to be haunted!

Uh... wait... a whisper from room 14 on the second floor of the dorm?
Ahaha... that... I think that's me. I wanted to read ghost stories in a more plausible atmosphere late at night.
Sorry if I scared anyone!

- Boss Rush lasts for 2 weeks, with powerful boss monsters as enemies.
- Boss Rush consists of 3 Steps.
- At the start of the challenge, you can progress from Step 1 to Step 3.
- You can enter a Boss Monster Stage with the difficulty of your choice for each Step.
- Once you finish the battle with a Boss Monster, you will obtain a score based on the battle results.
- Once you complete all the battles up to the Boss Monster of Step 3, the Challenge will be finished.
- When the Challenge is finished, each Step’s score will be added up and your record will be determined.

- Season Rewards are accumulated based on the highest tier cleared.
- However, there are no rewards for clearing Champion Tier.
- Rewards for Joint Matching will be based on the participating player’s level. 
- Current Rewards will be based on records of 3 heroes that cleared the highest Tier for Co-op(Defense).
- Current Rewards will be added to Accumulated Season Rewards and be reset every 48 hours. However, for the final Sunday of the season, the Rewards will be accumulated after 24 hours.
- The accumulated rewards can be acquired at the end of the season at once.

A ceremonial censer from The Chosen One. The herb inside is an indigenous species from the Desert of Madness. Inhaling the smoke from burning the herb induces a trance state accompanied with mental boost and delight. This item is classified as a drug because of its mind-altering effects. Sale and cultivation of this item is forbidden.

The lingering scent of the burnt logs crosses over the darkness and reaches the gateway.
This is the light of guidance from the lighthouse, the anchor’s chain from the docking ship.
The great star will finally descend into the plains.

Marianne is a famed exoskeleton engineer in Teatan kingdom. Teatans are known for their wits and adorable appearances - with cute animal ears and child-like height. Marianne isn't exactly a fan of her size. But instead of sulking over it, she builds weapons bigger than anyone. 

She is a one-in-a-billion genius and she knows it. She is a perfectionist and a workaholic. It's not unusual for her to be stuck in her workshop for days without responding to anyone.

She is arrogant, but knows when to admire others. What she'll never do is admit someone is smarter than her.

Akayuki is an ancient wandering swordsman.

She's been petrified for 500 years and is a bit out of touch with the modern world. When faced with entirely new technologies and cultures, her solution was simple. Nothing. She'll live the way she always has and figure things out on the go.

She has dedicated her life to challenging strong opponents. She will stop at nothing when there is any chance of a good fight and will fight with everything she has no matter who the opponent is. And if she loses, she will admire the foe and laugh it off. She simply enjoys good fights.

A parcel was delivered to the shooting site yesterday.
It only said "Recipient: Invader Pictures" without any specification.
Inside the package was a fine fishbowl.
None of the staffs says they ordered it.
It looked too good to throw away, so I bought some goldfish in and made a small fishtank.
It's quite therapeutic after getting smashed by the assistant director.
Speaking of getting smashed, the Invader Director seems irritated since yesterday.
He ordered a helmet and apparently it's not here yet.
He's very scary when he gets mad… I hope it gets delivered soon.

- Season Rewards are accumulated based on the highest tier cleared.
- However, there are no rewards for clearing Champion Tier.
- Rewards for Joint Matching will be based on the participating player’s level. 
- Current Rewards will be based on records of 3 heroes that cleared the highest Tier for Co-op.
- Current Rewards will be added to Accumulated Season Rewards and be reset every 48 hours. However, for the final Sunday of the season, the Rewards will be accumulated after 24 hours.
- The accumulated rewards can be acquired at the end of the season at once.

A dagger that all The Chosen One members, from the highest priests to the lowest believers, possess. It is overly showy and looks impractical, but the blade has been sharpened enough to pierce the heart. A book of scripture and a dagger is given to new entrants, who carry the items from their beginnings to their ends.

You are the branches of a tree rooted in the plains.
An extended night will cover the land in a constant darkness.
If the branches don’t fall off, they will wither with the tree.
If they do, they will become firewood to light up the darkness.

- Auto Battle is a function that allows auto repeating of Gnome’s Storehouse.
- Auto Battle can be used limitlessly to the number of owned tickets.
- Auto Battle and sweep is available after manually clearing Gnome’s Storehouse with 3 stars.
- Sweep is a feature that clears a dungeon in a short period.
- Sweep can be used limitlessly to the number of owned tickets after unlocking, but it can only be used 50 times at a time.
- If a touch interaction occurs during Auto Battle, it won’t be considered as being cleared by Auto Battle, so please be careful.

- You can invest Season Specialty Points to raise your Season Specialty Level.
- You can use 1 point to raise 1 level.
- Raising your Season Specialty Level allows you to unlock higher-tier Season Specialties in that Season Specialty category.
- You can check the unlock conditions for each tier of Season Specialties through the gauge at the bottom of the Season Specialty Management Window.
- Season Specialties that are linked to other season specialties can only be unlocked after raising the points of all previous season specialties to their maximum level.

A copy of the Book of Prophecies found on the body of a Chosen One believer.
The following contents are printed.

Book of Prophecies part 4 chapter 3.
On the day the Calamity Egg hatches, true doom shall befall upon this land,
A savior will arrive on those who have faith.

There’s a scribbled writing written on the back of the copy.

Archpriestess, thank you. I have done my part.
I saw the proper omen of doom after breaking through the forbidden curtain and bringing this here.
I will now rest my eyes happily since every shred of the prophecy is correct.

- Hero's [c][DE3955]Level[-][/c] will be initialized and all used [c][DE3955]Exps[-][/c] will be returned.
- Hero's [c][DE3955]Awakening[-][/c] will be initialized and all used [c][ED3955]Awakening Stones[-][/c] and [c][DE3955]Gold[-][/c] will be returned.
- Hero's [c][DE3955]Limit Break[-][/c] will be initialized and all used [c][ED3955]Hero Crystals[-][/c] will be returned.

Check if there are any unclaimed Hero Knowledge rewards.[-][/c]

When equipped, the Hero’s abilities will adjust to fit the weapon.
- Even when not the party leader, the weapon skill can still be used, but only 20% of damage and Ailment will be applied.
- When the weapon skill hits a single target, the damage dealt is increased by 50%.
- Party Effects will change to [c][F8E8CB]Increase Weapon Skill Regen Speed and Skill Damage[-][/c].
- Normal Attack will change to [c][F8E8CB]Offing[-][/c].
- Chain Skill will change to [c][F8E8CB]Water Tornado[-][/c].
- Special Ability will change to [c][F8E8CB]Flowing Water[-][/c].

- You can enter the Friendly Match by pressing the Friendly Match button.
- Anyone can open a Friendly Match.
- You can easily match and face off against other users with Public Room Random Matching.
- You can select Open Pick Match which reveals the opponent’s hero selection or Blind Pick Match which doesn’t reveal the opponent's hero selection.
- You can match and face off against chosen users in Private Rooms with a generated code.
- Private Rooms will proceed as Open Pick Matches only.
- A 3:3 battle will begin with the same rules as the Arena.

- You can invest Kamazon Point to register benefits.
- Benefit offers useful effects for your challenge.
- Some benfits can be invested multuple times to earn enhanced effect.
- Registered benefits can be retrieved when you are not in challenge, and you will be reimbursed all the points you invested.
- Benefits will be shared among all difficulties.
- Some benefits cannot be registered first, but can be unlocked after satisfying specific conditions.
- Registered benefit will be maintained for the season, and when the season is over it will all be reset.

- You can obtain Rewards when participating in Conquest.
- [c][4BC7E6]Participation Rewards[-][/c]: Battle Medals will be given each time you attack a Base.
- [c][4BC7E6]Conquest Rewards[-][/c]: When a Base is conquered, all Guild Members will be given Conquest Points allocated to it.
- [c][4BC7E6]Point Rewards[-][/c]: You can obtain Point Rewards by gathering Conquest Points.
- Unobtained Point Rewards during the Round’s progression will be automatically obtained during the next Round or entering Conquest for the first time after the season is over.

- You can use Evolution Stones to strengthen your Hero.
- Strengthening improves the Hero's general Stats and upgrades his/her Strengthening Level.
- You need 40 Evolution Stones per Strengthening.
- Heroes' maximum Strengthening Level differs according to their grades.
Grade 2: 0 ~ +2
Grade 3: 0 ~ +7
Grade 4: 0 ~ +20

- You can evolve your Hero once he/she reaches the maximum Strengthening Level.
- Evolution improves the Hero's general Stats.
- After Evolution, the Hero's Strengthening Level will be initialized.
- It also opens up new Awakening Nodes.

- Befriend various monsters and manage your ranch.
- You can meet monsters by praying to the Monster Stone Statue.
- You can increase the Friendship Level by feeding or interacting with your monster.
- Your monsters’ Friendship Level decreases slightly each day.
- The Friendship Level of monsters with Max Friendship Level will be maintained for up to 3 days without you visiting the Ranch.
- You can receive a gift if you achieve all Friendship Levels with your monster.
- Leveling up the Monster House will increase the number of monsters you can raise.

- Boss Rush lasts for 1 week, with powerful boss monsters as enemies.
- Boss Rush consists of 3 Steps.
- At the start of the challenge, you can progress from Step 1 to Step 3.
- You can enter a Boss Monster Stage with the difficulty of your choice for each Step.
- Once you finish the battle with a Boss Monster, you will obtain a score based on the battle results.
- Once you complete all the battles up to the Boss Monster of Step 3, the Challenge is finished.
- When the Challenge is finished, each Step’s score will be added to record a Total Score.

Mei is an apprentice of master Tao in school of Shen Mountain Fist.

Once prestigious, her family was destroyed by false treason accusations by its political rivals. She started training martial arts to get her revenge, but eventually got attracted to level of depth, both physically and spiritually, that lies within the art.

She has natural gift in martial arts. Before mater Tao took her, she already trained herself into a competent martial artist. She is hot headed and impatient, but she is starting to learn to control herself through meditation.

Marvin is a ruthless mercenary active in Desert Kingdom.

His body is as if it was engineered for pure destruction. With his inhumane strength and toughness, he was feared even among the fellow mercenaries. He was never welcomed into any place and has given up on getting close with anyone. He is harsh and jaded. But if he were to find something precious to him, he wouldn't stop at anything to protect it.

As he's been through myriads of battles, he's never agitated by one. In fact, many would say he seems more relaxed and comfortable in battles.

You side with Dabin and order the installation of additional cannons. Though reluctant, the androids follow your orders.
When the festival reaches its peak, Dabin fires all the cannons at once.
The roar tears through the air, and the ground shakes violently, knocking you and the townspeople off balance.
Just as complaints are about to break out, a dazzling display of fireworks fills the sky.
Amazed by the spectacle, you applaud.
As the festival ends, the townspeople thank you with a gift, saying it’s a day they’ll remember for a long time.

Guardian wolves are powerful mystical creatures that live in snowy lands.

When invaders made their debut to the world, they hunted down guardian wolves. The young wolf got stranded from its pack and was forced to survive alone. During its journey, it was befriended by two men. One was a poacher who wanted his skin, and another was a gambler who was knee deep in dog fighting. After escaping these two "friends", it became extremely skeptical of humans.

But if you land him a sincere and patient hand, he might still be your most loyal friend.

- The Exclusive Equipment Slot has 3 effects: maximum Level, maximum Limit Break and maximum Options.
- Each effect opens up based on the weapon level, the number of different [SSR] Exclusive Weapons owned, and the total number of Limit Breaks regarding the [SSR] Equipments you own.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.
- However, if the maximum Limit Break effect has not been unlocked, then the equipment’s level will be set according to its current Limit Break state.

- The Exclusive Equipment Slot has 3 effects: maximum Level, maximum Limit Break and maximum Options.
- Each effect opens up based on the weapon level, the number of different [SSR] Exclusive Weapons owned, and the total number of Limit Breaks regarding the [SSR] Equipments you own.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.
- However, if the maximum Limit Break effect has not been unlocked, then the equipment’s level will be set according to its current Limit Break state.

Today the DP said he'll buy us coffee.
He specifically metioned me, that he'll get me coffee personally for he knows I'm struggling as the youngest of the crew.
I always learned that I should respect when elders offer me something.
So I ordered my favorite, a special drink based on chocolate cream frappuccino with long java chips and chocolate drizzle, whipped espresso, four pumps of mocha syrup, and five pumps of hazelnut syrup.
He was speechless.
He's probably too amazed of my elegant taste.
Maybe I should give him some tips on the topic.

Girgas is a mischievous young dragon.

It is unclear where he came from. He ran away from home because he wanted to use magic without getting scolded by his mother. "I'm a dragon. I can do what I want!" is what he said, right before his incomplete transformation magic got him stuck in a half-dragon half-human form.

He looks down on humans as they are weak and small. But it should be noted that Girgas himself is young and naive, completely new to the world. He tries to pretend nothing ever surprises him but that unfortunately fools no one.

- The Exclusive Equipment Slot has 3 effects: maximum Level, maximum Limit Break and maximum Options.
- Each effect opens up based on the weapon level, the number of different Epic Exclusive Weapons owned, and the total number of Limit Breaks regarding the Epic Equipments you own.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.
- However, if the maximum Limit Break effect has not been unlocked, then the equipment’s level will be set according to its current Limit Break state.

Gremory is a research scientist from the devildom. Her life is solely dedicated to researching magic.

Her mind largely deviates from that of an ordinary person. She often gets trapped in her own thoughts in any time and place. She would start talking to oneself in middle of conversations or burst into endless ravings about her crazy research ideas.

To Gremory's eyes, everyone is an experimental subject. No one can predict what will happen to a subject in her lab or whether the subject will be able to see the sun again for that matter.

- To enter a stage, you must have at least one hero that meets the stage requirements.
- In the Normal Stage Information screen, you can enter Public Rooms and Private Rooms.
- Random Entry allows you to randomly enter a public room of a Normal Stage you already cleared.
- Public Rooms of Normal Stages and Random Entry use only the first slot of each class in the Hero Roster.
- Challenge Stages can only be accessed through private rooms.
- You can play Challenge Stages with other players in private rooms by adding the room to the list.

- Once the leader has been selected, party members will be recommended automatically.
- When making recommendations, the party members' growth statuses will be prioritized.
- Among the well-developed heroes, their class, type and equipment will be compared to form the strongest possible party.
- In the case of Supporters, those with healing abilities will be prioritized.
- If a Supporter with no healing abilities is chosen as the party leader, other Supporters will be considered again instead of selecting Warriors or Ranged Dealers.

On equipping, the Hero’s abilities will change to fit the weapon, and the hero can equip a shield.
- On equipping a shield, only [c][F8E8CB]20%[-][/c] of the shield’s standard Def will be applied, but damage dealt will be increased by [c][F8E8CB]20%[-][/c].
- Party Effects will change to [c][F8E8CB]increase Skill Damage[-][/c].
- Normal Attack will change to [c][F8E8CB]Mecha Marksmanship[-][/c].
- Chain Skill will change to [c][F8E8CB]Aiden Rider Break[-][/c].
- Special Ability will change to [c][F8E8CB]Psychic Generator[-][/c].

This is the exact mockup of the renowned martial arts test site in Shen city.
Beware of the enemies even when you're hiding behind the walls.
It is favorable to Heroes who can make ranged attacks or powerful melee attacks.
Who is the strongest of us all? This has been the vital question in all times and places. Even the members of Tiger clan and Viper clan would stop their feuding and participate in the test to prove their skills and abilities. They fight and compete over the honorable title of 'The Greatest Existing in the World.'

Examining the mecha suit, you realize it is powered by a special small reactor. As you remove the reactor, the mecha quickly shuts down, and the anti-gravity device soon ceases to function as well. Scintilla's face contorts in pain as she bears the immense weight, but she soon becomes excited, her expression filled with joy. "This is it! The incredible resistance I feel even just moving a finger...! The legendary training equipment was real!" Shaking your head in disbelief, you leave Scintilla behind and head out with the reactor.
Ancient Ruin Entrance

- You can claim rewards as your Pass Level increases.
- You can upgrade to the Gold and Platinum Pass through pass purchases.
- Purchasing the Gold Pass allows you to additionally obtain Pass Exp and Gold Pass rewards based on your level.
- Purchasing the Platinum Pass allows you to obtain Pass Exp, Platinum Pass rewards and Gold Pass rewards together.
- When a new season starts, the upgrade status of your Pass is reset.
- Pass upgrades are only available for purchase up to 10 minutes before the end of the Guardian Pass season.

The sharp mandibles of the creatures that emerged across Shen City and brought calamity.

This organism was first discovered through the nightmare at Shen City.
The creatures with mandibles sharp enough to cut through steel and boulders resemble spiders, but they’re completely different organisms.
They are highly aggressive and attack any organism that gets too close. They’re also observed to move in groups.
Based on the numerous wrinkles on the mandible, the youngest individuals are predicted to be at least 500 years old.

[c][DEB489]Selecting Basic Options[-][/c]
- When the possible combination among the selected Basic Options is endowed to the Relic, the auto change will stop.
- Even when only one of the selected Basic Options is endowed, the auto change will stop.

[c][DEB489]Selecting Basic Options Average Levels[-][/c]
- The Option’s Average Level means the average level value of the same Options endowed to the Relic.
- When the average level endowed to the Relic is above or equal to the Option's average level, the auto change will stop.

- Co-op Expedition features new co-op stages and stories throughout several seasons.
- Stages in Co-op Expedition are played in real-time with up to 4 players.
- Co-op Expedition stories are played automatically when certain requirements are met, such as starting a new season, entering stages or clearing stages. They can also be replayed in Records.
- Set up a hero of the class you wish to play through Hero Roster and match up with other players to take on the stage.
- Clear stages to obtain rewards or check out new stories.

- Co-op Expedition features new co-op stages and stories throughout several seasons.
- Stages in Co-op Expedition are played in real-time with up to 4 players.
- Co-op Expedition stories are played automatically when certain requirements are met, such as starting a new season, entering stages or clearing stages. They can also be replayed in Records.
- Set up a hero of the class you wish to play through Hero Roster and match up with other players to take on the stage.
- Clear stages to obtain rewards or check out new stories.

Amy is a mercenary and a berserker, dressed as a maid.

It's not a fashion choice. Her mercenary partner, Dolf, asked her to wear it so that he can better disguise himself as a high class court magician. Amy hates the ploy but plays along since Dolf gets them great deals that Amy could never get. 

She is usually quiet and timid. But when it comes to battles she is a formidable berserker. She wields two handed weapons like it's a children's toy and roars like a dragon. The face she makes alone can give her foes nightmares.

- You can use Gems to summon various Heroes and Epic Exclusive Equipment.
- Heroes and Equipment designated as the Pickup Hero & Exclusive Equipment Summon have a higher summon chance.
- You receive 1 Pickup Ticket for each Pickup Summon.
- Pickup Tickets can be used in exchange for Pickup Heroes & Exclusive Equipment during the Pickup Period.
- Each Pickup Hero & Exclusive Equipment has its own set of Pickup Tickets.
- When the pickup period ends, Pickup Tickets will be converted to regular Mileage Tickets on a 1:1 basis.

Recently, the growth rate of Hwangai Group’s official FB followers had been alarmingly low. So I personally looked into it… and found out that an ex-employee, fired just a few days ago, had been sabotaging us using an anti-fan account!
Most people would’ve punished him immediately, but… I thought one step ahead. I made that guy manage Hwangai Group’s official FB page himself!
Thanks to that, our official follower count has been skyrocketing day by day. It won’t be long before I receive praise from the chairman.

- This class specializes in dealing great damage to enemies through powerful attacks.
- The class skill [Rage Explosion] is an explosion of rage that increases the hero's Crit Hit Multiplier by 100% for 5 seconds.
- The class skill [Mortal Blow] is an exceedingly powerful attack that deals melee damage to the target. This attack always results in a crit hit.
- The class skill [Meteorite Fall] is an exceedingly powerful attack that deals ranged damage to enemies within a wide area. This attack always results in a crit hit.

A thin wooden piece with a tassel accessory. A verse from The Chosen One scripture is engraved on the exterior.

The prophet said, everything is pointless, worthless, futile, fruitless, and in vain.
Behold. What has passed will return and what has occurred will repeat.
The eye will not be sated from seeing nor the ear be filled from hearing. What has occurred will not be remembered, so what arises will not be passed on.
For the loop has now been broken, so fill a new vessel with power and grace and endow it to this land.

- Finish your challenge after enjoying as much as you want, and you can start a new challenge in Kama-ZONE.
- You can tap on Finish Challenge button to check your collected Bottle Caps, Kamazon Points, Artifacts, Curses, Benefits, and Silver Coins during the challenge.
- When a challenge is finished, your artifacts and silver coins collected during the challenge will be returned.
- When a challenge is finished, all Heroes' HP is recovered to full.
- When a Season or Round ends, your challenge will be automatically over.

- Player-matching starts once you choose a Co-op stage to enter, among players that have chosen the same stage.
- Each player chooses 1 owned hero to enter the stage. The selected hero can be reselected during player-matching.
- After a certain amount of time or if all players are ready, all players enter the stage together.
- If there are fewer than 4 players participating in the Co-op, player stats are increased in proportion to the number of missing players.
- There are no limits in the number of Co-op you can play.

- The Exclusive Equipment slot applies the highest values for 5 growth factors: Level / Evolution, Grade 6 Evolution, Limit Break, Engraving and Options.
- Each effect opens up based on the Stage progression, equipment level, the number of different Epic Exclusive Equipments owned, the total number of Limit Breaks regarding the Epic Equipments you own, and the number of engraved Epic Exclusive Equipments owned.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.

A medication with sleep-inducing properties.
The user will [b]lose consciousness[/b] and fall asleep within ten minutes.
It is water-soluble and dissolves easily in water or tea if removed from its capsule.
Since it is not classified as a dangerous item, it can apparently be brought into the venue.

[c][1c34aa]This sleeping pill appears to be the same brand that Ashika typically uses. Conversely, Ashika currently maintains that they have 'lost their own sleeping pills.' This discrepancy is certainly suspicious.[-][/c]

Relief supplies from the Chosen One for the citizens of Dungeon Kingdom.
The blue jelly is especially popular.

The Chosen One was the first to arrive at the ruins of Dungeon Kingdom. They searched for survivors and handed out supplies.
The aid of the Chosen One was like a beam of light in the darkness for the survivors awaiting their deaths inside the ruins.
For those who are desperate, filling their stomachs and licking their wounds ring true rather than complicated sermons.
Salvation begins from what’s close by.

An old and discolored Sheet Music.
It sings of a dark and sad song in a mournful tone.

Bard Ringo, known as a member of the Hero Party that saved the world, turned his entire adventure into songs.
The special fact he was a member of the Hero Party, and the songs’ high artistic quality fetches the Sheet Music a high price among collectors. It’s famously known that the current Emperor of Rah likes Ringo’s song. The Emperor’s mad collecting desires for the original Sheet Music made the prices jump even further.

- You can obtain materials by breaking [c][FE902E]Trees[-][/c] and [c][FE902E]Rocks[-][/c] in the field.
- You can create various [c][FE902E]Buildings[-][/c] and [c][FE902E]Objects[-][/c].
- Few Buildings can Level Up via Upgrades and their features will be enhanced.
- Leveling Up the Houser will increase the Maximum Level for buildings and Maximum number of Crop Tiles.
- Leveling Up the Storage will increase the storage capacity for Materials.
- Constructed Buildings and Objects can be freely placed within the Farm.

Jay is a Teatan ninja.

He is small, flexible, and is good at hiding his body. From early on he enjoyed ninja-like activities such as surprising his parents' from behind or hiding under the bed before someone came to wake him up. He is also good at not getting noticed and can sneak away without anyone noticing.

His biggest decision was whether he should choose a career as a ninja or a private detective. Although the latter had better financial perspective, Jay chose the former, as he gets to say more badass lines.

- Dream Evolution Stones are supplementary materials that can replace the Evolution Stones of any Hero.
- Dream Evolution Stones can be used in place of 1 Unique Hero's Evolution Stone, 2 Rare Hero's Evolution Stones, or 5 Normal Hero's Evolution Stones.
- You can use the settings icon next to the number of Evolution Stones owned to choose how many to use.
- Dream Evolution Stones are used before Hero Evolution Stones.
- Dream Evolution Stones can be obtained through the Gem Shop, Event Missions or even Hero reset.

- Auto Battle is a feature that lets you automatically play numerous rift dungeons.
- When entering Auto Battle, the selected stage will be repeated for the number of times you’ve set.
- Auto Battle can be used infinitely within the stamina you have.
- Auto Battle can be used on 3-star cleared stages.
- Each Event Rift ticket allows you to recharge your entry count 1 time.
- Auto Battle in Awakening Dungeon and Event Rift Dungeon can be used as many times using gems. Gems are used when ticket recharge is needed.

Karina is a mischievous young vampire.

Vampires no longer hunt human blood in modern society. Any vampire with grace and manners will buy blood from blood banks at fair price. However, born in a precious vampire household, Karina wanted to have little fun with her food.

She disguised herself as an innocent lost girl in forest and took little bits of blood from unsuspecting adventurers. She did it because it is "very sweet and lots of fun". If you are to accompany her, you better prepare some iron supplements.

- Press Guild Information button at the top to find information including guild member list, guild ranking, etc.
- If you are a Guild Master, you can change your guild information such as current emblem or approval status of join requests.
- The position of a Guild Master can be delegated to another Guild Member.
- Guild Master can expel Guild members from the Guild.
- If the Guild Master does not login for more than 14 days, then the position of Guild Master will automatically be given to another Guild Member.

Marty Junior is Marty's son, who was the Teatan Defence Force captain and Marianne's friend. 

He spent his adolescence blaming his father for abandoning his wife and son to defend the kingdom and Marianne for causing his father's death. However, after reconciling with Marianne through Marianne's heartfelt apology, Marty Junior grew to be a better person with the teaching from a skilled engineer, Marianne. Marty Junior could acquire both Marty's bravery and leadership, and Marianne's adept engineering skills.

- You can craft or upgrade merch in Merch Forge.
- Blueprint and material needed for merch crafting can be obtained through world exploration.
- Unique Merch are crafted within 50 times per Blueprint from the previous Unique Merch crafting. 
- Super Costumes are unrelated to Blueprints and crafted within 150 times from the previous Super Costume crafting. 
- If a confirmed crafting of Unique Merch and Super Costumes overlap, the Unique Merch will be crafted first, then the Super Costume will be crafted next.

Unlike Tokki, Bokki is a subspecies of Tokki that inhabits the Prairies.

Due to its high intelligence, it knows better than to be hostile to humans. So it veils its unique wild nature by wearing human clothes.

Every Bokki proudly wears a ribbon received as a gift from its soulmate, Pokki.

Bokki is known to be the top predator in the Prairies, but it is classified as non-threatening due to its peaceful temperament. However, if you try to take away its ribbon, you might have to face terrifying consequences.

Leah is an elven protector of Kanterbury forest.

No one knows where she came from or when she started to protect the forest. By her own account, she was just passing by the forest when she saw animals cornered by a poacher. She saved the animals, then she saw another poacher, kicked him out, one thing led to another and she realized she was several decades late to her appointment.

Because most poachers are humans she developed hate towards them. Maybe someone with a good heart can change her mind someday.

Closed Classroom is where the Magic School held its lecture for antipersonnel magic combat.
There are long walls placed to avoid the enemy's attack or run away. 
Heroes that can attack over the walls or move quickly while attacking will have the upper hand. 
Antipersonnel magic combat lecture was held in Magic Academy since the school was founded. However, in A.H. 343, the safety magic circle malfunctioned and caused massive collateral damage. Since then the lecture has been closed along with the classroom.

- Giant Capsule Machine uses Voucher Coins to earn various prizes.
- During the event period you can use the coin collected from completing missions to get prize from the Giant Capsule Machine.
- There are 3 Giant Capsule Machines and each has different grand prize.
- Collect Voucher Coins to aim for the grand prize.
- For each roll you get one Empty Capsule.
- Collect Empty Capsules to exchange for various winnings.
- After the Event ends, you can still collect unclaimed rewards during the checkout period.

- The Exclusive Equipment slot has 3 effects: maximum level, maximum Limit Break and maximum Options.
- Each effect opens up depending on the weapon’s level, and the sum of different owned Epic Exclusive Equipment, and the number of Limit Break of owned Exclusive Equipment.
- The equipment’s original growth will be applied for the slot’s effects that have not been unlocked yet.
- However, if the maximum Limit Break has not been unlocked, then the equipment’s level will be set to maximum Limit Break.

- There are four Hero slot effects: Max Evolution, Max Awakening, Max Limit Break, and Max Blessing.
- Each effect will unlock based on stage completion, number of Unique Heroes owned, growth progression for each Unique Hero, and number of Heroes owned with max blessing.
- Effects that have not been unlocked will use the original stat on the Hero in the slot.
- If Max Limit Break Effect has not been unlocked, then the Hero in the slot will reach the max level matching the Hero's current Limit Break status.

- Enemies damaged with Weapon Skills or Chain Skills are put in different ailments.
- Types of ailments include [c][e6ff70]down[-][/c], [c][3cfff8]airborne[-][/c], [c][72ec61]injury[-][/c], depending on the Skills you use.

- Just like floor clear reward, special reward can be earned once for each difficulty in one round.
- If you did not earn the special reward for the difficulty easier than the difficulty you are on for this round, you will be granted the reward for the lower difficulty as well when you clear the last floor.
- If you already earned the special reward for the difficulty higher than or same as the difficulty you are on for this round, you will not be granted the special reward when you clear the last floor.

Prickle is a hedgehog which inhabits Grassland regions.

It has the surprising ability to store elemental energy in the quills on its back. If this process is repeated for years over several generations, its body constitution may change. This is Prickle’s unique evolution method.

Prickles that are young or have absorbed several elemental energies in balance do not evolve.

Prickle is affectionate and likes to dance, which is one of the reasons why they’ve become a well-known and beloved pet monster.

Approximately 200 people are attending the event, entering floor by floor.
Precautions regarding a disguised trickster are recorded in a separate handover section.

[c][1c34aa]Since the schedule didn't allow for lengthy verifications, it seems they permitted entry as long as personal information matched, even for potential disguised tricksters. That explains why [b]entry security was so lax[/b]. It's a relief, however, that they were thorough with [b]dangerous item[/b] inspections and caught them.[-][/c]

- Giant Capsule Machine uses Voucher Coins to earn various prizes.
- During the event period you can use the coin collected from completing missions to get prize from the Giant Capsule Machine.
- There are 3 Giant Capsule Machines and each has different grand prize.
- Collect Voucher Coins to aim for the grand prize.
- For each roll you get one Empty Capsule.
- Collect Empty Capsules to exchange for various winnings.
- The Giant Capsule Machine and Empty Capsule can only be used during the event period.

- Heroes who completed Limit Break can go through Hero Ascent by using Hero Crystals.
- Ascended Heroes will have strengthened stats, and will have newly opened Awakening Nodes.
- Ascended Heroes’ illustration will change to their Ascent Illustration, and an Ascent Story will be added.
- Unlocking the newly opened Special Nodes via Hero Ascent requires Awakening Stones, Gold and Stellar Essence.
- Ascended Heroes' rarity will not change.
- Ascended Heroes cannot be placed into the Training Room slot.

Aoba is a leaf fairy that protects flowers of Kanterbury forest.

Half an hour of her touch does more wonder to flowers than hours of work from any other fairy. She would be the greatest leaf fairy of her generation - if she was not a natural born slacker. Instead of taking care of flowers all day, she invented magical sprinklers and automated her entire job. She now spends time taking naps and reading comic books from the human world.

By her own account, she is not lazy per se. She's just efficient.

Dragon is a Teatan fighter who mastered Ultra Rationale.

Ultra Rationale is a technique that connects every single muscle cell to its user's consciousness. It allows the user to plan actions and have muscles move exactly according to the plan, leaving no room for instincts or spontaneous movements. Because he needs to plan everything beforehand it requires some time for him to do anything, but when he does, he carries it out with perfect accuracy. He is the only Teatan known to master this technique.

- Season Rewards are accumulated based on the highest tier cleared.
- Rewards for Joint Matching will be based on the participating player’s level. 
- Current Rewards will be based on records of 3 heroes that cleared the highest Tier for Co-op.
- Current Rewards will be added to Accumulated Season Rewards and be reset every 48 hours. However, for the final Sunday of the season, the Rewards will be accumulated after 24 hours.
- The accumulated rewards can be acquired at the end of the season at once.

Rie is the cleanup hitter for the best Heavenhold battleball team, Purple Sox.

She is a passionate ace solely focused on battleball and practice all the time. The blazing desert is her battleball field, the freezing snow mountain is perfect to hone her battle sense for harsh weather and her batting power. Impossible is nothing, practice makes perfect are her slogans.

She is a connoisseur in steak. The perfect way to end a harsh training with sweat and exhausted body has to be a grilled juicy steak.

- You can enter the Friendly Match by pressing the Friendly Match button.
- Anyone can open a Friendly Match.
- You can easily match and face off against other users with Public Room Random Matching.
- You can match and face off against chosen users in Private Rooms with a generated code.
- Private Rooms offer a spectating feature.
- There can be upto 4 spectators
- Spectators can spectate in either the two players’ views or in free-mode. 
- A 3:3 battle will begin with the same rules as the Arena.

The ice witch carefully picks out her outfit before going on the hunt. A wide assortment of beautiful garments allows her to enjoy the hunt more.
A man and woman who climbed the mountain to collect herbs became the ice witch’s first prey. The man who left the frozen woman behind and ran away also met the same fate. His final words: “No”.
The ice witch’s second prey was a man in armor, but her hunt failed due to a missed attack. The ice witch demanded her failure be omitted from the records.

Examining the suit, you realize it's powered by a small reactor. The moment you remove it, the suit shuts down, and hundreds of kilograms of scrap metal crush down on Scintilla! Her face contorts in pain for a moment... but then, a joyful smile spreads across it. "This is it! My entire body is screaming just from moving a finger! A powered-down suit is the ultimate training equipment!" Leaving Scintilla behind as she begins a plank with an ecstatic look on her face, you take the reactor and head out.

- The Yutnori Event is a mini-game where you spend Event Tokens to throw Yut sticks, move your pieces, and compete against Invaders.
- By playing the event, you can obtain Red Lucky Pouches and Blue Lucky Pouches.
- Collect these pouches to earn various rewards.
- After the event ends, a Reward Checkout Period will be available, allowing you to claim any rewards you did not collect during the event.
- During the Reward Claim Period, Red Lucky Pouches and Blue Lucky Pouches can no longer be obtained.

Zoe is a tour guide of the Succubus town.

Ever since childhood, she loved to venture every part of the town. She knows and loves every inch of the town - from crowded tourist attractions to her own personal quiet place for meditation.

She is easy going and kind. She can help any nervous tourist to have a time of his life in the town. However, her kindness should not be construed as weakness. She knows her way in battles and when customers get rough, she is more than capable of taking them down.

- You can craft or upgrade merch in Merch Forge.

Blade is a Teatan fighter who can transform into Super Teatan 2.

Only a pure minded Teatan triggered by extreme anger can transform into Super Teatan. Blade first transformed into Super Teatan at 12, when he was grounded for failing geology. While grounded he enhanced his spirit through meditation which allowed him to transform into Super Teatan 2, an even higher form of transformation.

Blade is small, even among the Teatans. That allows him to maintain his speed even after the transformation.

- Raid battle stages last for 60 seconds. 
- If the time runs out or the player gets defeated, the battle stage ends and the damage is recorded. 
- If you leave the stage in the middle of a raid battle due to network failure, your damage will not recorded but your Daily Entry will be deducted.

- If your battle ends after the end of the season, the damage will not be recorded.

Coco is an innuit girl from Mt. Shivering.

Inheriting the cursed bloodline of the ice witch, she is gifted with powerful magic. When she realized her power, she decided to live by herself away from the people. It was to protect herself from people and people from herself. Her only friend is her loyal sleigh dog.

She may seem cold and quiet but holds deep passion and love for people. She loves watching rain on sea, as dances of running water lets her forget about her power for a moment.

Maria is a merchant who runs a traveling caravan shop along with her friend, Lisa.

Maria and Lisa have been friends since childhood. Maria is a bit short and chubby, but she is smart and quick. She's jack of all trades. When Lisa makes a mistake in the books, Maria will secretly correct it for her. 

Sometimes she has to go on an extra adventure to save their investor, Prince Beach, from a mischievous turtle queen. It's tiresome, but with Lisa's help, Maria can overcome any challenge.

Lisa is a merchant who runs a traveling caravan shop along with her friend, Maria. She takes care of managing products and finances.

Lisa and Maria have been friends since childhood. Although they love each other to death, Lisa always felt there was a bit of a rivalry between the two, a rivalry that she always lost. To Lisa, Maria is someone who she depends on but would like to surpass one day.

Lisa doesn't like their investor, Prince Beach, and often wonders what Maria sees in him.

Fei is an apprentice of master Tao in school of Shen Mountain Fist.

Before meeting master Tao, he was a member of a famed Tiger Clan. However his lowly eventually got him rejected from the clan. Despite all the hardships and unfairness he firmly believes that good nature and strength lie within every person.

He goes extra miles to treat people fairly, never to make anyone feel like he once did. He is well mannered and calm, but shows his soft sides when he is talking to animals.
