Nephy is a wolf-shaped monster that can be found in cumulonimbus clouds.

Legend says that a Nephy is born from the gigantic cumulonimbus made by the vengeful spirits of the wolf-shaped monsters that were unable to ascend to heaven.

A Nephy uses its strong hind legs to jump extremely high and its cloud-like tail to glide in the air.

Another name for a Nephy is "Rain-calling Wolf," which derives from how its howls were heard before heavy rain poured down from cumulonimbus clouds.

The ice witch Lupins is a figure in Innuit legends who can summon wolves. She is infamous for being fickle and cruel. Lupina is known to emerge once every few decades. According to recent rumors however, she’s been emerging more frequently.
Arrived at the ice witch’s cave and successfully made contact with Lupina. Surprisingly she remembered the scrivener ancestor who visited 120 years ago. She gladly accepted being recorded saying it will aid her in raising her infamy again.

- Guild Conquest is PvE content that involves ousting enemy forces with Guild Members and conquering enemy bases,
- Guild Conquest will be open for 2 weeks and progress differently for each Round. 
- Guild Members will design an optimal route under the Guild Master’s command and can play strategically.
- The goal is to neutralize each Step's defenses, occupy Control Towers to progress to the next stage, and occupy the enemy’s Command Headquarters within the enemy’s post.

The Death Match is the inheritance of a long custom from Dungeon kingdom.
Here are no obstacles whatsoever.
It is favorable to Heroes who can take the battle head-to-head.
Uncountable conflicts between warriors of dungeons have been settled in a very straightforward way. To take part in Dungeon kingdom's customary Death Match and fight until one of them falls. Since its opening, the kingdom's court has evidently become idle. Though that doesn't mean a peaceful dungeon at all.

Sizzle is an evolved version of Prickle and inhabits the Lava Zone.

Generations of absorbing fire elemental energy have caused the quills on its back to become flames. 

It is possible to estimate Sizzle’s age through the size of its flames. The flames grow bigger the longer Sizzle lives, and there seems to be no limit to their size. A normal Sizzle's flames are the size of a small flame, but those of a Sizzle that has lived over 100 years are the size of a large campfire.

The Secret Temple remained hidden from the world until its discovery.

The black murk at the center of the temple intensifies early turf wars, while the central area, located in the middle of the map, can either provide you advantageous high ground for combat or put you in danger, requiring careful decision-making. Various strategies can be formulated using the portals.

Research suggests that this place was created as an arena by the ancients for their own entertainment.

- You win a battle if you make your opponent's Hero faint within 30 seconds.
- If none of the Heroes faint after 30 seconds, the one with higher HP wins.
- If both Heroes have the same amount of HP left after 30 seconds, the match ends with a tie and the participants are replaced with the next Hero for both players.
- After a Hero wins a battle, some of their HP gets healed, and they continue to participate in the next battle.
- Player with the last Hero wins the match.

- You can instantly boost your Hero, Equipment, and Merch growth in the Training Room.
- Choose your Hero, Equipment, and Merch to put in the Training Room and be the best in various contents.
- Heroes, Equipment, and Merch trained in the Training Room can be used in every contents.
- However, the growth is not permanent. Once you pull out the Hero, Equipment, or Merch from the training slot, the Hero, Equipment or merch will revert back to its original state of growth.

Hyper is the hero of Byrule, the legendary elven kingdom.

She is playful and innocent, but also considerate at the same time. She is good with swords and can't stand injustice.

She rescued prince Elda from an evil pig monster and saved Byrule multiple times. But for some reason, the pig monster kept coming back and somehow succeeded in kidnapping Elda every single time. Now Hyper is once again on a journey to save the prince, but she asks herself, "Does it ever end?"

Under the Minister's dominance, this was a place to torture
Fugitives and refugees who have broken the camp rules.
People and soldiers of Rah vented their stress as spectators,
While Minister established and maintained his political power.
It used to be a place to decide which one to die and which one to live, 
But now it became an arena to uncover the strongest fighter. 
As it was made to prevent any kind of escaping, 
The place is narrow and consists of dead ends.

Loraine is the owner of the Katerbury inn which is well known among adventurers for its high quality services. She will always greet you with a smile full of kindness but with a hint of darkness.

No one knows much about her. Her past, age, where she is from, what race she is - nothing. Even when you witness her die right in front of you, she'll be ready to greet you back at the inn.

There is one rule when you stay at her inn. Never look up while you are eating.

A scepter engraved with the Chosen One emblem.
 The jewel at the end of the scepter is discolored and cracked as if it used up all its power.

It’s a scepter known to be possessed by only the minute high priests of the Chosen One.
It’s a frightening object inlaid with a crystalized mana jewel.
It can cause a great explosion by releasing its mana, and it holds great power to destroy any obstacle. 
Even if it’s a barrier made with the borrowed power of a god.

Tokki is a rabbit-shaped monster that inhabits Grassland regions.

Although it is a monster, it is tamed and raised by humans. Initially, it used to be a monster with its own personality, but as humans raised it, it has become similar to an ordinary rabbit.

Usually, it is gentle and obedient to humans, but when it sees a beautiful Bokki and Pokki, it tends to get jealous and irritable. If raised alone, it is a relatively easy urban monster to nurture at home.

Noirly is a subspecies of Wooly and inhabits Grassland regions. Unlike other Woolies, its fur is black.

The cause for this phenomenon remains unknown. Biologically, they are no different from the rest of the species, but their dark coat makes them look different, causing them to be often bullied by the other Woolies that prefer bright, colorful fur.

Noirlies are rather indifferent to their surroundings and dislike being in groups, preferring to be solitary.

Peggy is a researcher from the Succubus town.

Her research focuses on the ecology of rare monsters. She is known for a bold investigative method - she descends dangerous dungeons herself to observe monsters. She is also a prolific writer and has published multiple books which became must-read among adventurers.

She wears thick glasses on purpose as she doesn't want to accidentally seduce her colleagues.

In the village I lived in, there were many proverbs that used wolves as metaphors.
When wheat stalks were blown over by strong gusts of wind, they would say they had been 'trampled by wolves’.
On years of poor wheat harvest, they would jokingly say they had been ‘eaten by wolves’.
I understand they want to blame someone, but… shouldn’t they take into consideration the listener’s feelings too?!
